reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unbelievable experience!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A test spot! For everyone! Clean! Nice local flowers rare! Pink sand that you will hardly see elsewhere! A test spot for a sea rest!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: to see
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi is the icing on the cake called Crete. you need to spend at least a day to taste the beauty of the place; we went there at the end of September and the tourism was nothing short of ... mighty. the clear water and the shoreline attract

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WONDERFUL and unique
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A true paradise! I thought I would never find the magical colors of my Budelli, now closed to the public for years, to preserve its fragile and uncontaminated environment, and instead... Elafonissi was an unforgettable emotion, as soon as you get there it takes your breath away. We arrived with 40 minutes by local bus, super crowded, from Chania, along mountain trails a bit rough, but the trip was worth it.  A magical, heavenly, indescribable place that took my breath away. We hope it stays that way.... I can't wait to go back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Markthal – a stunning building, but a bit disappointing in terms of price and crowds
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Markthal looks beautiful and the design is certainly attractive, but the experience was a bit mixed for me. Although there are many food stalls inside, it seems quite expensive in terms of price. On weekends, it is very crowded, so it is difficult to sit and eat properly or take pictures. The artwork of Horn of Plenty is really great, but there's not much to do outside of architecture. So, once in a while, nothing special.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not worth it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Overflowing mass handling and a few crumbs of pink sand. Overrated and too expensive. The wooden paths are dangerous in accidents.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Avoid the crowds.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The drive from Chania was superb. The beach is huge and when we were there early it accomodated all the tourists. The pink sand was more subtle than in photos and the water was very shallow.Stunning landscapes and surrounds. By midday the beach was swarming with tourists - a lot of them unaware of others space.  Once again sadly a place that pretty looses its initial beauty when over run with tourists. So go as early as you can on a shoulder season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is a beautiful beach! It is really worth walking further away , it is nicer there and has almost no people 💗

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful place, they charge you 5euros to park, there are several businesses in the area and the beach is amazing!! Don't miss it at any time of year

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parking scam!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Do not park in the closest lot. They will tell you that everything else is full and it’s 5 euro. Everything else is either free or cheaper. Don’t fall for the scam.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very disappointing. There are other beaches as beautiful and quieter
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If there was a lot of pink sand, there are just a few grains left!The wind whips the sand in mid-October, there are people but very few brave swimmers.Going further allows you to discover other pretty beaches less crowded

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Get a tour to see this gem
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We got a tour ,no hassel with parking. The most stunning beach and crystal clear water. We enjoyed the beach although it was quite windy! A tiny bit pink!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Welcome to Disneyland Cretans 🤦‍♂️
reviewsWithKeywords.text: How can there be more than 13,000 positive reviews for 800 negatives...such a gap is incredible and really suggests that people are revelling in crowding and scamming. Everything is said in the reviews one or two stars. Scam at from the parking lot , Scam on the "paradise" side of the site (pink sand)....1h30 from Chania, you might as well stay on beaches nearby. Crete becomes, even out of season now, a tourist factory. But hey..., the majority of tourists have to delight in such experiences given the vast majority of reviews. So keep playing sheep to pile you up in Elafonssini, I'll go somewhere else. Cretans, wake up!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Never again! A mass event with a nasty rip-off while parking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was disappointed and angry! It started with the fact that right at the beginning of the place we were pushed by official-looking folders with high-visibility vests into a parking lot that was huge and should cost 5 euros. Already on this place we had to walk very far to the exit. Then we passed several parking lots that were closer to the beach and cost only 3 euros. Quite a rip-off! However, we felt that the folders were officially from the community. It's a huge outrage how this single car park operator swindles his money! Then you first walk past the other cheaper parking lots and then you walk with an army with other visitors about 20 minutes in the scorching heat down a gravel road to the water. I had the impression that it was going to a Mega Pop event or a football game. From above you could see all the many people on the beach and in the water, not much of the landscape remained. For us it was not worth it after the exhausting arrival and departure in the rental car. Almost 5 hours driving time and then to be in such a mass event! Terrible!!!!! Oh yes, toilet 1 euro! There are countless other beautiful and idyllic beaches on Crete!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty Good & Chill
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Overall Elafonisi is a really nice beach… Nice sand, shallow and super accessible especially for kids, nice mini hike to the beach…However I will say that there aren’t many services there. There is a quaint little bar on the beach front with a few drinks and ice cream and W/Cs that you have to pay a Euro to use but other than that there isn’t much.It is a really nice place though. Like I said, it’s a chill low effort beach to relax on but due to the lack of services isn’t very long.There is a mini market, restaurant and more up the dirt road away from the beach towards the car park but it is quite a trek from A to B. We also got really confused as there is a parking lot for €5 next to a more obscure parking lot for €3 and got a bit confused as to where to go and whether we were getting scammed or not.Still recommend it but wouldn’t say to put too high expectations on it because it’s quite a travel from major spots on the island like Chania or Heraklion (also is just a bit ummm… odd)Nice place, just not much there!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Don't go to Elafonissi if you would like to have good day!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Parking lots were full, beach full of people, sun bed receipt checks in every hour, no toilets etc.... we left this place after two hours and next beach Falassarna was 5/5!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parking lot rip-off but picturesque beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The one about the parking lot folders that make the impression of official people is probably a permanent problem. We got caught too and we were waved out on the first dirt track (the guy was standing in the middle of the road) and maneuvered into the last corner. I was really annoyed by this! With the 5€ parking fee we not only had the most expensive parking, but also the longest walk to the beach. As we drove away again we saw that many cars parked right on the main road for free.The stand itself is already picturesque and was not as crowded in October as already reported. We also had the impression that everyone was following the rules.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Don't bother
reviewsWithKeywords.text: No pink beach showing even in the sunshine, you are then told you have to be on the island to see the pink beach but the island is almost an 45 minute walk...we travelled 4 hours to see this beach. Parking is a total rip off, you are guided into what you think is a genuine car parking space only to find they lock the car park once full and then charge €5 to get out of the car park even though you are only there an hour, it's not even worth a coach trip unless you are guaranteed you can be there if the tide is out on the island and the sun is shining in the right direction....this is an honest review as we hired a car for a week to drive 400 miles one way to visit this beach , we parked up and left 40 minutes later as no pink beach was on show!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not so pink anymore.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice place to sunbathe and swim.  Very crowded on the site and annoying vsg there. Not much pink sand left. All the pictures you see are bad. I'm sorry.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pink sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I love this place , although I find access to paid parking unacceptable before we could park for free near the beach . On the other hand I wanted to point out that I saw a group filling bags with pink sands and leaving quietly with about twenty kilos it is scandalous if it continues like this in a few years there will be no pink sands I told a Greek who told me that nobody cares , and that there was a cave where everyone broke stalactites, result closed cave.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No pink sand what so ever.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely no pink sand in sight! A Nice sallow sandy beach but not worth a 2 hour drive each way and I wish I hadn’t wasted a day on this

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice Beach- long Access
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach, the sand and the water are perfect. They have chairs for rent but when we arrive they were all busy. The worth thing is the access to the beach is to long walk Take in mind the sand is only pink in some small partes

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is so beautiful and well maintained. We enjoyed the sun and clear water but it does get crowded in the afternoon when its streaming with visitors. Otherwise, it is a stunning place to visit in Crete and unwind for a couple of hours.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisi beach is gorgeous!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Gorgeous beach, everyone visits and it gets crowded, go early  to get a spot. I recommend walking past where all the beach chairs are set up and you can experience a more serene version of the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cute beach but gets busy...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We got there before 10 and it wasn't overly busy yet!! .. Yes we paid 5 euro to park but we were the first car park close to the entrance so I don't mind.Also used the little food vending shop for a coffee and the toilet both were perfect.. The beach itself had tints of pink but that is it.. Loved padding in the crystal clear water and walking over to the other island.. Ice cold beer on the beach went down a treat (5 euro) BUT it does get busy, people just pop there towel down anywhere so close to one another. Walking around can become a little challenging when it's busy as no-one wants to step on anyone.. We left before 1 and was pleased we did.. it does become super busy.. People  just keep coming and coming  lol!! Do get there early to enjoy it!! Glad I went but there won't be a re-visit!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parkingmaffia Elafonisi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When you go to elafonisi DO NOT use first parking . Do not sort to the right. Just ride further to parking 2 3 4 or 5They are all 3 euro a day .Parkingplace 1 is 5 euro ( even for 1 hour)If you sort right the force you in their parking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Defintely a tourist trap - Avoid!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was looking forward to enjoying my time at Elafonissi Beach and was highly disappointed.I knew it could be busy. So, I visited it in October and arrived after 4.00pm on a cloudy day.First, it is quite isolated. So, wherever you are based in Crete, it will take at least 1.5 hour to drive there, on winding roads.When I arrived, I was invited to park on designated parking places. Mine was 15 min away from the beach. 5 euros.Then I went to the beach; it was Disneyland! Myriads (literally hundreds of people) coming back from the beach in the other direction. Souvenir shops, supermarkets, etc.The beach: a little bit of pink sand and some turquoise (and quite warm, even in October) water. I collected some business cards left on the sand to make sure they do not go to the sea. A pair of briefs laying on the pathway. If you need to go to the toilets, it is one Euro.There are many other beaches in Crete that are more beautiful and relaxing. This one is far too much overrated but it seems to be a big local business.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A real disappointment!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Not worth it, when you arrive you will be sent to a parking lot. Which you have to pay 5 euros for afterwards. Then you have to walk very far to the beach where a lot of people walk. There's nothing to see. I don't know if they say it's one of the most beautiful beaches in Crete. Have seen much nicer beaches

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the best beaches in Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach Pure Turquoise WaterThis beach is known for its pink sand, but in fact the sand is not as pink as the images on the Internet.  Also pink color of sand depends on weather and lighting But the water is really chic, big, shallow lagoons, perfect for kids. The beach is crowded, come early Then you can guarantee a parking spot, and pick a nice spot on the beach. From the parking lot to the beach walk +/- 700mThere are sun loungers and cafes where you can eat One minus, it was very windy.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Victim of its success
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An enchanting place certainly, pink sand also... But far too many people and between paid parking lots, tour buses, souvenir shops: it spoils a little fun Fortunately I went there on my own taking the time to go along the coast from kissamos The ride is part of the adventure

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The paradise of Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The photos do not make the colors of this magnificent beach. Sand of the shoreline of a beautiful pink color. The absence of hotel facilities make it uncontaminated. A trip to this beautiful beach should not be missed by those who go to Crete.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Somewhat overrated.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The water colour is beautiful but the pink sand is hard to find. Beware of the parking sharks who do not display their fee when you approach the beach. You are also parked quite a distance from the beach. Coming from Australia, this beach would be middle rank. Not worth the long drive.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unfortunately to avoid
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is of course a very nice beach and the water is turquoise. But there are so many people that you can't see the pink sand. It has become an extreme commercial machine and the ridge has even more beautiful places. Do not take the first parking lot. It requires you to go home but they are more expensive and further away. It is a mafia behavior but accepted here in elafonissi.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, but busy.Please note that upon arrival they will try to send you into a parking lot. Don't do this!!Plenty of parking space down the road and a lot cheaper

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: There is very little pink left, the photos on the net are retouched, clean water and nice beach but in my opinion the lagoon of Balos is much more beautiful especially if you come from above going down the mountain

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Probably the most photoshopped beach in the world!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I’m not really a beach person as I’m not a sunbather and I tend to get bored quite easily, but having said that Elafonissi Beach is a stunning beach - even with 3 million people strewn across it! Okay, this might be a slight exaggeration, but prepare yourself for a LOT of people vying for a spot to cremate themselves.Most people tend to congregate around the area where the beds and umbrellas are rented out, but if you wander away from the masses you’ll be rewarded with tranquility and beautiful views. The beach isn’t really a swathe of pinkness either - it’s more a teasing glimpse of pink sand here and there along the coastline. I think it’s a fair assumption to say that quite a few pics are photoshopped or enhanced with filters. It’s still worth visiting, but rein in your expectations!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty but don’t need to come back
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were blown away by the number of people at the beach. Coach loads started arriving at breakfast time and it was crowded. It is (was once) a beautiful beach but as always, humans have spoilt it. There is pink sand visible but it depends on the weather and amount of sunshine. We won’t bother coming back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach but if you’re going for the pink sand, you will be greatly disappointed. There’s a little here and there but not much left from people taking it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very overrated in my opinion, in Sardinia there is definitely better! Pink was nowhere near present in the meantime. Bottoms really too shallow you have to go a long way in the water to have water waist height. Valet parking that force you to stop at the first parking lot that costs 5 euros (the most expensive) and you have to do a lot of walking! It's all right that you have to live but this is really thieves! Anyway nice water!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Scammers aloud to operate in the National Park!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Was scammed at the 1st Parking as they blocked the road and made as think that the parking near to the beach is closed, had to pay to wash my car after wards! Disgusting corrupt people!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Doesn't have to be
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The not so good reviews can be easily understood, totally crowded, extremely windy, 20 euros for beach chairs and umbrella, shower is in the last corner and the toilet costs. The first dusty parking lot charges 5 euros, further down it costs only 3 euros. We didn't discover pink either. You can safely save yourself.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach- be obs on parking.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach - although you have to look for the pink sand. There is shallow and beautiful crystal clear water. You have to walk a bit to get down there - and parking costs - between 3€ and 5€. We were guided by a man in a reflex vest, who very urgently got us into their p-place. It turned out that there were other P places cheaper and closer. It cost money to drive out again from this p-place immediately. Note this.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonissi Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely beautiful beach - 2 hour drive from Chania. Crystal clear water and the best part was the water stays at waist height for as far as you can walk! It’s about a 15 min walk from the parking lot. Recommend getting there early to avoid the crowds!Must do if on the western side of Crete!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice without more
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Don't stop at the first parking lot!The guy stands in the middle of the road, arms crossed and signals you to enter the parking lot, as if we had to... 5 euros for this one while the ones after are 3 euros! It's not okay to do that kind of thing.For the beach, it is nice, the sand is beautiful but not pink as in the photos that can be seen on the internet and to reach it, it takes about 10 minutes to walk.It's not a must-see in my opinion!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Long way to a crowded place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We decided for us, it was not worth it. Unless you want to see hundreds of half-naked people. The pink of the beach is hardly to be seen, the whole area is very touristy, although you are told that you are entering an environmentally sensitive area. There is lots of waste everywhere in the bushes, tourists get driven there in coaches. As for most places in Crete the best times are before 10 and after 16 hours. There is no shade along the beach, so people bring umbrellas. Sunbeds were 20 Euros. The drive to Elafonisi over the side roads however is beautiful. The honey and oil they sell on the road are too expensive. Better buy in the villages. If you want to eat good Greek food, stop in Topolia, after you have driven through the old tunnel.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: ATTENTION TO CHEATING PARKING
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Definitely the most beautiful beach we have seen in Crete, but much traveled by tourists, so I write some tips based on our experience: PARKING Absolutely avoid the trap of the first parking lot, where an intruder tries to force you to enter his parking lot with aggressive attitude, parking that costs 5 €. Don't care, even if this guy's in the middle of the road, and keep going down the road, which is downhill. There are other parking lots for 3€ more convenient to the beach. The point beyond which you can not go is well signposted, get there, there is all the place to turn around and go back choosing comfortably which parking to choose. The one we chose also had bathrooms, better to take advantage, there is not much on the beach (stinky and for a fee). CROWDING: obviously there are a lot of people, so the sooner you get there, the better you place. We arrived at 10, and the umbrellas were already finished. It must be said cmq that the beach is very long and articulated, so a quiet place is always found, perhaps at the ends. SHADOW buy a parasol at the supermarket (they also sell them in convenience stores near parking lots), there is plenty of place to plant them. If you don't even have that, on the left of the beach, coming, there are trees, some unfenced. Or on the islet on the right, within walking distance (the water is shallow) there are rocks where you can hang towels for shade. VIVERI: I had brought everything from home. There's a bar on the beach, but I don't know what it's like. At the beginning of the walking route there are convenience stores. ON FOOT, once parked, you have to make a 10-minute walk of downhill dirt road, a path suitable for everyone. But for disabled people or those with problems, I saw a van with the wheelchair symbol. SHOWER: I saw only one, near the bathrooms, uninviting. I put two big bottles of water in the car, and I rinsed myself with them. ENJOY THIS BEAUTIFUL BEACH!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful!! 🤩 Lots of coves, pink sand. Has everything, toilets, showers and a great shop/cafe. ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb natural beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A place not to be missed. The road from Chania will offer you beautiful shots in the mountains. The beach is one of the most beautiful and clean. Upon arrival, you will find that there is no longer free parking. The closest to the trail costs $5. You are a 10-minute walk away. There are plenty of people, but enough space to find a place of your own. Pink is a little overrated. There is a dewy glow on the edge of the beach, but nothing like the photos that are circulating.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Between ELAFONISSI & Kedrodassos: que du Bonheur!! <3
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi Beach... To do! Even if it's crowded, it's no problem! Take the tenacious one! Take the European trail on your left... sneak to Kedrodassos... you will have beautiful nuggets... almost deserted that same beginning of September!:)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Well, it goes like this
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have to say it's not worth it until 5 pm .... pink hardly visible probably only around 5.30 , it was very windy, like almost daily and the sand whips you around the ears . Water was very good ,from the parking about 10 min to the beach

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, but go over to the island, THERE lies the pearl.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, but the sun bed was busy long before you reached the beach.But the real pearl was if you just went over to the other side of the bay and to the island. Then walk the little path to the other side. There was deep and beautiful where you could swim right in crystal clear water.The beach by the sunbeds was all right, the sandy beach in the middle was nice, but the beauty was hidden on the other side of the sandy beach. Just a few hundred yards from where everyone else was sitting.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Terrible.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was the horror mass bus tourists - from the far away parking lot an endless crowd of people goes to the hopelessly crowded beach - an immediate escape proves to be almost hopeless due to the oncoming traffic on the rocky and dusty goat paths- despite immediate return to the car 5€ parking fee - even for the toilet has to be paid 1€ per toilet. Terrible how this former gem has degenerated.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Get there at 8am for a couple of hours bliss
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Get there at 8am is my advice and enjoy the calmness of the beach and clear water , this means you will also get a sunbed ( 2 for €20) , bear round to the right and go on the little section by itself . I say get there at 8am as from 10 am is starts to fill up and at 11am the coaches descend and then it is no longer nice , you won't get a sunbed by then and there is no shade otherwise. Everyone trying to get photos of the tiny bit of pinkish sand on striking the poses required for Instagram! I'm glad I have been but there are much better places , not crowded .Park at the Mega Car Park , it is the nearest one . There is food and drink that is reasonable

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonissi Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach, or beaches.Very shallow. Clear water.Unfortunately, a little too many tourists, though all could fit, both in the water and on the beach.But .... saw no pink sand .... Not at all. False advertising!The road there was exciting, sometimes a little too exciting. Narrow, curvy and incredibly beautiful views.Also long walk down to the beach.Nothing too limp and limp!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice to see sometime. Come on time!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Be on time because very touristy and later in the morning it flows full and very busy. Prices for sunbeds very expensive. Nice to take nice pictures but no more than that. Most beautiful beach of 2025 I absolutely disagree.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice but...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful less pink than the various influencers show but whatever, the only flaw is the parking. Just arrived there is a valet who arms in the middle of the road stating that ahead everything is full and the road is closed, a scam nice and good! Up ahead there are at least three other parking lots with lower prices. It is not because of the price difference but on principle!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A most beautiful and stunning must see beach, but go early and ignore the parking attendant you meet first !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I gave this 5/5 purely for the beach and our experience, there were downsides but this grading is for the beach, the view and the gorgeous water. The beach is beyond stunning with the most lovely warm aqua water, and a beautiful back drop. When we were there we didn’t see any boats arrive to spoil the water or view. The downside is the parking as people have mentioned in previous reviews as you are forced to park at the car park furthest away, only to find as you walk down there are closer ones. If going here and you have infirm or lots of really young children, ignore those in the road guiding you to the first car park and drive on (you can always come back if full) There is a bit of a walk, downhill, but the view and beach are worth it. We went in August and the beaches were very very busy. We went to the far side and enjoyed silence and beautiful water all day. I am glad we went as Elefonisi along with Balos was part of the reason we chose this part of Crete. If we were to go again, and we would go again,  we would arrive earlier, aim for a closer car park and go to the far side again. I think it’s a must see if you are this side of the island :-)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Much to overflow! Two sunbeds cost 25€ and the umbrella an additional 5€. In addition, there are too many people to receive loungers at all.  After an eternally long serpentine ride, this beach is not recommended. The sand and water are beautiful but still there are so many beautiful and not so crowded beaches all over Crete!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but meh…
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Depends from where you’re coming. We came a really long way to see this beach and balos and even if it’s beautiful , it’s not worth the hourssss of driving. Pakistani scammers, 1€ to use the toilet?! You should encourage people to use it not charge for everything. The road to get there is a bit dangerous as well . Idk. Also very few sunbeds, it was windy so it was imposibile to put an umbrela up and sun is melting you

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beware of the first parking lot Pakistani scammers
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach, just don't park in the first parking. They will tell you the others are full but it's just a scam to charge you more and trick you

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Expectations exceed reality
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Surely the beach has some points where the sand takes a pink color but in others not, shallow water you walk everywhere except in some places at the bottom but unfortunately being full of people is unmanageable, despite it being September. We were also left without umbrellas because they were all full, all after paying € 5 parking at the entrance (you have to look good and not stop at the first parking lot because there were others who took € 3 for the whole day). Unfortunately like everything when it gets too sponsored you end up being disappointed by expectations. I wouldn't go back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Attention to valet parking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Arrived at the parking lots do not stop at the first, forcibly avoid the valets who try to stop you and continue, you will save yourself a nice stretch of road on foot.The beach is very nice but I recommend you go early in the morning so as to avoid the crowd.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and... Impossible
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful water, beach as well but too crowded and expensive. My advice is to pop in, two photos and look for a beach among the many beautiful of the island

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fairy place!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's one of those places you don't think exists. Magical landscape, crystal clear waters, incredible experience that is worth all to experience. The only thing I didn't like was the behavior of people in the parking lot. You're incredibly rude and act like crazy for the money. I also came across a scene where a stranger was almost beaten up. A little embarrassing...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but…
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We drove the 90 minutes from Chania and actually thought the twisty road through the mountains was very thrilling. Yes the beach is amazing…and thought there were 5 individual ones to enjoy. However we likely would not return given the drive and lack of umbrellas and loungers.Is it Number One in the World? No.  But yes worth seeing at least once.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach but very busy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is amazing & we ended up going 2x in our 10 day holiday. We hired a car there as it was only 1hr away from our hotel. As you arrive to the beach there are scammers that stand in the road saying that the main car park is closed when it’s not just drive round them or say your going to the shop down the road & you can get through so you can park closer to the beach (€5) for the whole day cash or card. There are 2 shops & a cafe before you start the walk down to the beach which takes about 15 mins. There are also 2 beach bars offering hot snacks, drinks etc on the beach. The first part of the beach is really really busy but if you cross the water & carry on walking it’s really quiet & your almost on your own also the snorkling is absolutely amazing in this area. As for the pink sand… you can definitely see it’s pink in the main area but there isn’t as much of it as you see in the pics on Google but again once you walk further it does get a bit pinker. Would definitely recommend a trip here as it’s absolutely beautiful but go early to beat the rush. We got there for 9.30am the second time we went & it was already starting to get a bit busy but as I said is you walk an extra 15 mins there are hardly any people.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning Elafonisi 😎😘
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Well worth the two hour drive through the mountains (which is an event on its own!) A stunningly beautiful place, take time to wade over the lagoon and explore the left hand side of the peninsula and it's pink sandy and rocky areas. It's so lovely here 😎

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Spectacular beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were there on a bus excursion, 2 hours of travel, but once we arrived, we were enchanted by so much beauty. Immense beach of white sand and in some stretches with pink shades, the sea looks like a pool, definitely one of the most beautiful we have seen. In the first stretch there are a series of umbrellas and deckchairs with 2 kiosks, but personally too exploited and crowded, a shame in such a natural paradise.  Crossing a small and shallow (about 50 cm maximum) stretch of sea you reach an islet where a long stretch of beach begins, less frequented, without services, with a succession of spectacular coves with incredible colors of the sea and beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Advertised but no longer worth so much
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It has become completely commercial and due to the exploitation and crowd it has unfortunately lost the glamour that it had a few years ago.. a lot of walking for nothing.. tip: don't get into the 1st parking lot that is more expensive, it has more down and cheaper and closer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wicked Wicked Wicked
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I'm so sorry about this place that's so beautiful and you can't have access if you don't pay the parking bastards who block you from everywhere. So many people I'd never do it again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach visit Elafonissi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Were back in Elafonissi after over 15 years and are totally disappointed as it is completely overrun. You used to be able to drive to the beach by car, now you have to go down in the heat for 15 minutes and pay for the parking. Also the prices for the loungers are already very considerable and must be reserved in advance, otherwise you will not get one. Shade places are almost nonexistent.Beach is nice, but to avoid in the mass tourism (peak season).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overflowing and overrated – once is enough
reviewsWithKeywords.text: As with many hyped social media places, this beach turned out to be a typical tourist trap. As soon as you arrive, it begins with the well-known parking history. Tip: Just drive past the first parking angles – there are still plenty of parking spaces closer to the beach further ahead. One of them costs only 3 euros, then you reach the beach with a short walk.On the beach itself, there is crowding. I explained it to my partner as a Swiss: “It’s like the Street Parade in Zurich.” Those who expect beach romance, tranquillity, security for their valuables or sufficient shade will be disappointed. Although there are chairs and umbrellas, they are paid and too few anyway – almost like on Rimini beach.The only really worth seeing is the sandy tongue, on which you can walk far out into the sea. Everything else is more like an illusion. For example, the color pink. The only pink I saw in the sand were the thousands and thousands of tourist feet. Stop your stupid filters.We accepted four hours of driving and four hours of walking back for this trip – a second time we would certainly not do that. There are plenty of beaches, not only in Crete.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Top
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches / pools in the world, we were astonished, offers equipped beaches and two kiosks for the supply of sandwiches

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, disappointing parking experience
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is gorgeous like others say, don’t expect the Instagram pink but the water is as blue as it looks in pictures. We arrived at 10:30 and the beach was so full of people it was hard to find a place to put our towel down. There is also no shade anywhere! When you enter the beach area there is a car park on the right and has an attendant that tells you to go in and when you say you want to keep going he shows a sign that the road is closed. This is a scam as there are 3 more car parks with lots of spaces after and they cost less. Drive by the first attendant if you want to save a bit and park closer. The attendant was also very rude to us when we pointed out that there are cheaper car parks closer to the beach as we had read previous reviews, he started shouting at us. There are plenty of shops for food, drinks, souvenirs, also toilets that cost €1 everywhere and changing cabins. The water is shallow so perfect for kids too. Overall really enjoyed it but the parking situation was a bit of a let down.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, it is sure that the place is paradisiacal, crystal clear and warm waters but unfortunately too many people who spoil the decor a little. A quota wouldn't be too bad. Watch out for parking, we are forced to stop as far away as is most expensive! Say no to people in the parking lot and go closer to pay less and walk less

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointment with local beach management behaviour
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is undoubtedly beautiful! Too bad every year is worse as no one enforces or controls compliance with the rules especially the protection of the beach park. Yes, compared to the past they have fenced with stakes and ropes the unique natural areas. Unfortunately, the uncivilized people on the rise come in and lay their towels eating and bivouacing inside these nature reserves and nobody says anything. Then another sore note often in some bars and rentals sunbeds "does not go credit card" and arrive tour operators with cash in hand to take and rissrvare dozens of beds for the arrival later 'of their guests by bus. That's not cool. If that's playing by the rules? One gets the impression that they don t want tourists only to live off rent tourism for the whole year! Too bad that another top natural location is endangered by human cause! Emblematic is the writing that no one in over 10 years has ever eliminated that appears in the shower area 🤔 Elafonisi gone

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Don’t bother
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We left Agia port with KYRIAKAKIS travel at 8.45am. After a horrendous drive over narrow mountain roads, with enormous drops and no barriers, we eventually arrived at Elanfonissi beach at 12.15pm. To then have a 30 min walk down a stone hill in the hot sun, to find not one bit of shade or a bed, which if you could get one was €30 to Inc umbrella and 2 beds, and a couple of small snack bars. You could hardly walk for bodies everywhere. We eventually found shade behind the wooden toilets. We were promised 4hours on the beach but were only given 2hours 15min Before the long haul back up hill to the coach. Then a compulsory 1hour stop at an isolated restaurant for lunch at 4.30 pm. Which is not included in the price. Eventually getting home to Agia marina at 6.30pm. Although the beach is beautiful if it was not covered with bodies. Genuinely not worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Be careful with first parking lot. They fool you.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Be careful with the first parking lot that you find when you arrive. They fool you saying that you cannot continue and oblige you to enter their parking. It is 5€ instead of 3€ in the next ones. It is not that it is more expensive, it is the fact that it is a tourist trap. And nobody likes to feel fooled.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beware of Fake Parking Guides – Beautiful Beach Worth Visiting
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Be careful with the parking situation near this beach. A group of people tries to mislead tourists by standing in the middle of the road and insisting that you must park in the first parking lot they point to. You do not have to. If you drive just a little further, there is another official parking area for only €3, and even more parking options closer to the beach. Don’t let yourself be pressured — you have better and cheaper choices.That said, the beach itself is absolutely beautiful, wide enough for everyone to enjoy without feeling crowded. Please respect the nature around you — don’t damage the dunes and help keep this place as stunning as it is.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointing and nothing special
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand was not pink! There was fish everywhere, and despite the sand not being pink the overall beach was disappointing and nothing special. I wouldn’t waste my time here. Overcrowded and there is MUCH nicer beaches around Crete that aren’t packed. Water was quite clear though

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Comfortable and fantastic
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed there 2 times in a week as the best for families for ease of approach (10 minutes walk), fine sand and shallow, crystal clear water. We stayed in the tongue of sand accessible across the sea and on both days there was no crowding. The only problem was the wind (if you have umbrellas bring anchors). Parking closest to the sea very large at € 5 (do not stop at the first even if they tell you that the next ones are full). Also recommended for snorkeling

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No Pink Sand to be seen .
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Booking through Travel company who we came with was 60 euros each , we booked in the resort for 25 euros each , it’s called Pink Beach for its sand colour but there was no Pink Sand there at all very misleading when you have to travel 3 hours to get there , the beach was absolutely packed people practically sitting inches from you . Very disappointing going by the photos they use to advertise the Pink Sand Beach .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not as expected
reviewsWithKeywords.text: First you are forced to take the first parking space, which is of course the most expensive and farthest from the beach, although you want to drive further as there are cheaper and sufficient parking spaces closer to the beach. Then already visible at the parking lot, tourist stronghold. We at the Love Parade.The stand totally overflowed. The stand itself is beautiful. But it is not fun and in my opinion is not worth seeing. Better hit another beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Once and never again.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Completely overrated, no pink beach/shore area found.Were there at about 08.30, in front of the tourist streams.From the parking lot still about 500m to walk / crawl, not for the elderly or disabled. Expensive beds close to close,0 privacy. Not recommended, once u.never again, are gone after 30 min.Not worth it at all ,there are much nicer beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful sea in Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spectacular sea!!! , crowded beach. Paid parking lots, but don't stop at the first one you find coming (they get smart)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointment in Elafonissi!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The road to the beach is long, very mountainous and full of turns. We arrived at 10am and the beach was already crowded. It is impossible to find deckchairs, all occupied in the morning, so obligation to land directly on the sand. This wouldn’t be a problem in itself, but as it is a lagoon, the sand is constantly wet: our towels were soaked in a few minutes.The beach is beautiful, but overcrowding totally ruins the experience. We lasted barely two hours before leaving so crowded.In my opinion, this beach is not worth a visit. I recommend the Balos lagoon, much more beautiful and pleasant.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not worth it….
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s a beautiful beach - no doubt - big lagoons, crystal clear water, soft sand. But it’s not pink, there are no real amenities (limited chairs/umbrellas, one panini snack shop), a 20-30 min walk from the parking to the beach and a ZILLION people. Plus it was a pain to get there. Hard pass. There are plenty of of gorgeous beaches in Crete without all of the people, amenities etc. if you are going to go bring everything in with you - towels, chairs, drinks, food, umbrella and go early or late as it’s hard to find a spot.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the few beaches to remember in Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Probably the most beautiful beach in Crete, although not the most enjoyable due to the crowding.Accessible by car, paid parking, services such as bathrooms, showers, bars, umbrellas and sun loungers. When the sea is calm it is very nice to snorkel. In my opinion to see, by far the most beautiful beach compared to the others for which a trip to Crete would not be worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tourist place only... bad
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I had been to this beach about 20 years ago and the sand was really pink, now there is nothing left of pink, just the name probably... there were no parking lots and you reached the end of the dirt road... now large parking lots (do not stop at the first one where it says that at 100 meters the road stops because it is absolutely not true, even if they try to get in front of the car. Further on you will find a parking lot at and or 5 euros much closer.There are three establishments and by 10 am they are all fully booked. Impossible to find shaded areas, not even at the bar, all under the sun, DIY umbrellas that sell you at the beginning of the route at 10’ useless euros because there is too much wind to place them...Toilets available at a cost of 1 euro, Only a bar and little stocked. Total disappointment beyond the beautiful water.There are less touristy and definitely more beautiful places...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach most beautiful view so far, to visit absolutely. Road from Chania challenging but feasible, fully paved, ample parking. I recommend arriving before 9:30, after that time the establishments are full

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Carpet, all for profit, better go to Kedrodasos five minutes from Elafonisi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Complete blocking of trees with shade because everything is fenced.  Expensive sunbeds 20€ the set. Particularly in the first parking lot to be careful comes out the parking lot out on the road and closes the road by making the traffic and puts you his own parking lot with five euros while below he has with three euros parking lot (at least 3 parking lots). The route is about 15 minutes walk but there is so much people that it is not worth sitting and the experience is altered, we picked them up and left and went to the beach of Kedrodasos, fantastic free with a railroad without much people 5 minutes from Elafonisi.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No special beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you happen to be in the area, maybe nice to visit, but don't sit in the car/bus for hours. Especially in summer months too busy and too few facilities. You have to look carefully for the pink content in the water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Terrible
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I really don’t understand how Elafonisi Beach has gotten so much attention, for this place was a big disappointment from start to finish. First and foremost, the road is directly dangerous – narrow, curved and steep roads without proper security. It felt like a life-threatening ride just to get there, and you’re sitting all the way with your heart in your throat wondering if the car is even coming out. When you finally think you have reached a paradise beach, you are faced with the opposite.It is a long walk from the parking lot, and the road is full of sharp rocks that make it uncomfortable and tiring to get forward. You expect soft sand, but instead you have to slide into a rocky landscape that makes the whole experience heavy and turbid before you have arrived.The beach itself is a huge disappointment. It is far from a pleasant sandy beach – everywhere there are rocks that make it impossible to lie well or walk barefoot without cutting or damaging your feet. This is not a place to relax, but a struggle from start to finish.The water is shallow almost everywhere, so it is completely impossible to swim properly. One can neither swim nor enjoy in the waves, because one stands with water to the knees as far as the eye reaches. In addition, the bottom is also covered with stones that make it uncomfortable to move in the water. The whole experience feels just wasted – you travel far, struggle there, and end up standing in shallow, rocky water without the ability to swim properly.All in all, this is one of the most overrated and unpleasant places I have ever been to. I really regret that we spent time and energy going there. If you are in Crete and are reviewing Elafonisi Beach – save yourself the disappointment and drop it. There are many other places that are both safer to get to, more comfortable to be in and actually suitable for swimming. This place is simply terrible and completely wasted.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Definitely fantastic!!!Parking: there are several, the first ones you meet are the most expensive and they will tell you that the next ones are full even if it is not true, continue.Descent: About 10 minutes, in the sun but very feasible with flip-flops (sand and rocks), slope not important.Beach...wonderful!!!!!The crowd is formed where there are umbrellas for a fee (there are not many) but just walk (mostly in the shallow water so it is also pleasant!) and there are numerous perfect corners! We went to the islet and found a corner all to ourselves ... wonderful!! (arrived at 10:00)The water is crystal clear with a large very low area (perfect for children).There is a shower (at least I have seen only one I do not know if there are others), there are bathrooms and a bar.I would recommend to go early because obviously until 10 there are fewer people and it is more beautiful.... and to bring rock shoes so as not to be limited in movement. (Sand mixed with rocks)What to say.... it is a beach that you absolutely must see!!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonissi Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a disappointment...we came in 2020...there was no paid parking, we could park on the large parking near the beach...the 1st prevents you from continuing and the rate is 5 euros...while the one right after is 3 euros...if we add to that the world...the beach is still as beautiful...but everything is ruined by the rest...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful SMOKING!!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So given as the most beautiful beach of Crete see one of the most beautiful in Europe if you look at some reviews.  Well what a smokehouse!!!! We arrive and we get alpine by the first parking where it is marked that the others are complete 5€, finally the others are far from complete and as a bonus we get yelled at!!!!1km walk we arrive on the so-called most beautiful beach of Crete good if we do not want to pay 20€ of deckchair we go on rocky areas and the water is clear but pink sand hardly exists. In short an overpopulated beach far from resembling the Caribbean or even certain of the Atlantic coast. There are many other beaches in Crete more beautiful and less populated. For me it’s the beautiful tourist catch!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: superb beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Superb beach with crystal clear waters , ideal with children because shallow waters . lots of people , we went there by bus from Hersonissos but it is long 4h30 to go and we stay on site 4h for return around 9 pm to the hotel , in short tiring day but it is worth it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pipinara’s beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I have seen so many beaches in the world and I cannot say that this is number one I do not know on what basis this claim was made. Thousands and thousands of people who arrive and end up on the beach with umbrellas or towels thrown here and there. To take a bath, you have to walk 300 m of crystal clear water, but that gets to your calf. If this is the number one beach in the world, then I have seen paradises.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Really disappointed ☹️
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What a disappointment!!! We come to Elafonisi every year and were delighted until now. Unfortunately, we have noticed year after year nature has given way to massive urbanization! You have to focus to be able to see the little pink sand that remains! In addition, this place has become a real money machine! This place has lost all its charm, it's regrettable. We will not come back.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: By car, we arrived after 2.5 hours from Retimnyo; beautiful roads, apart from the last 15/20km up and down the mountain;Parking at 3/5€ but... there's everything to give them, for the place!!Excellent market (with also toilets) before going down to the beach;On August 20 there was the slaughter of people on the beach but managed to find a very quiet and shaded spot!!Super water!!!A bit of confusion of people in the 2 bars;2 two toilets on the beach at a 1€... honest, because the one used by us was kept well;Annoying air especially in the afternoonConfirmed: after 10...zero sunbeds and umbrellas free...confirmation had from gentlemen known at the beach and arrived at the beach a moment after 10

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fabulous pink beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A wonderful place. Do not dwell on the first part but go beyond the dunes .. it will open a paradise where even on the busiest days you can get a cove all to yourself.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Terrible.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Too many people, too long and rocky walks in the heat, parking facilities far from the beach that cost. Overcharged at the restaurants. SICK LOTS OF PEOPLE. Not worth it at all.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Felt like Heaven on Earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We loved our experience at this beach and it was hard to leave. It’s very large and expansive with lots of beach areas so it is easy to spread out even though there’s lots of people.The water was warm, clean, and a beautiful turquoise color.  The sand was soft in all the natural large lagoons and beach areas. The water was shallow so you can walk through all the lagoons. We saw some pretty pink sand in one area. Our boys enjoyed seeing all the little fish in one of the lagoons. As of August 2025, we paid 5 Euro to park closest to the beach and kept driving past the lots that are further and more expensive and operated by scammers according to other reviews. You have to walk down a pretty long path which isn’t too bad for adults but since we had toddlers we pushed them with our stroller then carried it to our spot at the beach. This is a must see if you’re in Crete! It’s now one of my favorite beaches of all time and would definitely come back!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and impossible
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach... to be avoided strictly in August as a destination, during the day, thousands of people who make it substantially inaccessible.The same goes for the equally beautiful sea, where it becomes difficult to find even the space to stretch out your arms and go swimming.I understand that it will be difficult to do so, because the seduction of one of the most advertised beaches in the world makes the temptation high, but my advice is: change your schedule while you are in time!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not the most beautiful beach in Crete but definitely the most (over) populated
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Road blocked about 1.5 km from the beach. You end up on foot after parking at the entrance. Be careful some feel that you park at the 1st car park which is also the furthest and most expensive (5€ whatever the time spent) while there are others a little later at 3€.Rocky path to the beach, without any indication.Beach HARCHI HARCHI CROWDED spent a certain hour. 20€ the deckchair!! 🤯In short, the beach is probably beautiful (even if we could not observe the presence of the famous pink sand - too many people - despite having settled a little secluded towards the rocks) but it is not the most beautiful. It is obviously a victim of its success which makes it a not very pleasant spot. We had the chance to discover other little unknown but absolutely charming beaches with very few people even in broad daylight. So clearly we didn’t like Elafonissi or Felasarna (also crowded) which were advertised as the most beautiful beaches of Crete. To flee, but really, at least in high season and during the day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: In power it might be wonderful, but in August it's the Bathers' Round of Hell.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want to see this beach, do it at different times from August. As soon as we arrive, an unauthorized valet leads us into a parking lot charging 5€; we find out soon after that closer to the sea the parking lots are empty and cost only 3€. After being ripped off, we go down to the beach under the scorching sun for about 800 meters to the beach, literally stormed by sea and land. Sunbeds occupied I think since dawn, toilets for a fee at 1€, a sandwich and drinks kiosk and above all a billion people everywhere, crowded into every single square meter of beach. We go around, hoping for a remote corner, pick up our things and get back in the car. Not before pointing out to the abusive valet that the SCAM deserves a penalty, but we are too tired to go through with it and we go up the road all curves that brings us home. If you're looking for mass, it's right there, in Elafonissi's pond-space.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but to do in the morning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach provided you do it from 8:30 to 11:30 because after far too many people to enjoy well the places that are Whouaaaa panorama level and turquoise water.However, regarding pink sand, wh...bof..., it is sand.It's a far cry from the edited photos on the Internet.But if we ignore the pink sand, the spot is magical.For the parking do not stop at the first or the car park guards get on the road to prevent you from passing, you have to force the way to go to the next ones.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This stunning location features a pink beach and crystal-clear turquoise waters—a true must-visit destination. The beach is pristine and meticulously maintained, possibly the most beautiful I’ve encountered in the Mediterranean. It’s an essential stop for anyone visiting Crete.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Not to be missed: Unforgettable Elafonissi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi Beach – August 2025Elafonissi is undoubtedly the most beautiful beach that my family and I visited during our holiday in Crete.The beach and the seaThe first part of the beach is reminiscent of the lagoon of Balos: shallow sea, almost closed, with colors that look like a natural pool and a picture-postcard clear water. Continuing on foot through a stretch of shallow water you reach another area, less crowded than the main but equally beautiful. Here you can walk up to completely free stretches, even in mid-August, with fine white sand, pink reflections (due to crushed shells) and crystal clear sea with incredible turquoise shades.Snorkeling and natural experienceWith mask and snorkel I had one of the most beautiful swims of my holiday: I found a remarkable variety of fish, some coral and colorful sponges. A real wonder for those who love exploring the seabed.AtmosphereBetween sand, unique colors and rocks scattered here and there, Elafonissi is a place that leaves you breathless. I would not be surprised if it was the perfect choice to spend a whole week of vacation in an accommodation nearby.Parking and practical tipsParking is not a problem, there are several. Be careful though: as soon as you arrive on the main road, some attendants try to direct you immediately to the first car park, which is also the farthest and most expensive (€5 per day). You should not stop there: going further on you will find other parking lots, closer and at 3-4 € per day. From the farthest car park it takes about 10 minutes on foot, from the nearest ones it takes 5-6 minutes. A little trick that makes the day more pleasant.ConclusionElafonissi is a unique beach, with crystal clear sea, sand that looks like velvet and unforgettable views. A must for those visiting Crete, and for me the most beautiful of the island.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but watch out for indelicate behavior
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Exceptional place for its natural beauty. It's completely worth it to even drive to see, but not really seen pink sand maybe because of the strong influence but despite it the spot is crazy.  WARNING though, at the entrance of the city men in military uniform and yellow vests block the road to tell you that it is closed to cars (which is completely false!) and forces you to park in their parking lot which is the furthest away, double the distance from the others is the biggest constraint and also the funniest still is the most expensive 5€ instead of 3€ on average (this is for the principle), so bypass them because I do not think their method is very "legal" and they have no right to do that.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No pink sand beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: No pink sand , millions of people , can’t swim because of the rocks.  Did i mention NO PINK SAND ?! blyaķ. parking workers don’t let u go to the parking lot which is only 3€ , they make u pay 5€. don’t go there , not worth it. 🙁

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Greek Caribbean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is famous for its water and expectations have not been disregarded. A beautiful aspect is the size of the beach, extremely large and spacious. Like most of Crete’s beaches, the services we are used to in Italy are a bit like that. A couple of restaurants-bars a bit ‘cobbled together, but still useful! Another thing that could bother .. the wind! It's okay that there is but when it really starts blowing it's more the sand in the air than the wind itself. It deserves of course, but arm yourself with patience to reach it on foot

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Total slaughterhouse
reviewsWithKeywords.text: On the panorama nothing to say, a paradise on earth, BUT totally ruined by FLEETS of tourists arriving every 5 seconds with overflowing cars and buses, making the beach impassable and taking away much of the beauty of the place itself. It would be one of those beaches to be designed with a limited number of entrances, with the help perhaps of more equipped beaches that, once filled, leave no room for further entrances. It is a natural landscape that must be protected and not stormed by people you know, everything is but polite. Unfortunately,

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Caos
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A heavenly place ruined by mass tourism. The only beautiful thing here is the water which is really fantastic. For the rest if you like to be piled on top of each other it is your ideal place. Rivers of tourists arriving at every minute and crowding on the free beach. I put an extra star precisely for the water and because probably arriving very early and taking an umbrella with 2 sunbeds the situation would improve but you would still have to scramble to get into the water. In August a big no I would like to visit it out of season that certainly deserves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WOW
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A true paradise with crystal clear water and glimpses of pink sand really suggestive! To fully experience the essence and nature of the place I recommend not to stop at the first beach as soon as you arrive but to cross the sea (the water is very shallow and allows you to cross the stretch without too many problems) and go to the islet of Elafonissi .. there is true paradise 😍 (bring everything you need as there is nothing on the islet). The only negative note (taking into account that we visited the beach in August) is the amount of people who crowd the beach .. really excessive .. which distorts the essence and nature of the place. A real shame! Personally I preferred other places like Balos or Falassarna, but surely for those visiting the island it is a place to visit. I recommend arriving very early in the morning for those who want to grab a sunbed and umbrella (2 sunbeds + umbrella €20).

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A beautiful place. But very busy.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi beach is one of the must-sees for tourists eager for unforgettable views. And the place really is. A few downsides though: the traffic jams before your arrival (nothing to do with the rush hours on the periph’), the very demanding parking employees and, above all, the world. The beach is crowded in August, which, it must be said, breaks the myth a little. The place must be literally heavenly host season. So, to see. But not in August.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach exit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We made the beach of elafonisi today First of all do not park at the first car park (thing I did ) 😂 it is paid 5€ whereas those just after are either 3€ or free Far too many people but beautiful beach after a lot of departure between 3pm and 4pm because of the tourist buses A beach to do without hesitation if you come to Crete and without forgetting the wind 😅

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I don't understand who writes mediocre reviews about this beach. She's wonderful! Obviously in August it is full of people but it is big and there is room for everyone. There is the bathing establishment but I did not use it. We were "on the islet" to the right of the entrance and it was amazing. Clear and transparent water, photos do not make the idea. You park for a fee and do a nice little piece on foot, uphill on the way back but it's worth it! Go absolutely if you are in Crete!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A lot of reason for nothing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Shame on the location!We arrived at 10:30 in the morning from Chania and there was no room to sit down, let alone for sunbeds.The beauty of the landscape lost in so much world, from time to time did not come bad smell (depending on the turn of the wind) ...The pink sand is mainly in front of the sun loungers which were caught early by tourists while that spot smelled strongly bush.The location is magical but when a place accepts more people than it can stand (there is no unused point of the island) its beauty is lost.I know that in August there is crowd everywhere but this situation at Elafonisi at 10.30 a.m. exceeded all expectations.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Must see place, but be careful with the parking places
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing place with the pink beach and turquoise water.. Definitely a must see place.However don't trust the guys at the parking place which is the most far to the beach. They are cheating people by charging more than all one other closest parking places and tell everyone there is no place close to the beach.They are definitely thieves.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unique in the world!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I am a lover of clean sea and beautiful beaches, I think I have seen enough beaches in the various trips, I have always headed for crystal clear waters and beaches defined as very beautiful! But I can say that Elafonissi is absolutely the most beautiful beach I have ever seen in my life! There is no photo that does it justice! An immense expanse of crystal clear water in a succession of beaches and dunes that take your breath away! Saying she's beautiful for me is simplistic! I got to see it both crowded and semi deserted and certainly when there are so many crowds it loses some of its charm but the spectacular water remains unchanged as well as the context that is unique in the world! There are two small equipped establishments and two small kiosks very well stocked, rent umbrellas at 20 € but you have to arrive in the morning around 8.30 (at least in August), alternatively the free beach is really wide and in several directions and offers space for everyone! During this trip I dedicated a day to each beach, for Elafonissi I was not enough three days, I would have returned a thousand and a thousand times just to enjoy a unique and wonderful show!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Skip the trip if you are expecting magical.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was expecting beautiful pink sand. It wasn’t pink. It was, however, very crowded. We arrived at 11  and there were no chairs available for rent. It was difficult to find a spot that was clear enough to put out a few towels and an umbrella. The walk to the beach in the heat was also not pleasant. It felt like quite a long walk from the parking lot. Also note that there is a charge for the use of the bathroom. Sections of the beach were also quite rocky. There were a few positives. The water is quite shallow so perfect for small children. It was also warm and quite clear in August. There was easy access to food and drinks and I found the prices to be reasonable. Needless to say I did not love this beach but perhaps if you arrive very early or during off peak times it is worth a visit if you have small children.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We're still looking for pink sand...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The different parking lots are easy to access (prices vary between 3 and 5 euros depending on the parking lot)... I advise you not to stop at the first car park but to advance as much as possible, because there is a little walk from the car parks to the sea! A beautiful beach with TURQUOISE, TRANSPARENT and HOT water! A real happiness, like a lagoon:) ON THE OTHER HAND, pink sand non-existent... A bar/grocery store is located on the beach in case of need! And a 1 euro toilet on the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Never seen such a busy beach!!! Absurd!!! At noon not even room for towel on the sand
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Never seen so many people together!we knew it would be busy, but this..... We got there at 8:30 and in time for a parasol. By 9 o'clock it was already running for a parasol and by 9.30 they were all up. More and more people came until at some point there was no room for even a towel on the sand. The parasol landlord estimated the number of visitors at 10,000 to 12000.  It is called the "pink " beach, but there was nothing pink to see. Maximum depth seawater knee-hip height, no more. Ideal for children though.  Without people it will be nice, in February maybe.....we were gone soon!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Really really beautiful and a snorkeling paradise. However, go sooner or later because you walk over the people in high season.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: SCENIC BEAUTY NOT SUBSTANTIAL
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Scenically beautiful, but in fact the beach is narrow, especially the right side.The sand is flat, a sign that it is often wet. The waters are shallow, but also warm, so you do not even feel cool except under the umbrella or some trees near the beach or along the way. Vera the review on parking: they block you at the first without having the authority, and then there are at least 3 closer and at a cost of 3 euros instead of 5.The avenue leading to the beach is about 1 km long or slightly more, wide, with a slight slope.There is a van that offers a ride to people with mobility difficulties.I much prefer Falassarna, with long, wide and sandy beach, beautiful sea and cool waters.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice place, but not as perfect as expected
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was really excited to visit Elafonissi after hearing so much about the pink sand and clear waters. The beach is indeed beautiful, but the pink color is much lighter than the photos online, so don’t expect it to be bright pink everywhere. When I arrived, it was already very crowded, even in the morning, and it felt a bit too busy to fully enjoy. The water is shallow and great for kids, but not ideal if you like swimming in deeper areas. Facilities are basic and quite far to walk if you need anything. Overall, it’s a nice spot to see once, but not as magical as the pictures suggest.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful day at the beach ⛱️
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, although quite crowded. Not much left of the "pink" sand that gives it its name. Nevertheless, it is a great beach to spend a day at.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A unique beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A unique beach of its kind. A kind of big lagoon with warm, crystal clear water. A lot of people but also a lot of space. The beach is clean and well maintained. Perhaps the most beautiful I have seen in the Mediterranean. It is a must-see for visitors to Crete

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Please don't waste your time !
reviewsWithKeywords.text: After looking at the beautiful pictures and great reviews , we drove over two hours to give it a go.  What a disappointment . Far too may people , a beach you cannot swim in , no shade or facilities to buy bottles of water. Steer clear - only one positive was the restaurant near to the beach as you are walking back to the parking - gorgeous views. Should have had lunch and left !

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Definitely worth visiting, but in May/June!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The road to Chania isn't much. I recommend a car with automatic transmission. No organized buses. To kissamos you travel well, then you have to cross the mountains. It is not complicated but not even very easy between hairpin bends and narrows. Once you arrive, along the road to the beach you will find parking lots: the first is the most expensive: 5€/day, the second 3€/day, the last is free. The valets will try to convince you to come in; dodge them and go ahead, otherwise run them over. If you find the nearest ones full, go back... you'll find a place. Once you have parked your car, a 10-15 min walk between shops and markets awaits you. The beach is equipped with two kiosks and several umbrellas for a fee. If you arrive too late you risk not finding them free. My advice is to equip yourself with an umbrella. The beach is huge and is almost all free. Don't expect to see the beach in postcard!! that you will find maybe in May... in August it is supercrowded, but not for this you will not appreciate the clear water, shallow and the view. To swim you will have to walk a little. You can definitely have a nice day. The sand is loamy... suitable for sand castles, but annoying to take out of clothes. Make sure, before you go, his weather that the wind... gusts above 20km/h are annoying and will make you go away. Beach kiosks sell sandwiches/ pizzas and drinks at fair prices. There are changing showers and free toilets

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice, though.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went there today. After 160 km of winding roads and a very high expectation, unfortunately I was not repaid. It is certainly very beautiful and characteristic, but the huge turnout greatly limits its value. In the first stretch the water is shallow and if you want to swim you have to go offshore or on the left side.  To catch anything at the few beach bars, you have to queue up huge. Surely in low season its charm is more valued

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This once beautiful please screaming SOS
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I've been there after 12 years, and all I can say is that this place is destroyed. Nothing reminds the old beauty of Elafonisi. Greedy crooks raped the place for some b$cks. Kids making castles destroying the once pink sand but no one cares as long as the mini market sells the bottle of water at 1€.Some dirty , broken sunbeds at hilarious cost and thousands of people squeezing for a place, leaving behind garbage and dirt.STOP THIS now. Put a low visitor limit per day, rise the entrance price and protect the place by demotivating masses to come . It will probably take another 10 years to return (if still exists)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Evaluate well
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach must be beautiful... empty. Tip: come very soon. And if you can't come anytime soon, don't come at all. Every corner of the beach is covered with umbrellas and towels and there are so many people that the water is not even clear, except far from the shore. We took a bath to cool off and see the water further out and then left. However, it can be a good alternative for families: easily accessible, shallow water for a long distance, some fish.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach but very quickly crowded (9:30 10 am)So full that at 12 o'clock it was overcrowded and we left. Come very early if you want a deckchair.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisis
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach of white sand and crystal clear water, accessible from a nearby parking lot at 5 euros!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unfair competition on Parking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When you arrive with your car in the area the first thing you notice is a guy in the street, outside the first parking lot, to make sense that below is all occupied and to direct you to his one that is also the most expensive (5€ when all the others have 3€).  Do not pay attention, go ahead and pay cheaper as it has countless parking spaces!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: how to ruin the ecosystem of this place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: ..... I look forward to reading today's reviews, if any..... they talk about free parking.... actually there are several parking lots and arriving in the area , a man with a reflective vest and a traffic policeman’s shovel (in reality he has no labels , nor ‘signs of recognition), diverts you to the first parking that costs €5.00.at which point you continue on foot on an asphalted road where you discover that there are other parking lots much closer to the sea and also at a cost of €3.00. At the end of the paved road , after stalls and bars , the fairly easy dirt road begins .that takes you to the beach.09.45.... what no one warns you about is that the sunbeds and umbrellas of the equipped beach are already finished,(it was enough that the owners of the shops at the end of the asphalt were in contact with the beach managers)would have given the possibility to pigs like us to buy at least the umbrella. So, without an umbrella, we chose to leave the famous beach of Elafonisi and leave, we certainly could not stay under the sun or even under a plant and even less without drinking or eating for a day, because the nearest bar, is at the top of the dirt road .Okay, it's not a suitable place for everyone.... as we left, we encountered queues of motorists pouring in and many buses full of people.
