It is true that the beach is large, but we would not have beached like seals. I am now attaching a film and I kindly ask you to tell me , if you have visualised some pink sand as they say

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mixed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach visually with crystal clear water but several negatives: access to the beach difficult on foot, low water temperature and lots of wind which makes swimming unpleasant, no pink sand as sold and deckchairs very difficult to get.Mixed experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Watch out for the first parking on the right
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful, the first time we came as a couple 10 years ago, now with 7 year old. Strong wind but always beautiful. We noticed a lot more people.Attention there is the first parking lot on the right with a road sign closed at 100 meters. He is the only one who takes 5 euros a day, the others only 3 euros. It's not a clean job!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nothing special
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach with huge people, very windy and sea with cold water. It doesn't pay for the trip. There are other beaches in Crete less famous and more pleasant.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A spectacle of nature
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach I've ever seen .. the water is transparent and always shallow, and in some stretches the sand is pink (there is a prohibition to collect it!)... and although after 10.00 there may be a risk of being very crowded, the space in the sea is so much, that this is absolutely no problem ... There are paid parking lots, at 5 and 3 euros, and then on foot you walk for about ten minutes an unpaved path. It is worth it, because then you have the opportunity to admire a simply wonderful landscape, a true spectacle of nature...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: the beach where nothing is pink ..
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What to say about this so-called pink beach .. well it is not pink ... except a few pink reflections in places the photos on the net are faked ... filters added to deceive the tourist. just like what happens on arrival .. they force your hand to park on the farthest and most expensive parking under the pretext of a closed road .. which is not ... below the parking is 3 euros .. once the way to the beach is a huge disappointment. the turquoise blue of the sea and lagoon fades in front of the crowded beach ... one on top of the other and if you find a free deckchair you will have the feet of the neighbor on your head and you can participate in the conversation of the neighbor. even read his magazine ...only positive point the translucent water ... In summary flee ....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: To start with the fact that you park in the parking lot very far from the beach and walk in the capsule at least 15 minutes until you arrive.We arrived at 9 in the morning and it was all very beautiful!But even there because even at that time we didn't find a sun lounge...We had an umbrella but with the incredible air there was NO umbrella standing so you either burn or leave.After 12 I don't talk about it.Concluding...very beautiful place where you don't go to take a bath is very shallow but to see all this beauty ONLY early in the morning!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Despite a high number of visitors, a beautiful beach!We arrived in the middle of the afternoon in the tourist season, the beach was overloaded. However, if you cross the ford across the island (the water reaches at most the height of a small adult, but beware of the current if you are passing with a child), the attendance is much more correct.The water is crystal clear, the slope very gentle (don’t think about swimming unless you’re going very far)Parking: we followed the advice of the reviews on the site.  A shoe agent tries to point you to a parking lot from the beginning of the access, with a sign “road cut”.Do not believe it and continue (he will try the argument of authority but ignore), a parking is much closer and huge.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tourist magnet
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Great beach..but would not consider it to be the most beautiful in the world in 2025, as it has been said to be.We arrived early departed we thought, but when we were there a little before 11 there was stack full of everything. No free sunbeds and some maurtue. Little pink sand again, but it popped up here and there. Fresh and clear water. Possible for surfing etc. large parts are very longground, so lovely for children.Clearly the place has become a tourist machine, and one must have expectations thereafter. But okay to have been there. The road to Ellafonisi from Chania is OK. New road here and there and some turns down the last part, but drive with reason, then it goes fine.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonissi Beach in August
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is beautiful there is no doubt about it. But it is way too crowded. We got there at 9.30 and not a single sunbed free and all the sand spots were quickly getting filled up with people. The water is stunning. Crystal blue and yes some of the sand is pink. We stayed for 3 hours and left. Too many people so not relaxing. But glad we went and got to see it. My advice is: get there for 8.30am, stay for a few hours then make your way to somewhere else for a more peaceful afternoon. Bring some water and a few snacks of your own. Oh and  a sturdy umbrella as it is windy! 1euro to use toilet.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice attention to the first parking lots
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Ideal for children, clean and very crowded, preferable in the afternoon, avoid the first car parks present more expensive and far away, you can go further, pay attention to the directions of valets who mislead

reviewsWithKeywords.title: By all means don't go!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It could really be a little less rosy. Yes, the water is crystal clear *just like so many places on Crete), but the pink sand you really have to look for with the number of people brought in by busloads. It's even worse than Scheveningen and Lloret de Mar combined on a sunny day. If you don’t go organized, the people who offer parking places extort you, by pretending that the road ahead is broken...tip...just drive on. Then the people who rent out the beds and umbrellas (+/- 150 ) are king in the land of One Eye, where all tourists (+/- 2000) are the blind. If all the parasols are taken and you still want a bed without a parasol, only to share shade (what you need there, you don't want to catch skin cancer), you'll just be reprimanded for not paying for a parasol. It's just outrageous.I would say, especially DO NOT go!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A fun excursion with crystal clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is very shallow so it's perfect for kids in that regard. The water is crystal clear.There are some sunbeds and umbrellas to rent, but they are rented out really fast so be there early or prepare to bring your own umbrella. A word of causion, it is windy there so quite a few struggled to keep their umbrellas up.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Avoid! there are better, less crowded beaches elsewhere
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Having read all the guidebooks and looked at tours that said this is the best beach on Crete, we drove from Chania to find the most crowded beach we've ever seen on the island. People trying to get you into car parks, the 10-15 min walk to the beach, not a square inch to sit anywhere let alone finding a sunbed to rent.  So we crowded under a tree for five minutes of shade before returning to the car.  Didn't even put our toes in the water!  People were still streaming in as we left, with coaches still arriving to join the rows of other parked coaches. I don't know when all the beautiful photos of the beach were taken without the people, but they don't look like the ones we took!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: UNACCEPTABLE PARKING
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is wonderful, but not in the summer months! We visited it in August and we did not sit for an hour because there was too much people and you couldn't take a bath! The three stars are pure only for nature! Attention the first parking place you will encounter stops and tells you that it does not go further down with the result that you park there and pay 5€ go further down there is parking closer with 3€.. you are unacceptable!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tourist beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long to round the road. You must be on the beach before 08:30 to get a sunbath. The first bus stop from Chania arrives at 0845. Get full soon after that. Incredibly many people out over the day. Difficult to find sleeping on the beach with cloth. Every square meter on small islands is busy with people with cloth and toys. Violent tourist pressure

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Very nice beach, but come early!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is beautiful! The waters are crystal clear and there is a strip of pink sand on the edge. After seeing all the beaches of Crete, except Balos, she is clearly in the top!Come before 10am to avoid the large crowds and plan to walk one end in the water to access the other side, with less people! Watch the wind for umbrellas too!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: We shouldn't have gone!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: From Xania 1h30 of winding road. Arrivals in Efalonisi agents "force" you to park your vehicle in the first car park at 5€ (scandalous).  Other car parks closer to the beach are accessible at 3€.  From the parking lot to the beach take good shoes, the path is scabrous for 10-15min. Arriving at the beach, we did not find pink sand (what a scam).  Reentered in the water, impossible to swim, there are only rocks and very little water.  There is only one small place where the beach is suitable (fine sand and water without rocks).   Don't go!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Great site on arrival early
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived around 9:30 and we had room to find a place on this sublime beach. The first car park is 3€ on arrival and the second 5€ (closer to the beach)The descent is quiet without anything complicated. This beach is sublime with heavenly lagoons. Do not hesitate to go behind the island where there are fewer people and the pink beaches are just as beautiful. The place is at the end of the world but it would be a shame to miss this exceptional site

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A little disappointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beach quite far from parking lots. Also favor the nearest car parks because they are cheaper even if agents will invite you to go to the first car parks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A THOUSAND TIMES LATE IN THE AFTERNOON - IT WOULD BE GOOD IF THE CITY BANNED KITE SURF IN THE WORLD
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Looking for advice on visiting the beach, we found that most recommend either a very early morning visit (9am) or late in the afternoon (17:00) to avoid the crowd. Because we started from the old house that is just over 1 hour away, we decided not to be bothered by waking up too early in the morning with the fear that we might not find a sun lounge again. We arrived at the beach at 17.45. We were fully justified!  We found comfortable parking (not to mention that unlike what we read, the first parking costs 3€ and the last "mega parking" located 20 meters below 5€), no heat at the 15-minute descent. Also, most people were leaving at that time, we obviously didn’t need sun loungers (not even sunscreen), fantastic colors in the sky and on the beach (threatening photos ..), comfortable sailing in the lagoon and comfortable bathing in all places, we enjoy the sunset and went up to the parking lot at 20.30 with coolness. For us (a family with 3 children - the youngest 3 years old) it would have made no sense to be there early in the heat. We suggest you do if you want a first bath on your nearby beach and enjoy the redness as later as possible. The sun goes down across and the beach has light until very late. Only negative of the beach: two idiots with kite surf who considered their right to cross the passes in the lagoon with speed among the boys who wept, apparently considering that they are so "experts" that they would avoid the accident. The extra positive is that we found a comfortable table to eat in the village on the return, since most had already finished their dinner when we arrived.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Fast stop
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It is definitely a beauty of nature, one of those to see .. But then you realize that it is a lagoon where you can not swim because it is low, crowded beach with people stopped to take selfies or to "steal" the sand as if it were a souvenir. No refreshment points on the beach, a few sectors equipped with sun loungers attached to each other. Given the rough and long road, you should arrive early, enjoy a couple of hours of natural beauty and then go away to other equally beautiful destinations

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice place to see.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, very nice to put down your towel or rent an umbrella and a sun lounger.Pink sand is present; the color is due to micro shell fragments of the same color. The water is transparent and swimming can be done in peace especially with young children because of the shallow depth of the water.A tip: go there at the end of the day to avoid the flood of tourists arriving by coach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pink sand beaches
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Access by curvy car and once parked there are several places to eat and buy drinks. We previously booked. The descent to the beach is about 10 minutes approx. Beaches with crystal clear and warm waters, nice, fine sand. A great experience.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Cretan adventures
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach and sea are very nice. The scenery is stunning. We got there at 8.30 and had we wanted to we could have got sun beds and an umbrella for 20euros. By 9.30 these had all gone. The crowds of people can be a pain but the area is great.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Avoid high season
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Overrated,  overcrowded, windy and very little beach facilities.If you are lucky you can rent a sunbed and an umbrella.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: HORRIBLE
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Front We should not recommend looking for pink sand but not found before going to tale that it was seen a penne,The only thing I liked was the water

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A dream
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful, magnificent, there are no words to describe it. The photos do not make the beauty of this beach. I recommend going before 10.00 to find umbrella and 2 deck chairs cost 20,00 €. In addition there are 2 kiosks to eat , toilets at 1.00€ , showers free and changing rooms to change. Parking from 3 to 5,00€. Route to get to the beach quiet, 5/6 min walk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Only a little pink
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is very nice indeed.  But get there very early (by 9:00) to be sure to get a parasol beach lounger spot. The water is clear and clean and there are beach side cafes. It gets very busy, and the famous pink sand is really quite restricted to the area where the waves break on the shore. The road to the beach from Chania is quite hairy, with some very narrow places and a single lane tunnel. Take it slowly and it will be fine. Worth the trip, but the pictures of bright pink beaches are exaggerated.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Superb pink beach with clear water that looks like a pool
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The most beautiful beach I have seen, really beautiful , protected area where you can walk from one island to another without sinking, downside is that it is quite crowded

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Perfect water for kids, but she wants you to have an umbrella. Because the tourists from 9 have closed them. A little cold sea

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonissi with Klados Travels
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We traveled with Klados Travel from Rethymnon to Elafonissi Beach. We were four adults. The bus came precisely. The driver drove safely and the guide provided useful information. On your way to the beach you will see a lot of nature on Crete. The beach is fantastic! The water is clear and clean. There were a lot of people there, but it's a big place, so there was no problem. The water is colder than in Rethymnon. It takes some time to walk from the bus and down to the beach and further to the island, especially when it is very hot. If you are all out on the island you need about 20 minutes back to the bus, partly in the upper hill in the sun. The information says you get five hours on the beach. But we got four and a half. I asked the guide why we had less time than the information. She said that she did not know what it said in the brochure, and that this was the normal departure time for the bus. Klados should either change the time of the return, or change the information. The bus was back in Rethymnon half an hour early.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A little disappointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Don't stop at the first car park because they try to block you when there are parking lots closer to the beach and cheaper 15 minutes walk quite strenuous Sunbeds and umbrellas at 20 euros at availability Absence of catering with a few bars with prepackaged sandwiches Crowd always present with thousands of people always on the move They were waiting for us far from sin

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Big disappointment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A complete waste of a day trip. We drove there, a man stood in the middle of the road in a high vis waving us into a car park. Walking closer to the beach, there are other car parks for €3. It's a complete tourist trap, even if you need the loo there's a charge, €2 to spend a penny!!! Once you eventually get to the beach, it's just people everywhere. Every inch of sand covered with people. All sun beds were full, you can buy an umbrella for €1 but ours flipped inside out and broke pretty much instantly. We didn't see any pink sand. Yes the sea is clear, but so many other beaches in Crete are just as beautiful.  I spoke to our hotel receptionist who said Elafanisi is best if you get there before 10 and only some small parts of the beach has the pink sand. Don't bother with this one.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parking disaster and money making beach beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful but at the very beginning the road is closed by a parking guide to direct you to the parking lot which costs 5 euros although further down and closer to the beach parking is cheaper This is real money-making and a real pity just drive past those and use the cheaper parking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: DO NOT STOP AT THE 1ST PARKING LOT
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful but don’t stop at the first parking lot people in the parking lot will make you believe in yellow vest that the road is blocked, so yes it is blocked but 600m away there is a parking further away at the same price. They are simply trying to force you to pay theirs further (already the beach is already far away)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: More than a beautiful beach...🤩
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful site because it is much more than a beach. Water colours and paradisiacal surroundings, friendly and accessible restaurants ...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Where to park
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Watch out for parking! I recommend you not to stop at the first parking lot where there will be a person in the middle of the road who will make you understand that the road is closed and that you are obliged to turn right.... actually he is letting you enter his parking lot at a cost of 5 € and 20 minutes walk to get to the beach, when immediately after there will be more parking lots at a cost of 3 € which are also closer to the sea. The beach is beautiful and worth visiting

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach. A must on you go to Crete. Come early before the afternoon wind sets in. First avoid the parking lot and ignore the parking attendants who try to force you into expensive parking. Drive on closer to the beach and take cheaper parking. Bring food and plenty of water because in July it is 32-37 degrees Celsius. Don’t forget sunscreen as the wind doesn’t make it feel so warm and sunny.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Attention to parking
reviewsWithKeywords.text: WARNING: As soon as you arrive, employees in vest are thrown out of the parking lot in the middle of the road and make sense to get into the parking lot. Do not do it has lower parking with less money and closer to the beach. Long distance from the parking lot. About 15 minutes on foot and quite tiring the journey in the heat. The day I went there was plenty of air and there was no umbrella. Nevertheless, the beach was nice, shallow and clear waters.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The sea is very clear, wonderful and clean, but you must be careful and not swim in the depths.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sea is very clear, wonderful and clean, but you must be careful and not swim in the depths.😍🥰🥰😍😍😍😍😘😘😘🌹🌹🌹🌹

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach even though it is not so pink anymore.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful nature area. Beautiful shallow beach. Come before 9:00, then the sunbeds are available. 20 euros for two beds and an umbrella. Otherwise there is plenty of room for blankets and a small cafe on the beach. Is not so pink anymore, but it can be seen. It is still a very beautiful beach and definitely worth a visit. Family with 2 children aged 11 and 15.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, ruined due to the excessive number of tourists; in areas where the water is shallow it becomes cloudy and loses its transparency. Entries should be restricted to safeguard nature and beauty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's a beautiful beach, on which we agree. Everything else is wrong. I had been there 8 years ago in broad daylight and unfortunately the quiet, peaceful, a little wild side is no longer present at all.A lot of people (outdated 9h vs will all be like sardines ), not enough deckchairs so forced to buy an umbrella with an infant of course! (the information was given late otherwise we would have organized upstream) difficulty finding a place to bask so much we were all on top of each other. Luckily my son was happy to see the fish and pink sand...  Caution because at the moment we reach 40 degrees: caps/hat and sunscreen galore on an island where there is no corner of shade!Anyway, I certainly wouldn't go back. Everything has changed and it's a shame...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: That's not what it used to be...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was first on this beach 8 years ago it was sublime wild calm. Today if you are not at 9:00 this beach has no interest. It has become a seaside resort with more than 5,000 people per day with only 180 umbrellas. Not a corner of shade. If you have children at a young age it is absolutely necessary to protect them from the sun. Of course you will have shops to buy umbrellas and a supermaket filled like never before. It’s a beach to see but it has lost all its charm... What a pity.

First and foremost the water is beautiful clear and that lovely turquoise that makes you just want to stay in the waters for ever....now for the rest of the experience.  Tourists everywhere...packed from inch to inch so if you want a peaceful getaway and dont like the sardine experience maybe give it a miss in the peak season.  As for parking...a word of warning if you plan to drive there.  As you cannot park near the actual beach and need to treck down to the water be mindful of the pseudo parking attendants in high viz vests that wave you into the first parking.  Its the furthest away and they charge you 5 euro for the parking.  As you walk further down there is parking for 3 euro and even further down you can park for free if you purchase something from a local establishment. A little bit cheeky to be waived into a parking spot thinking that its the only option only to find there are others.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: too overcrowded to enjoy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: i don't recommend. it's already so extremely overcrowded at 10 am & too windy for the sun umbrella. the beach is not pink at all.the beach is beautiful still, but we simply didn't enjoy our stay due to the factors mentioned previously. if you go by car, be careful: don't be fooled by the man standing telling you the road ahead is closed and leading you to a parking lot! it's a scam. just drive straight ahead to "megapark", it's 5€ per day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Waste
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you are looking for crowds, scams,no shade,high prices and bad restaurants, congrads you found it..  also the road in is one way and narrow and in bad shape.. any beach in Crete is better then this one.. its a waste of a day..

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tourist trap
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Tourist trap. Yes - the beach is nice, but with several thousand (dry I claim) tourists and locals you can see nothing but umbrellas that stand out from the beach. Parking guards fight and discuss. We came by bicycle, which made it easier to find parking than those struggling with cars. The water was clear and nice to the left of the beach too, although you did not get the idyllic beach there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unforgettable day. Beautiful beach. Clean sea. If you arrive early enough you can also rent sunbeds and umbrella. Two sunbeds 10€ . Also the cost of parking is not excessive. 5€/day, 3€/day for motorcycles. The road to reach it is quite winding, but when you arrive the spectacle of nature that appears to you is worth the trip!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Arrive early if you want an umbrella! Very nice as a beach. Top amenities!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I arrived by bus from Chania (departure at 9 am and arrival at 10.40 am. Cost of 22€ return) There is a nice 15-minute walk to do on foot. I recommend arriving early to be sure to find an umbrella!Arrived in the beach the first section of umbrellas was already all occupied, going to the right you will find two other parts with umbrellas.Even the second was full, continuing to walk you will find (the third the outermost) where there were still umbrellas but in zero two ended. I paid 20€ last row with two deckchairs.The bathroom has a cost of 1€ (you can also pay with the ATM) but they are really very clean. Instead the shower is free. Bar with honest prices. 1€ water, beer 3/4€, gin and tonic 6€ and magnum 4€.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Absolutely did not live up to the recommendations. My advice, steer away.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The first thing that meets us is a parking guard who stands in the middle of the road and guides us into the first parking lot. He's giving a signal that we can't move on. We park the car and walk out of the parking lot just to discover three parking spaces below which were more affordable than the first one. Then we get to a supermarket where dozens of buses empty out tourists to then go in line 1 km to the beach. The beach itself was beautiful with many fine colors in the water, large lagoon with a beach that surrounded it and high mountains in the background. But with several hundred bathing guests, there were just too many people and it became more a visit to a recommended tourist spot to be crossed off. Very sharp stones on the right side seemed surely better on the beach that separates the lagoon from the sea. There was also a national park there, but it did not come up. Should you go here and have a nice experience go outside the high season or maybe very early or very late in the day. Crete has much more to offer on this which was very commercial for our taste.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wonderful Elafonissi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Definitely the beach and the most beautiful sea of Crete . Don't stop in the bay but cross it and go to the beach that is beyond the bay (the real beach)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Over-touristic and expensive beach. Travel another place
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Overcrowded beach, expensive parking and curved narrow road down to the beach, calculate about 15 min walk in queue. Expensive sunbeds and very much wind blowing sand in the face, access road beach is poorly organized so that tourists have begun to create their own shortcuts that struggle down nature and the surrounding area. About 1.5 hour drive from Chania each way. Drive away

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach, we had a lovely time here.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Visited with my 2 children, age 15 and 7 year old and we had a lovely time. This beach is absolutely beautiful and we really enjoyed relaxing in the water and looking for fish and sea life around the rocks.Things that may be helpful - there are toilets just before the entrance to the beach and these were 1 euro to use. There isn’t much shade so take a sun umbrella or beach tent, but be careful as it can get quite windy and I actually witnessed a sun umbrella flying across the beach and hitting several people in its path whilst I was there! There is a cafe and shop located near the car park where you can buy hot/cold food and drinks. The little shop also sells beach items, including umbrellas so don’t worry if you forget something. The shop also sell sun creams, towels, and many other items. I purchased a bottle of sprite, a cappuccino and a Cornetto and it cost me around £8 euro which I didn’t think was bad. I didn’t use the cafe as it was too expensive. There are also several little huts scattered around the main beach area for getting changed, I also saw a larger disabled hut near the entrance. Another important thing to mention is the path that leads from the car park down to the beach. This is a gravel bath and a slight hill so going down isn’t bad, but coming back up in the mid day sun was quite challenging as there isn’t much shade. It takes about 5-10 mins to get down to the beach and anyone with mobility issues would more than likely struggle, so please keep this in mind when planning your trip here. All in all I would definitely recommend visiting if you’re in Crete and I do hope to come back with my family in the future. Thanks for reading and enjoy if you do visit this wonderful place. 😊

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Wow
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Fantastic beach, the sea a pool.... shame the wind very annoying!One of the most beautiful beaches on the island, easily accessible from the many on-site parking lots (don’t stop at the first one but continue to the next, in addition to being closer they are also cheaper!)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: WHAT A DISAPPOINTMENT
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long trip to visit this beach, arrived it seemed to be in Rimini😱😱. Nothing to say at a glance, quite the contrary. Maybe going there in other months is the solution. As soon as you arrive a valet literally throws himself under your car to let you into his parking lot. Don't stop, go further. Leaving the car it seems to be a Dante group.😱😱😱. Hordes of people with umbrellas, chairs etc. etc. walking to the beach and returning from the beach which will be at least 800 meters from the parking lot. All under a terrible sun. Once you arrive you will find many people in the water. The beach was pink but only for the large number of people. In summary; it is not worth going there waiting for who knows. In other seasons it is definitely a spectacle.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Unique, less beautiful than Balos, but still crazy.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's very good if you can go in the evening and early morning.Otherwise forget, too many people.Moving to the island in front, this is where you will see the pink sand with the sunset.I liked it less than Balos Bay. But still, it's a unique, privileged place.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach with crystal clear water
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach with crystal clear water, although the pinkish tone has faded slightly over time. The atmosphere is calm and inviting, perfect for a relaxed day. In the small café on the beach you can buy snacks and drinks.

Avoid Getting Scammed!Do not park at the first car park you see. The staff there often make it seem like the road ahead is closed – it’s not! That car park is the most expensive and also the farthest from the beach.As for the beach itself, it’s absolutely stunning, but more scenic than practical. It can get quite windy, and there’s very little shade. If you plan to spend the day there, try to arrive before 9 AM to grab a spot with a sun umbrella.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisi beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Was there today. The truth is I was quite disappointed. There is a long walk to the beach (at least 15 minutes). It is quite challenging in the heat. For some reason the parking place is far from the beach. In addition-it was very very crowded. I guess I should have arrived earlier, cause I couldn't find a sunbed. I think it's better to arrive at 9 am. Oh and the pink sand exists only in certain areas, you have to look for it. To sum up-I guess it's a must, it's true that the beach is  impressive with all the lagunas but it's crowded now in July, it takes a walk in the sun  to get there and the pink sand is relatively minimal.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise on Earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach crystal clear water unforgettable pink sand, if you are in those parts is a must, if you do not go to see it you can not understand its beauty

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: To get to the beach we had to make a 2.5 hour drive, but it was worth it! Beautiful pristine beach, beautiful and crystal clear sea, worth the trip! Some tips: bring umbrella and high protection sunscreen. Being in the water often risks getting sunburned. There are some umbrellas for a fee, but they sell out immediately in the morning; do not stop at the first parking lot, but get to the last before the walk that takes us to the sea, with 5 € you can leave the car all day.  You will not be disappointed!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but very early arrival a must
reviewsWithKeywords.text: If you want to experience the beauty of this spot, go very early. We were there before 9am, got a sun bed first row in the small middle area , beautiful view and quieter. We got two hours to experience the beauty, walk to the small beach behind the little island and snorkel before it got very very busy from 11am onwards. Stayed another few hours people watching and were happy we went.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Heavenly!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi beach is a real paradise. There is always room because it is vast. So no problem if you arrive late. Parking lots are different with lots of space. Just pay attention to the first parking lot you will find on the street. They get smart and they stop you and make you think everything's busy afterwards. The cost of the ticket is 5 euros all day. There are further ahead, closer to the beach other parking always at 5 euros or even 3 euros. When we went we realized they were free. So, go to Elafonissi because it's a dream, no problem of any kind. Only attention the first valet. Don't stop at once intimidated by the fact that they point you to stop. Go on ahead. You will find other car parks closer or at the usual price or even less.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A paradise on earth
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach of Elafonissi is a real wonder. It is easy to access and very spacious. Despite the people, by the hundreds, the beach is really huge and you do not suffer the crowd effect, this at least in July. There are various kiosks on the beach where you can buy drinks or food and go to the bathroom. The water is a wonder like all of Crete, but the very conformation of the beach is the specialty that makes it unique.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Caribbean beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The glance is spectacular, the colors are breathtaking. Clean and transparent water. Too bad the beach is dirty, full of garbage and cigarette butts. Unfortunately, people are often uncivilized. And the lifeguards don't give a damn the beach is full of tourists, all the time. That's too bad.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Among the most beautiful in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: One of the most beautiful beaches ever seen in my life.It is a mixture of a lagoon, sandy sea and coves with rocks.I recommend you go either in the morning by 10 or in the early afternoon when several already leave.The beach is great and there is room for everyone, do a few meters and you will find yourself practically alone.Free showers and affordable bars.Parking at 3 euros.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful! But, avoid the first parking lot you see :)
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very beautiful beach! Worth checking out, even with how touristy it is. Just get there early! A quick side note: AVOID the first parking lot that you see. It is slightly more expensive than the closer lots, and the way they operate is pretty shady. They wave you in with a bright vest, making it look like it’s the only way you can go. This is wrong! The next lots always have space, are cheaper, and are much closer.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Scam parking Elafonissi beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach! But don’t stop at the first parking lot – they lie about the road being closed! Keep driving, there are cheaper and closer options ahead. They are scammers.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: amazing beach!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach spectacular and one of the best in the world. It’s definitely the best one we found in Greece. The sand is soft and not pebbles like many beaches in Greece. The water was warm and so clear. The sand is slightly pink rich was pretty. It’s very busy in the summer so be ready for the crowds. There is a canteen on the beach with food and drinks. There is also a market at the top of the hill to buy drinks, ice cream and sandwiches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Mooi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach but extremely busy. You have to look for the pink sand because there is minimal. You walk / scramble for 10 to 15 minutes on the paths and stones so it is not accessible to everyone. Definitely worth a visit but wouldn't stay there too long.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The place to go
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi is the beach not to be missed. The road to get there is narrow and winding, but absolutely practicable. There are 3 car parks, do not stop at the first one you meet, for the same price (€5) you can leave the car closest to the beach. I also recommend bringing umbrella, backpack (preferably waterproof) skip the baths and bathers who stop in the most "touristy", take a walk and cross the lagoon to find the Earthly Paradise. You won't regret it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisi Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach. Until there though. A lot of walking in the heat from the parking spaces to the beach. Forecast for disabled people in terms of access??? A municipal car that according to the driver does not concern all disabled people but only those with motor problems. That's how he's fucked. Those who do not have a motor problem and have 80% disability certified by KEPA I am sorry but you painted it. Good luck to you. To remove from the car of the Municipality the symbol of the disabled and put something else better. Whatever you think. Let's not be fooled at all. It’s a shame because some of us blacken the true image of the hospitality and heartfelt Cretan that we have known to this day.  To exploit the tourist I don't say. To charge him to park, to charge him to sit in an umbrella, to charge him to go to the wc (1€). But don't forget the human factor. So that he won't forget about us sometime... And whoever understood understood.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Caribbean Sea
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Caribbean beach worthwhile, easy to reach , parking present. 10 minute walk downhill but worth it. Beaches equipped with sunbeds and umbrellas, bars

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Watch out for the sunbed guy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is really nice but the sunbed guy is a scammer. He asked for 30 euros for 2 sunbeds and said he will be back with the receipt, but he never did. Later we saw that the price for 2 sunbeds is 20 euros.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very suggestive and particular beach, shallow and clear sea, beautiful landscape and you can glimpse a little pink sand. You park your car and make a very simple route of about 10 minutes walk. In the parking area there is a large supermarket. On the beach there is a kiosk with very honest prices. Unfortunately, we had a bit of a windy day (I don’t know if this is always the case) so it was a bit difficult to keep the umbrella open. Around 11am, in June, the beach started to get a bit crowded but still livable.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisi Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful and rustic beach, different from many in Europe, as it is sandy. Sea water looks like a swimming pool, very clear and calm. And with lots of fish (p who likes snorkeling). We only saw 2 points that rent loungers and tents (20 euros 1 tent and 2 loungers). There is no food/drink to sell on the beach, only on the way. Beach well full, if it is c children go early or late in the afternoon, because there are no shadows / trees and take tb something to eat and drink. We stopped at the first parking lot (5 euros per day), but after we walked we saw that the others were 3 (NO PARKING IN THE FIRST PARKING). It is worth seeing this paradisiacal beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Lovely beach go in the afternoon
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely beach we went about 2.30 so was not as busy but no sunbeds! We sat on the sand and was fine.The sea is shallow would recommend beach shoes as rocky getting into the sea but it clear and beautiful so can see where your treading.On arrival ignore the first car park for 5 euros keep going there are A few for 3 euros and closer ! There is a supermarket so grab drinks ice cream etc before going to the beach and there is only a small beach bar on the beach. We didn’t see any pink sand maybe wrong time of the day however was a lovely beach the drive to it was along some scary mountain roads so be warned if driving x

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Yep do it
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It’s an experience alright and swimming around this islet is a dream.   Snorkelling was fun too if not quite as good as on the south coast.   The only quibble is the sheer number of people who descend on this spot,  So pick a quiet time.  Oh and the drive is heaps of fun if you enjoy driving!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonissi Beach is absolutely stunning!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Elafonissi Beach is absolutely stunning! The sand has a beautiful pink tint that makes the whole area feel unique and magical. The water is crystal clear, and the beach was very clean and well-maintained during my visit. It’s a perfect spot for relaxing, swimming, and enjoying nature. Highly recommend!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Be aware of scammers operating at Elafonissi
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Be aware there are scammers operating at Elafonisi - visited 8th July 2025, as you drive in there is a sign saying road closure 100m ahead with people standing by the sign frantically telling drivers to turn right into there car park pointing at the sign - this is a scam which will cost you almost double to park vs the next more legit parked further down the road - when I tried to take a photo the parking assitants threatend to smash my phone absolute scum bags.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pink all the way
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A very beautiful and pleasant beach. Be prepared for a bit of a walk to reach the best spots to relax. It can get quite crowded, so the best time to arrive is early in the day. The parking area at the end is the most convenient option and costs just 5 euros for the whole day.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but what a struggle...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sea really beautiful, it is an immense swimming pool maximum 1 meters high where you can swim. In some places it is very low and is so hot that it looks like a spa.To park do not stop at the first car park even if you are told to go there, further on there are many that cost even less.To eat you will have two sandwich kiosks with honest prices.The flaws are:Lack of showers on the beachUmbrellas impossible to find given the immensity of people presentTo get there you have to do an hour of curves, climbs and descents by carTo eat there are only sandwichesThere is a walk under the sun downhill on arrival and uphill on return... but if you have a spirit of adventure, you have no problem staying on the free beach a little 'clumped and have no problem spending a day with so much salt on you, it will be a beautiful experience in a fantastic and unique place. Think of it as a tiring but very rewarding hike

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Attention, do not go to the 1st parking lot.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach, sea,and landscape definitely unique. But our experience was bad city we stopped at the 1st parking lot saying that we were not allowed to go below the 5€ charge while there were at least 4 other parking lots for 3€.Attention!!!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Horrific, absolutely avoid
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Unfortunately, Elafonissi is still touted everywhere - most beautiful beach in Europe, etc. That was perhaps 25 years ago when there were no buses going there, but we were looking for the way there with the rental car over a long gravel road. We were almost alone in the natural paradise.Now there are around 5000 people a day, worse than beaches in Thailand! Umbrella to umbrella, in front of people you can hardly see the landscape anymore!You will be greeted by Grand Parking signs! If the Cretan government does not limit access soon, there will soon be nothing left of the beauty of the lagoon, just garbage...Why not book online and limit? Why not use entrance fees and money to protect nature? Then people could still enjoy the once so idyllic place in the future!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: I don't think it's worth it.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very far from the reality of the product they promote. Crowded, with a shortage of sun loungers and little space to sit and sunbathe. Such a trip from Chania (1.40 minutes) in my humble opinion, does not justify it.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Paradise on Earth .. I come from Sardinia and I am used to the beautiful sea but I must say that this beach left me speechless .. also because it is really big. It is definitely worth a visit bearing in mind that you need to come very early if you want to find a place in the establishment. In this regard, a dispassionate tip: it is not advisable to go to the establishment because the sunbeds are very very close and especially because those who arrived later calmly stood in front with towels and umbrellas without anyone saying anything. In fact, the same staff of the plant placed umbrella and sunbed in front of the "fixed" ones. In Italy this as well as being forbidden would have resulted in a mega collective brawl.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointment
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I was very disappointed to see this place that I discovered 12 years ago. It has become very touristy with a very large number of visitors, a multitude of deckchairs, umbrellas and glitter. In addition, you are directed to a car park that turns out to be paid for when you leave. In addition it is the furthest parking at 5 euros while there are 2 closer to the beach at 3 euros. It also takes a lot of mar her to reach the beach. When I discovered this place there was a wild side and an irresistible desire to launch it. Actually agreed very very touristy and that is a shame. Good luck to those who would like to venture there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's worth it, the water looked like the Caribbean. The wind is a bit strong but I recommend going at least once if you go to Crete. The wonderful water.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful as Balos but simpler
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Al.contrario.di Balos, to the.beach of Elafunissi you can easily get there by car. Do not stop the first parking at € 5 but get to the bottom, parking very close to € 3. Beautiful beach, umbrella and 2 sunbeds, if available, at 20 € and cloister on the beach with sandwiches and more to eat cheap. Beach and sea top

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Too bad.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: From a naturalistic point of view it is definitely a wonder, dream water (in the morning at least). Too bad about everything else. Mass tourism, crowded people and rudeness, as witnessed by butts and plastic in the sand. That's a shame.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Had hoped to see it as you see in the pictures on the net
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We were there on 3/7-25 and there was almost nothing pink. Asked a guide the next day, after which he replied that the best time was in August, that I would have shown. The water is piv cold

reviewsWithKeywords.title: To avoid
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Back to Elafonissi 30 years later... the appalling damage of mass tourism: crowds piled up like sardines on the beach, cordons that do not prevent going where you want, scams of all kinds... How can one give positive notes to such a horror??... if despite this you absolutely want to go, beware of the first parking lot. They will try to get you into their car park for 5 euros, while 200 m later, closer to the beach, there is one as large for 3 euros...

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Absolutely stunning, a  must see place!!  When drive up, ignore the 1st car parks as they are a long walk away and is cheaper ones further down!.  Before setting off on the long walk down, get plenty of drinks qnd go the loo!  It's quite a walk in the heat!! But once you get down, makes it totally worth it    simply stunning !!!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful and impossible
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach and the sea are dreamy. The occupation of the beach for the amount of people present by nightmare. It certainly has its charm, but really too many people and thank goodness it was June....

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A little disappointed
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I returned to Elafonissi three years after the previous visit, and I was a little disappointed. The sea is always beautiful, turquoise in color, but there is little pink sand left of three years ago; there are far fewer umbrellas, and they fill up very early, at 9 am there are already very few free. Now it is not possible to get to the bottom with the car, you have to park 500 meters away, at a cost of € 5; there are several showers (free) and bathrooms for € 1.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach large enough, the water is shallow so warm, the sand is not as pink as in the photos, there is no shade and often wind. Be careful not to stop at the 1st parking even if you are made to believe that you can not go further it is false it is just the most expensive parking.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The most beautiful beach in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Impressively beautiful beach, perhaps one of the most beautiful I have ever been to. Parking 5€. Umbrella and 2 sunbeds 20€ . Services at nearby kiosks.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nice beach, but not at all drive the trip from Chania worth. .
reviewsWithKeywords.text: When you get to the first parking lot, there is someone who says the road is closed and shows everyone to a parking lot far away from the beach. Just drive by, it is FUSK and that costs twice as much as those that are further down to the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in Europe
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach is magnificent and very large but around 1pm it gets crowded, the crystal clear water makes the beach unmissable but the water is too shallow to stay there all day. This beach is recommended for people who want to tan

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Spectacular beach. We came at 9 am and there is gone we went for 13 to the beach next door (not equipped but beautiful). After 1 pm it gets crowded and so if you just can't go in the morning I suggest you go to the part behind the lagoon of the beach that is much less crowded.If you arrive in the morning you can also take the sunbeds. From the beach car park there is a 5-10 minute walk to the beach, but it is really worth it. If you do like us that you leave at 1pm I recommend you eat at the "Kalomirakis Tavern" very fast to serve.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Parking on arrival fraudulent
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We arrived to discover the pink beach which is beautiful but we were stopped by the thief who holds the parking at 5 € per day he told us to stop in order to park here in the end of the free places a little further away it is a shame it is more expensive than a parking in Paris and when you want to negotiate because you saw different prices a parking at 5 € another at 3 € and another further away free this insults you in Greek , the same for the toilets pay 1 € while a little further to the supermarket which are free

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A beautiful beach but in my opinion it is overrated. Visit subsequently the beach of Falassarna remained more impressed. Here many people and very few umbrellas but also little beach given the amount of visitors.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The sand was barely pink, but the water was clear and shallow. It's a popular beach, but you can find a secluded spot if you just walk farther. You can even hike to a cave and a church, but be sure to wear shoes.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonissi parking scam
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It was fun. Really cool and beautiful. Obviously a very busy place but to be expected. Arrive early if you want chairs but otherwise the beach is soooo big that there's plenty of room to just set up a towel and lay there.BUT. Please dont be fooled by the first parking. They will tell you that you cant park further but you can for cheaper and one for the same price which is also 5 euros.Tourism scam on that first parking for sure. I was very upset with them and yelled at them. Please spread the word and dont support them! Then owner was rude about it!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: For those seeking Rimini in Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Nice to see, take a picture and run away as fast as you can.It seems to be in Rimini in mid-August (and this in June), people crowding and screaming and this already in the early morning before the masses descend from the ships.There are definitely more beautiful beaches to live in CreteGreetings

reviewsWithKeywords.title: PARKING
reviewsWithKeywords.text: WARNING! do not stop in the first parking lot where with signs that make you think that ahead is all full induce you to enter .. ask you 5 euros while in the nearest one immediately after costs 3 euros .. it is not for 2 euros but for the scam way of operating . then the place is beautiful

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Choose somewhere else - thank me later
reviewsWithKeywords.text: First of all: drive all the way down to the where road closes. The parking-guides will guide you to the first parking, but that’s to far away (20 min walk min) and it’s the most expensive. It’s just a few sunbeds at the beach. So it’s not enough at all. They are also expensive (20 euro). Most important: do not travel here if it’s windy. It was 14 m wind, and it was completely chaos at the beach. The sand blowed all over in ears, eyes and bags, strollers, shoes and stuff blowed away. (Rip nature). I was here 15 years ago - it was a pearl! Now- it’s not worth it at all. To long way of walking (15 min at least), to many tourists and expensive. I will sertantly not go again.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Come early and enjoy
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach with clear water. Getting there early is a top priority.  From 11 am the beach is really crowded.  But he's Morgenstern's dream

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Go early in the morning!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach to enjoy in the early morning. We arrived at 9.30 and until 10.30 we had a great time, then the world arrived. However to see absolutely. Take umbrella (20 euros) or bring a sturdy one because with the wind there are cheap ones flying away (we saw at least 4 in the baskets because broken). We stayed all day it's worth it .Wc costs 1 euro, free showers (look for them!) . Bar to drink and eat with "reasonable" prices for the place it is.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The best beach in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: This beach was the best beach in the world and it was absolutely lovely to snorkle there. The water was crystal clear. The sunset was very nice to watch from the beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Definitely worth visiting  but don't expect what you see in the Internet
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I visited the beach with my wife on a tour from Rhethymno,  organized by local tour operator Platanos Tour. The tour was very good, in a modern bus, with guide in  English,  French and German. The beach itself really crowded, but I mean the main beach. Following the advice of our guide we crossed the shallow water (but definitely deeper than 20 cm as it was said) to the island. There, right behind the rocks, there was another beach - much less crowded, with the pink sand (again, definitely NOT that huge amount you see in the internet), but without "civilization": no umbrellas etc. to rent,  no shops. Good for us. And if you go further along the beach, there's less and less people... but less and less the pink sand, more and more rocks at the same time. Crystal clear and cool water all the way long,  fishes at hand. Beautiful place anyway. On the main beach the umbrella and two sunbeds cost 20 € (didn't use), toilet right next to the main entrance 1€, showers for free (beware of the HOT water, warmed up by the sun), small changing room for free. Parking fee 3 € according to the signs,  a number of restaurants and shops by the road.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful windy beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach, very windy, you can not keep the umbrellas open so it is better to go a little 'tanzati. Consiglio, as soon as you arrive by car do not be fooled by the first valets who indicate you to enter their parking, because further on, closer to the beach there are other parking places that cost less.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but absolutely overhyped tourist destination
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach itself is very nice, but nothing of pink/pink sand was visible far and wide. Were there very early (before the crowds arrive by coach etc.), therefore still manageable by the people (being there before 9 am pays off). In my opinion definitely an overhyped tourist destination that you can have seen once, but also missed nothing if not.Parking costs 5€ per day, walk to the beach are about 10 minutes downhill. Nice bar on site.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but too many people
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach that can be reached after a walk of about 10 minutes. I recommend visiting it early in the morning when it is not yet invaded by tourists and especially when the sea is calm because otherwise you will not see the small tongues of sand and pink sand present.From a certain time it starts filling up with people and it's chaos.Still worth a visit!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nothing exceptional
reviewsWithKeywords.text: All smoke and... Beach accessible only on foot. So those who do not walk are not optimal. There is a shuttle that takes you from the parking area near the beach but I think it is not enough. Very breezy and wind gusts force you to stay only time for a bath. I would not recommend it.😔

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth a visit
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful lagoon with turquoise waters.When you arrive in Elafonissi, you are required to access the 1st car park which costs 5 euros.Don't be fooled, continue on your way and at about 300 meters you will find parking at 3 euros.But in high season, it is possible that this parking is complete in which case you will have no choice but to pay the 5 euros parking

reviewsWithKeywords.title: The Crete tourist scam
reviewsWithKeywords.text: It's really a scam. Not only is there nothing pink about the sand, but there are crowds and not a centimeter of shade. For me, it's not a beach, it's a strip of normal, uninteresting beige sand.There are many more beautiful places to see in Crete.Do not take the 1st parking, even if 5€ is cheap, the following are 3€. There are no small savings and the feeling of being fooled is unpleasant.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Worth visiting…with reservations
reviewsWithKeywords.text: First of all, don't be fooled into parking in the first parking lot where parking guards hotly and harshly wave in cars. It is not only more expensive (5€) but also further to walk. There are more, cheaper (3€) parking spaces further down the road, also with parking attendants.…then you should expect it to be a 20 minute walk down to the beach, there is no natural shade on the beaches and the sun beds are few compared to the number of visitors.BUT I can not say other than that the place is worth visiting. Crystal clear water, white soft sand, beautiful rock formations and beautiful views.There are supermarkets by the car parks, a tavern before the walk to the beach and pay toilets.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful but crowded beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is beautiful IF there weren’t 5000 people there. The pink is hard to see but the water is shallow and very pleasant. Unless you get there at the crack of dawn, there are no chairs left. DO NOT park at the first place where the guy will jump in front of your car and say the road ends. You will pay more money to walk VERY far when there is closer parking. Complete scam and disgusting behavior. The walk to the beach from the parking area is relatively easy but long and hot. There is one small concession on the beach with drinks and sandwiches. And a very friendly clerk.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A diving in Elafonisi June 25
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went around 9:30 a.m. to 10:00 a lot of people, "guns" with vests make sense to get into their parking lot. We finally got to the biggest parking lot. From there down "forbidden". Walking about 10-15 minutes, some cut way from some rocks.Beach dream, blue waters, I dropped for a long walk until it reached the middle, but today air (we had our own umbrella, singing) at some point raised and chased the woman in the water although I had put a metal base. And cold sea and salty... Pink sand minimal on the shore We left in 2 orices, medium experience enough inconvenience 1 hour and 25 minutes from Chania to go and another so return, road 25-30 minutes straight (BOAK) 55 turns provincial.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful!! I have never seen a beach and a lagoon so beautiful!You cross the lagoon among the fish and even a Bernard the hermit!!Beach parking at more than adequate rates and enough to eat! If there is a beach to see in Crete it is without hesitation the one

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Nightmare
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A nightmare, what was a beautiful beach, turned out to be a nightmare. It's not worth taking the ride. Thank God there are many other beautiful beaches.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Good
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A bit overrated, but still a beautiful beach with crystal clear water. Sand isn’t as pink as marketed in photos, but the view is still great. Can get a bit crowded. Two sunbeds and a parasol were 20€, we payed for it in cash.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overrated, overcrowded and over priced.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Overrated, overcrowded and over priced. Don't get me wrong, it's a beautiful spot but very little pink sand. It's a kilometre hike to the beach from the car park and the guy at the first and furthest away from the beach stands in the road and guides you into his car park. Ignore him and go down as far as you can. There will be spaces. Hundreds of people and very few sunbeds at €30!!!! They even fence off the trees where you would find shade. The water is crystal clear and very shallow so good for kids. I was really looking forward to going there but was disappointed.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradisiaca........
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A natural paradise...... We immediately fell in love with this place..... sea and dream beach.... We paid 2 sunbeds and 1 umbrella 20 euro...... Parking 5 euro...... Wonderful.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Ranked among the most beautiful in the world
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Given some of the most beautiful white beaches in the world, we would like to include it among them. Habitué in June, we have seen that most of the presences stop in the great lagoon and this explains the very high turnout, but if you leave it behind and walk for about half an hour, you open white sand coves edged with pink and rocks, crystal clear water with dunes behind covered with bulbaceous trees and a lot of tranquility.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Stunning beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Hired a car and drove from Aghia Marina which took about 1 hour 15 minutes. Got there at 10.15 and it was quite busy. The sand and waters are stunning. Loads of car parking is available ranging from a price of €3 to €5 for the day. Cheaper rate is for further away from beach but only a few minute extra walk. Not many sun beds are available for hire considering how busy it gets. We took our own towels had a walk around and swim and left after about 80 minutes. Well worth a visit it’s stunning.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach easy to access.Fish can be seen at the edge of the beach.Warning: pink sand is not as present as in the photos.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beach beautiful attention to parking...
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful beach. The only negative note when you arrive at the first parking lot make you understand that it is the only one pointing to the sign "cannot park on the beach". The first parking costs 5 euros, those further ahead and therefore closer to the beach cost 3 euros. I mean, they're screwing you!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Scam for parking!!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: You are forced to take the first car park on the pretext that the others are complete and charge you more ( 5 instead of 3€). Besides, they laugh when we point out their dishonesty.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Beautiful place before the many people arrive
reviewsWithKeywords.text: A great day at Elafonisi Beach,  we travelled from Chania, by car, we made an early start and arrived at the beach at 9am, this was perfect as there were not many people there.  The cost for the sun lounger was 20 euros for 2 beds and a umberella.  We stayed furthest away from the main area, so lovely to walk around.  By 12 it was getting very busy with busses arriving.  Try and go early or later in day for the sunset.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: lovely day trip
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We stayed not far away, so we drove the beautiful coastal road to Elafonissi in the early morning, the views are fantastic. Elafonissi has soft sand and the sea in pastel shades, but when busses full of people started to arrive, we were not sorry to leave. The road back through the Topolia Gorge was interesting. We stopped at the Agia Sofia Cave, quite a climb when it's hot, and then at the amazing Komolithi formations, unique on Crete.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Overlaid
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach is certainly pretty but difficult to find a place to land unless you like to stay in full sun. Lots of people, not enough umbrellas, almost no shaded place, and especially no pink sand. I regret coming.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A great un-missable beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We hired a car to travel to Elafonisi. The car park is as described in earlier posts. There was plenty of room in the closest car park, despite much arm-waving and sign-pointing telling us it was full from the men in the yellow jackets (we arrived at about 12:15). It cost 5 euros.The beach was incredible. Yes it was busy but spread over a very large area. We walked along the beach, waded through a bit of water and found a quiet spot. Make sure you have your snorkel and mask. The water is crystal clear - the clearest I have ever seen anywhere. It's a beautiful beach and not to be missed. As well as pure white sand peppered with some pink grains,  there are intermittent rock formations where the fish hang out.I cannot comment on sun beds or umbrellas. I never go to a beach to sunbathe - why would you want to be lying on the sand when the water's that beautiful? We spent about 2 and 1/2 hours there and absolutely loved it. Some people advise to go to Falassarna instead claiming it is just as - if not more - beautiful. I disagree. Falassarna was a great beach but a class below Elafonisi.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: A paradise beach!!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: An incredible stretch of beach, with some glimpses of pink sand. This beach is a must-see if you are visiting Crete and enjoy the beaches with crystal clear water in which to lie down. We stayed there about 5 hours to enjoy all the corners of this beach which is imposing. I recommend this beach for everyone: family, friends, couple! Despite the world, the beach remains very quiet and allows to relax.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Careful parking! However wonderful place!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The 1st car park forces your hand (under excuse road bare) and displays 3 eur and pay later 5 eur. He refuses payment at the entrance and then removes the 3 eur panels and claims 5 eur at the exitThe second car park shows 3 euros! However the place is beautiful and worth a visit.  Shaded location very popular. The sun is beating!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Sardine central
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Obviously weren't expecting to see it like on TikTok etc but over crowded is a understatement !!Terrible experience extremely limited sun beds ( obviously I understand this could be for asthetcs ) and what few where there they were packed like sardines touching the next person never seen sun beds so close .Got some nice pics from near the top when you first enter that's all I would recommend really as not worth the 15 min walk to get to the beach any get fried  in the sun 3 stars was for the lovely drive through the mountains to get there .

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointing.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Many people unfortunately kittens and a mother cat of a cadaveric thinness who came to the tourists to ask for help she came to me that to do we were at 2:30 from our hotel I went to buy her 2 big chicken sandwiches that we crumbled and we united her a bowl of water she threw herself on what heart puncture you can praise beautiful places but when you see the animal misery it ruins everything

reviewsWithKeywords.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the Mediterranean
reviewsWithKeywords.text: What about it? One of the most beautiful beaches in the Mediterranean, for conformation, colors and height of the water, color of the sand, white with pink shades on the shoreline, extension.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Crowded and windy, but perfect view
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The view was perfect, but please check the weather before you go there. On our day there was very windy, the sand all over the body, hurts like needles. We were only half hour there because of that. The beach and all around is great but doesn’t worth it if you go by bus. We were by car so we can left immediately. The view from tavern was stunning (if there was less people on the beach, It would be better 🙂)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pretty but crowded
reviewsWithKeywords.text: The beach itself is very beautiful with clear, shallow water. However, it was very crowded. Sun beds were also all taken. I would recommend coming here independently on a less popular time.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Tour operated visit.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: We went expecting an experience where there was shade and cover with sufficient sun beds for the day. On arrival at around 11am the whole area was packed and we subsequently found there were no beds available. Added to this there was no shade as most of the trees are roped off. I would estimate that the temperature was well over 30c.Had we been aware of this situation before we would have bought at least one large umbrella. One thing to bear in mind is that the water is so shallow you can’t swim!!!It is very pretty with the pink sand etc but there isn’t anything else to do.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best beach in the world!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Amazing beach! Went on a day trip, which was a long day but definitely worth it! Can see why it’s has been voted best beach in the world. Went on a Saturday and didn’t feel crowded at all. Best beach I’ve ever visited and definitely worth a visit.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Amazing beach and day!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Breathtaking beach area! Rented a car in Chania and drive the 1.5 hr to this beach. Parking was 5e then there is a path down to the beach. There is also a nice snack bar which has good food, nice selection of alcoholic drinks as well as coffee. There is also a pay toilet that is clean and costs 1e. Lots of area to spread out. Shallow area was great for families. We were able to walk across the sand bar to another area of the beach which had fewer people. We were here mid May so the summer crowds were not here yet. Water was chilly but not bad. I appreciated how the beach was in its natural state, not built up with shops, etc. Very relaxing and pleasant day!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Paradise for little ones ☺️
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Realy nice place , worth the trip to the edge of island. Reccomendations1. Come in the mornin min 9-10am2. Prepare for crowed , 3. You can park realu Close to beach but you will have to walk around 5-10 min, but It’s flat so no worries4. Lots of parking so dont stop at first parking lot , first try the closest one.5. It’s really shadow water so paradise for the little ones.6. Road to REACH it is veeeeeery narrow and lots of turns 😂 good luck and be patient 🤭☺️There are bars , shower, and sun bed s if u want but IF You come late There might be none left because there is a lot of people.P.s it was not that pink as on instagram pics 😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂And It’s really wondy dont forget su screen

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Pink beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Beautiful pink beach, with blue sea. Modest prices in the kiosks and also in the parking 3€ (do not stop at the first parking)

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Best of Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Wonderful beach, only flaw there are few umbrellas, recommended to arrive before 10:00 to not stay under the scorching sun (even with cream you risk). But it's really lovely

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonisi Beach
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Very nice beach paradise! You walk and it never gets deeper! But he has a big defect walking about 1000 meters because there is no access for cars to the beach.We got tired of the sun and the kids couldn't stand it. We never found flooring. It was all full. You have to get your own umbrella. For us tourists it is not easy to have an umbrella.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: No sun bed or parasol available to rent, no shaded area on the beach. Buy a parasol at the entrance !!
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Long distance to walk from the car park to the actual beach in scorching heat. We were also tricked to get into a car park which was not the mega car park and was quite far away from the beach. No shaded area whatsoever on the beach, all the trees blocked and had a barrier to prevent people from hiding from the heat. Absolutely no parasols or sun-beds  available to rent as they were all sold out. Despite the place being beautiful I would not recommend it unless you go early morning or late afternoon also bring your own parasol, umbrella, tent or whatever  to keep out of the scorching sun. Come on cretan government invest in planting some trees on the beach or build picnic areas with shade. People can collapse and die in this kind of heat. The beach is beautiful and large enough to accommodate the amount of people there.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: This has to end.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Once it was a good thing but now it has been destroyed i.e. they have enormous fences old place not to do people camping and as an excuse for a flower that is a protected species while in reality it is in the lighthouse that you do not walk almost a person and is full and it is illegal to fenced forest land and put on parking so that people do not direct the fair things but hello to go to the loungers and hotels while they do not want part time and are forced,that all this is not called a person but a lot!

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Like a cattle market. Avoid.
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Like a cattle market, I’ve never seen a beach this packed. Be warned; car parking on the way in: the sheisters at the first car park will aggressively beckon you in, stopping you on the road and telling you that you must park with them… as tourists you blindly assume that’s the only option. Ignore it. Keep driving. Cheaper parking available further in towards the beach. I’m furious we believed them; especially as it’s about a mile walk after. The whole area was absolutely rammed; say good bye to nice photos or a pleasant day out. This is a cattle market. We weren’t even there in high season. Coach loads of tourists (there were 7 coaches there when we arrived).Avoid.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Elafonissi Beach Crete
reviewsWithKeywords.text: Lovely open beach, very family friendly, walk west along the coast and it’s a little more quiet with some nice lagoons and rock formations and a little more pink sand.  Parking is now controlled between 3 & 5 €, about a 5 minute walk to beach.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Disappointing
reviewsWithKeywords.text: So disappointing!  Been to ELAFONISSI beach a few times previously, the last time a couple of years ago.  How it has changed!  It has become a commercialised money making trap.  You used to be able to drive down to the beach and park for free.  Now there are a few car parks up on the hill.  We got hijacked by a man insisting we couldn’t go any further and directed us into his car parks.  We discovered a couple of other car parks further down the hill, charging less money.  You then set off on a walk with thousands of other tourists down to the beach.  Yes it’s a beautiful beach but it has lost its charm for me and we won’t bother coming again.  There are a few traditional tavernas serving lovely food and I do recommend these.

reviewsWithKeywords.title: Magical sunset 💫
reviewsWithKeywords.text: I visited between 7-9pm and had the most incredible experience.
