reviews.text: Probably the most beautiful beach in Crete, although not the most enjoyable due to the crowding.Accessible by car, paid parking, services such as bathrooms, showers, bars, umbrellas and sun loungers. When the sea is calm it is very nice to snorkel. In my opinion to see, by far the most beautiful beach compared to the others for which a trip to Crete would not be worth it.

reviews.title: One more thought
reviews.text: Congratulations to the organizers of the beach of Efalonissi who thought of a shuttle for the disabled, otherwise the beach would have been impossible to reach. Thank you so much!

reviews.title: Tourist place only... bad
reviews.text: I had been to this beach about 20 years ago and the sand was really pink, now there is nothing left of pink, just the name probably... there were no parking lots and you reached the end of the dirt road... now large parking lots (do not stop at the first one where it says that at 100 meters the road stops because it is absolutely not true, even if they try to get in front of the car. Further on you will find a parking lot at and or 5 euros much closer.There are three establishments and by 10 am they are all fully booked. Impossible to find shaded areas, not even at the bar, all under the sun, DIY umbrellas that sell you at the beginning of the route at 10’ useless euros because there is too much wind to place them...Toilets available at a cost of 1 euro, Only a bar and little stocked. Total disappointment beyond the beautiful water.There are less touristy and definitely more beautiful places...

reviews.title: Paradise beach
reviews.text: Beach most beautiful view so far, to visit absolutely. Road from Chania challenging but feasible, fully paved, ample parking. I recommend arriving before 9:30, after that time the establishments are full

reviews.title: Carpet, all for profit, better go to Kedrodasos five minutes from Elafonisi
reviews.text: Complete blocking of trees with shade because everything is fenced.  Expensive sunbeds 20€ the set. Particularly in the first parking lot to be careful comes out the parking lot out on the road and closes the road by making the traffic and puts you his own parking lot with five euros while below he has with three euros parking lot (at least 3 parking lots). The route is about 15 minutes walk but there is so much people that it is not worth sitting and the experience is altered, we picked them up and left and went to the beach of Kedrodasos, fantastic free with a railroad without much people 5 minutes from Elafonisi.

reviews.title: No special beach
reviews.text: If you happen to be in the area, maybe nice to visit, but don't sit in the car/bus for hours. Especially in summer months too busy and too few facilities. You have to look carefully for the pink content in the water.

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: I really don’t understand how Elafonisi Beach has gotten so much attention, for this place was a big disappointment from start to finish. First and foremost, the road is directly dangerous – narrow, curved and steep roads without proper security. It felt like a life-threatening ride just to get there, and you’re sitting all the way with your heart in your throat wondering if the car is even coming out. When you finally think you have reached a paradise beach, you are faced with the opposite.It is a long walk from the parking lot, and the road is full of sharp rocks that make it uncomfortable and tiring to get forward. You expect soft sand, but instead you have to slide into a rocky landscape that makes the whole experience heavy and turbid before you have arrived.The beach itself is a huge disappointment. It is far from a pleasant sandy beach – everywhere there are rocks that make it impossible to lie well or walk barefoot without cutting or damaging your feet. This is not a place to relax, but a struggle from start to finish.The water is shallow almost everywhere, so it is completely impossible to swim properly. One can neither swim nor enjoy in the waves, because one stands with water to the knees as far as the eye reaches. In addition, the bottom is also covered with stones that make it uncomfortable to move in the water. The whole experience feels just wasted – you travel far, struggle there, and end up standing in shallow, rocky water without the ability to swim properly.All in all, this is one of the most overrated and unpleasant places I have ever been to. I really regret that we spent time and energy going there. If you are in Crete and are reviewing Elafonisi Beach – save yourself the disappointment and drop it. There are many other places that are both safer to get to, more comfortable to be in and actually suitable for swimming. This place is simply terrible and completely wasted.

reviews.title: Wonderful!!!!
reviews.text: Definitely fantastic!!!Parking: there are several, the first ones you meet are the most expensive and they will tell you that the next ones are full even if it is not true, continue.Descent: About 10 minutes, in the sun but very feasible with flip-flops (sand and rocks), slope not important.Beach...wonderful!!!!!The crowd is formed where there are umbrellas for a fee (there are not many) but just walk (mostly in the shallow water so it is also pleasant!) and there are numerous perfect corners! We went to the islet and found a corner all to ourselves ... wonderful!! (arrived at 10:00)The water is crystal clear with a large very low area (perfect for children).There is a shower (at least I have seen only one I do not know if there are others), there are bathrooms and a bar.I would recommend to go early because obviously until 10 there are fewer people and it is more beautiful.... and to bring rock shoes so as not to be limited in movement. (Sand mixed with rocks)What to say.... it is a beach that you absolutely must see!!!!!

reviews.title: Elafonissi Beach
reviews.text: What a disappointment...we came in 2020...there was no paid parking, we could park on the large parking near the beach...the 1st prevents you from continuing and the rate is 5 euros...while the one right after is 3 euros...if we add to that the world...the beach is still as beautiful...but everything is ruined by the rest...

reviews.title: A beautiful SMOKING!!!!
reviews.text: So given as the most beautiful beach of Crete see one of the most beautiful in Europe if you look at some reviews.  Well what a smokehouse!!!! We arrive and we get alpine by the first parking where it is marked that the others are complete 5€, finally the others are far from complete and as a bonus we get yelled at!!!!1km walk we arrive on the so-called most beautiful beach of Crete good if we do not want to pay 20€ of deckchair we go on rocky areas and the water is clear but pink sand hardly exists. In short an overpopulated beach far from resembling the Caribbean or even certain of the Atlantic coast. There are many other beaches in Crete more beautiful and less populated. For me it’s the beautiful tourist catch!!!

reviews.title: superb beach
reviews.text: Superb beach with crystal clear waters , ideal with children because shallow waters . lots of people , we went there by bus from Hersonissos but it is long 4h30 to go and we stay on site 4h for return around 9 pm to the hotel , in short tiring day but it is worth it.

reviews.title: Pipinara’s beach
reviews.text: I have seen so many beaches in the world and I cannot say that this is number one I do not know on what basis this claim was made. Thousands and thousands of people who arrive and end up on the beach with umbrellas or towels thrown here and there. To take a bath, you have to walk 300 m of crystal clear water, but that gets to your calf. If this is the number one beach in the world, then I have seen paradises.

reviews.title: Really disappointed ☹️
reviews.text: What a disappointment!!! We come to Elafonisi every year and were delighted until now. Unfortunately, we have noticed year after year nature has given way to massive urbanization! You have to focus to be able to see the little pink sand that remains! In addition, this place has become a real money machine! This place has lost all its charm, it's regrettable. We will not come back.

reviews.title: Wonderful!!
reviews.text: By car, we arrived after 2.5 hours from Retimnyo; beautiful roads, apart from the last 15/20km up and down the mountain;Parking at 3/5€ but... there's everything to give them, for the place!!Excellent market (with also toilets) before going down to the beach;On August 20 there was the slaughter of people on the beach but managed to find a very quiet and shaded spot!!Super water!!!A bit of confusion of people in the 2 bars;2 two toilets on the beach at a 1€... honest, because the one used by us was kept well;Annoying air especially in the afternoonConfirmed: after 10...zero sunbeds and umbrellas free...confirmation had from gentlemen known at the beach and arrived at the beach a moment after 10

reviews.title: Fabulous pink beach
reviews.text: A wonderful place. Do not dwell on the first part but go beyond the dunes .. it will open a paradise where even on the busiest days you can get a cove all to yourself.

reviews.title: Terrible.
reviews.text: Too many people, too long and rocky walks in the heat, parking facilities far from the beach that cost. Overcharged at the restaurants. SICK LOTS OF PEOPLE. Not worth it at all.

reviews.title: Felt like Heaven on Earth
reviews.text: We loved our experience at this beach and it was hard to leave. It’s very large and expansive with lots of beach areas so it is easy to spread out even though there’s lots of people.The water was warm, clean, and a beautiful turquoise color.  The sand was soft in all the natural large lagoons and beach areas. The water was shallow so you can walk through all the lagoons. We saw some pretty pink sand in one area. Our boys enjoyed seeing all the little fish in one of the lagoons. As of August 2025, we paid 5 Euro to park closest to the beach and kept driving past the lots that are further and more expensive and operated by scammers according to other reviews. You have to walk down a pretty long path which isn’t too bad for adults but since we had toddlers we pushed them with our stroller then carried it to our spot at the beach. This is a must see if you’re in Crete! It’s now one of my favorite beaches of all time and would definitely come back!

reviews.title: Beautiful and impossible
reviews.text: Beautiful beach... to be avoided strictly in August as a destination, during the day, thousands of people who make it substantially inaccessible.The same goes for the equally beautiful sea, where it becomes difficult to find even the space to stretch out your arms and go swimming.I understand that it will be difficult to do so, because the seduction of one of the most advertised beaches in the world makes the temptation high, but my advice is: change your schedule while you are in time!

reviews.title: Not the most beautiful beach in Crete but definitely the most (over) populated
reviews.text: Road blocked about 1.5 km from the beach. You end up on foot after parking at the entrance. Be careful some feel that you park at the 1st car park which is also the furthest and most expensive (5€ whatever the time spent) while there are others a little later at 3€.Rocky path to the beach, without any indication.Beach HARCHI HARCHI CROWDED spent a certain hour. 20€ the deckchair!! 🤯In short, the beach is probably beautiful (even if we could not observe the presence of the famous pink sand - too many people - despite having settled a little secluded towards the rocks) but it is not the most beautiful. It is obviously a victim of its success which makes it a not very pleasant spot. We had the chance to discover other little unknown but absolutely charming beaches with very few people even in broad daylight. So clearly we didn’t like Elafonissi or Felasarna (also crowded) which were advertised as the most beautiful beaches of Crete. To flee, but really, at least in high season and during the day.

reviews.title: In power it might be wonderful, but in August it's the Bathers' Round of Hell.
reviews.text: If you want to see this beach, do it at different times from August. As soon as we arrive, an unauthorized valet leads us into a parking lot charging 5€; we find out soon after that closer to the sea the parking lots are empty and cost only 3€. After being ripped off, we go down to the beach under the scorching sun for about 800 meters to the beach, literally stormed by sea and land. Sunbeds occupied I think since dawn, toilets for a fee at 1€, a sandwich and drinks kiosk and above all a billion people everywhere, crowded into every single square meter of beach. We go around, hoping for a remote corner, pick up our things and get back in the car. Not before pointing out to the abusive valet that the SCAM deserves a penalty, but we are too tired to go through with it and we go up the road all curves that brings us home. If you're looking for mass, it's right there, in Elafonissi's pond-space.

reviews.title: Beautiful but to do in the morning
reviews.text: Very nice beach provided you do it from 8:30 to 11:30 because after far too many people to enjoy well the places that are Whouaaaa panorama level and turquoise water.However, regarding pink sand, wh...bof..., it is sand.It's a far cry from the edited photos on the Internet.But if we ignore the pink sand, the spot is magical.For the parking do not stop at the first or the car park guards get on the road to prevent you from passing, you have to force the way to go to the next ones.

reviews.title: Stunning!
reviews.text: This stunning location features a pink beach and crystal-clear turquoise waters—a true must-visit destination. The beach is pristine and meticulously maintained, possibly the most beautiful I’ve encountered in the Mediterranean. It’s an essential stop for anyone visiting Crete.

reviews.title: Not to be missed: Unforgettable Elafonissi
reviews.text: Elafonissi Beach – August 2025Elafonissi is undoubtedly the most beautiful beach that my family and I visited during our holiday in Crete.The beach and the seaThe first part of the beach is reminiscent of the lagoon of Balos: shallow sea, almost closed, with colors that look like a natural pool and a picture-postcard clear water. Continuing on foot through a stretch of shallow water you reach another area, less crowded than the main but equally beautiful. Here you can walk up to completely free stretches, even in mid-August, with fine white sand, pink reflections (due to crushed shells) and crystal clear sea with incredible turquoise shades.Snorkeling and natural experienceWith mask and snorkel I had one of the most beautiful swims of my holiday: I found a remarkable variety of fish, some coral and colorful sponges. A real wonder for those who love exploring the seabed.AtmosphereBetween sand, unique colors and rocks scattered here and there, Elafonissi is a place that leaves you breathless. I would not be surprised if it was the perfect choice to spend a whole week of vacation in an accommodation nearby.Parking and practical tipsParking is not a problem, there are several. Be careful though: as soon as you arrive on the main road, some attendants try to direct you immediately to the first car park, which is also the farthest and most expensive (€5 per day). You should not stop there: going further on you will find other parking lots, closer and at 3-4 € per day. From the farthest car park it takes about 10 minutes on foot, from the nearest ones it takes 5-6 minutes. A little trick that makes the day more pleasant.ConclusionElafonissi is a unique beach, with crystal clear sea, sand that looks like velvet and unforgettable views. A must for those visiting Crete, and for me the most beautiful of the island.

reviews.title: Beautiful but watch out for indelicate behavior
reviews.text: Exceptional place for its natural beauty. It's completely worth it to even drive to see, but not really seen pink sand maybe because of the strong influence but despite it the spot is crazy.  WARNING though, at the entrance of the city men in military uniform and yellow vests block the road to tell you that it is closed to cars (which is completely false!) and forces you to park in their parking lot which is the furthest away, double the distance from the others is the biggest constraint and also the funniest still is the most expensive 5€ instead of 3€ on average (this is for the principle), so bypass them because I do not think their method is very "legal" and they have no right to do that.

reviews.title: No pink sand beach
reviews.text: No pink sand , millions of people , can’t swim because of the rocks.  Did i mention NO PINK SAND ?! blyaķ. parking workers don’t let u go to the parking lot which is only 3€ , they make u pay 5€. don’t go there , not worth it. 🙁

reviews.title: Greek Caribbean
reviews.text: The beach is famous for its water and expectations have not been disregarded. A beautiful aspect is the size of the beach, extremely large and spacious. Like most of Crete’s beaches, the services we are used to in Italy are a bit like that. A couple of restaurants-bars a bit ‘cobbled together, but still useful! Another thing that could bother .. the wind! It's okay that there is but when it really starts blowing it's more the sand in the air than the wind itself. It deserves of course, but arm yourself with patience to reach it on foot

reviews.title: Total slaughterhouse
reviews.text: On the panorama nothing to say, a paradise on earth, BUT totally ruined by FLEETS of tourists arriving every 5 seconds with overflowing cars and buses, making the beach impassable and taking away much of the beauty of the place itself. It would be one of those beaches to be designed with a limited number of entrances, with the help perhaps of more equipped beaches that, once filled, leave no room for further entrances. It is a natural landscape that must be protected and not stormed by people you know, everything is but polite. Unfortunately,

reviews.title: Caos
reviews.text: A heavenly place ruined by mass tourism. The only beautiful thing here is the water which is really fantastic. For the rest if you like to be piled on top of each other it is your ideal place. Rivers of tourists arriving at every minute and crowding on the free beach. I put an extra star precisely for the water and because probably arriving very early and taking an umbrella with 2 sunbeds the situation would improve but you would still have to scramble to get into the water. In August a big no I would like to visit it out of season that certainly deserves.

reviews.title: WOW
reviews.text: A true paradise with crystal clear water and glimpses of pink sand really suggestive! To fully experience the essence and nature of the place I recommend not to stop at the first beach as soon as you arrive but to cross the sea (the water is very shallow and allows you to cross the stretch without too many problems) and go to the islet of Elafonissi .. there is true paradise 😍 (bring everything you need as there is nothing on the islet). The only negative note (taking into account that we visited the beach in August) is the amount of people who crowd the beach .. really excessive .. which distorts the essence and nature of the place. A real shame! Personally I preferred other places like Balos or Falassarna, but surely for those visiting the island it is a place to visit. I recommend arriving very early in the morning for those who want to grab a sunbed and umbrella (2 sunbeds + umbrella €20).

reviews.title: A beautiful place. But very busy.
reviews.text: Elafonissi beach is one of the must-sees for tourists eager for unforgettable views. And the place really is. A few downsides though: the traffic jams before your arrival (nothing to do with the rush hours on the periph’), the very demanding parking employees and, above all, the world. The beach is crowded in August, which, it must be said, breaks the myth a little. The place must be literally heavenly host season. So, to see. But not in August.

reviews.title: Beach exit
reviews.text: We made the beach of elafonisi today First of all do not park at the first car park (thing I did ) 😂 it is paid 5€ whereas those just after are either 3€ or free Far too many people but beautiful beach after a lot of departure between 3pm and 4pm because of the tourist buses A beach to do without hesitation if you come to Crete and without forgetting the wind 😅

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: I don't understand who writes mediocre reviews about this beach. She's wonderful! Obviously in August it is full of people but it is big and there is room for everyone. There is the bathing establishment but I did not use it. We were "on the islet" to the right of the entrance and it was amazing. Clear and transparent water, photos do not make the idea. You park for a fee and do a nice little piece on foot, uphill on the way back but it's worth it! Go absolutely if you are in Crete!

reviews.title: A lot of reason for nothing
reviews.text: Shame on the location!We arrived at 10:30 in the morning from Chania and there was no room to sit down, let alone for sunbeds.The beauty of the landscape lost in so much world, from time to time did not come bad smell (depending on the turn of the wind) ...The pink sand is mainly in front of the sun loungers which were caught early by tourists while that spot smelled strongly bush.The location is magical but when a place accepts more people than it can stand (there is no unused point of the island) its beauty is lost.I know that in August there is crowd everywhere but this situation at Elafonisi at 10.30 a.m. exceeded all expectations.

reviews.title: Must see place, but be careful with the parking places
reviews.text: Amazing place with the pink beach and turquoise water.. Definitely a must see place.However don't trust the guys at the parking place which is the most far to the beach. They are cheating people by charging more than all one other closest parking places and tell everyone there is no place close to the beach.They are definitely thieves.

reviews.title: Unique in the world!
reviews.text: I am a lover of clean sea and beautiful beaches, I think I have seen enough beaches in the various trips, I have always headed for crystal clear waters and beaches defined as very beautiful! But I can say that Elafonissi is absolutely the most beautiful beach I have ever seen in my life! There is no photo that does it justice! An immense expanse of crystal clear water in a succession of beaches and dunes that take your breath away! Saying she's beautiful for me is simplistic! I got to see it both crowded and semi deserted and certainly when there are so many crowds it loses some of its charm but the spectacular water remains unchanged as well as the context that is unique in the world! There are two small equipped establishments and two small kiosks very well stocked, rent umbrellas at 20 € but you have to arrive in the morning around 8.30 (at least in August), alternatively the free beach is really wide and in several directions and offers space for everyone! During this trip I dedicated a day to each beach, for Elafonissi I was not enough three days, I would have returned a thousand and a thousand times just to enjoy a unique and wonderful show!

reviews.title: Skip the trip if you are expecting magical.
reviews.text: I was expecting beautiful pink sand. It wasn’t pink. It was, however, very crowded. We arrived at 11  and there were no chairs available for rent. It was difficult to find a spot that was clear enough to put out a few towels and an umbrella. The walk to the beach in the heat was also not pleasant. It felt like quite a long walk from the parking lot. Also note that there is a charge for the use of the bathroom. Sections of the beach were also quite rocky. There were a few positives. The water is quite shallow so perfect for small children. It was also warm and quite clear in August. There was easy access to food and drinks and I found the prices to be reasonable. Needless to say I did not love this beach but perhaps if you arrive very early or during off peak times it is worth a visit if you have small children.

reviews.title: We're still looking for pink sand...
reviews.text: The different parking lots are easy to access (prices vary between 3 and 5 euros depending on the parking lot)... I advise you not to stop at the first car park but to advance as much as possible, because there is a little walk from the car parks to the sea! A beautiful beach with TURQUOISE, TRANSPARENT and HOT water! A real happiness, like a lagoon:) ON THE OTHER HAND, pink sand non-existent... A bar/grocery store is located on the beach in case of need! And a 1 euro toilet on the beach.

reviews.title: Never seen such a busy beach!!! Absurd!!! At noon not even room for towel on the sand
reviews.text: Never seen so many people together!we knew it would be busy, but this..... We got there at 8:30 and in time for a parasol. By 9 o'clock it was already running for a parasol and by 9.30 they were all up. More and more people came until at some point there was no room for even a towel on the sand. The parasol landlord estimated the number of visitors at 10,000 to 12000.  It is called the "pink " beach, but there was nothing pink to see. Maximum depth seawater knee-hip height, no more. Ideal for children though.  Without people it will be nice, in February maybe.....we were gone soon!!!

reviews.title: Wonderful paradise
reviews.text: Really really beautiful and a snorkeling paradise. However, go sooner or later because you walk over the people in high season.

reviews.title: SCENIC BEAUTY NOT SUBSTANTIAL
reviews.text: Scenically beautiful, but in fact the beach is narrow, especially the right side.The sand is flat, a sign that it is often wet. The waters are shallow, but also warm, so you do not even feel cool except under the umbrella or some trees near the beach or along the way. Vera the review on parking: they block you at the first without having the authority, and then there are at least 3 closer and at a cost of 3 euros instead of 5.The avenue leading to the beach is about 1 km long or slightly more, wide, with a slight slope.There is a van that offers a ride to people with mobility difficulties.I much prefer Falassarna, with long, wide and sandy beach, beautiful sea and cool waters.

reviews.title: Nice place, but not as perfect as expected
reviews.text: I was really excited to visit Elafonissi after hearing so much about the pink sand and clear waters. The beach is indeed beautiful, but the pink color is much lighter than the photos online, so don’t expect it to be bright pink everywhere. When I arrived, it was already very crowded, even in the morning, and it felt a bit too busy to fully enjoy. The water is shallow and great for kids, but not ideal if you like swimming in deeper areas. Facilities are basic and quite far to walk if you need anything. Overall, it’s a nice spot to see once, but not as magical as the pictures suggest.

reviews.title: Beautiful day at the beach ⛱️
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, although quite crowded. Not much left of the "pink" sand that gives it its name. Nevertheless, it is a great beach to spend a day at.

reviews.title: A unique beach
reviews.text: A unique beach of its kind. A kind of big lagoon with warm, crystal clear water. A lot of people but also a lot of space. The beach is clean and well maintained. Perhaps the most beautiful I have seen in the Mediterranean. It is a must-see for visitors to Crete

reviews.title: Please don't waste your time !
reviews.text: After looking at the beautiful pictures and great reviews , we drove over two hours to give it a go.  What a disappointment . Far too may people , a beach you cannot swim in , no shade or facilities to buy bottles of water. Steer clear - only one positive was the restaurant near to the beach as you are walking back to the parking - gorgeous views. Should have had lunch and left !

reviews.title: Definitely worth visiting, but in May/June!!!
reviews.text: The road to Chania isn't much. I recommend a car with automatic transmission. No organized buses. To kissamos you travel well, then you have to cross the mountains. It is not complicated but not even very easy between hairpin bends and narrows. Once you arrive, along the road to the beach you will find parking lots: the first is the most expensive: 5€/day, the second 3€/day, the last is free. The valets will try to convince you to come in; dodge them and go ahead, otherwise run them over. If you find the nearest ones full, go back... you'll find a place. Once you have parked your car, a 10-15 min walk between shops and markets awaits you. The beach is equipped with two kiosks and several umbrellas for a fee. If you arrive too late you risk not finding them free. My advice is to equip yourself with an umbrella. The beach is huge and is almost all free. Don't expect to see the beach in postcard!! that you will find maybe in May... in August it is supercrowded, but not for this you will not appreciate the clear water, shallow and the view. To swim you will have to walk a little. You can definitely have a nice day. The sand is loamy... suitable for sand castles, but annoying to take out of clothes. Make sure, before you go, his weather that the wind... gusts above 20km/h are annoying and will make you go away. Beach kiosks sell sandwiches/ pizzas and drinks at fair prices. There are changing showers and free toilets

reviews.title: Nice, though.
reviews.text: We went there today. After 160 km of winding roads and a very high expectation, unfortunately I was not repaid. It is certainly very beautiful and characteristic, but the huge turnout greatly limits its value. In the first stretch the water is shallow and if you want to swim you have to go offshore or on the left side.  To catch anything at the few beach bars, you have to queue up huge. Surely in low season its charm is more valued

reviews.title: August lime!!!
reviews.text: The place is definitely magnificent but do not go there in August! An endless crowd of people, already at 10 there is no longer a sunbed to rent. At 11 there was no place to put a towel on the beach! An absurd carpenter. They should limit access because it's unlivable.

reviews.title: This once beautiful please screaming SOS
reviews.text: I've been there after 12 years, and all I can say is that this place is destroyed. Nothing reminds the old beauty of Elafonisi. Greedy crooks raped the place for some b$cks. Kids making castles destroying the once pink sand but no one cares as long as the mini market sells the bottle of water at 1€.Some dirty , broken sunbeds at hilarious cost and thousands of people squeezing for a place, leaving behind garbage and dirt.STOP THIS now. Put a low visitor limit per day, rise the entrance price and protect the place by demotivating masses to come . It will probably take another 10 years to return (if still exists)

reviews.title: Evaluate well
reviews.text: The beach must be beautiful... empty. Tip: come very soon. And if you can't come anytime soon, don't come at all. Every corner of the beach is covered with umbrellas and towels and there are so many people that the water is not even clear, except far from the shore. We took a bath to cool off and see the water further out and then left. However, it can be a good alternative for families: easily accessible, shallow water for a long distance, some fish.

reviews.title: Beautiful but...
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but very quickly crowded (9:30 10 am)So full that at 12 o'clock it was overcrowded and we left. Come very early if you want a deckchair.

reviews.title: Elafonisis
reviews.text: Beautiful beach of white sand and crystal clear water, accessible from a nearby parking lot at 5 euros!!!

reviews.title: Unfair competition on Parking
reviews.text: When you arrive with your car in the area the first thing you notice is a guy in the street, outside the first parking lot, to make sense that below is all occupied and to direct you to his one that is also the most expensive (5€ when all the others have 3€).  Do not pay attention, go ahead and pay cheaper as it has countless parking spaces!

reviews.title: how to ruin the ecosystem of this place
reviews.text: ..... I look forward to reading today's reviews, if any..... they talk about free parking.... actually there are several parking lots and arriving in the area , a man with a reflective vest and a traffic policeman’s shovel (in reality he has no labels , nor ‘signs of recognition), diverts you to the first parking that costs €5.00.at which point you continue on foot on an asphalted road where you discover that there are other parking lots much closer to the sea and also at a cost of €3.00. At the end of the paved road , after stalls and bars , the fairly easy dirt road begins .that takes you to the beach.09.45.... what no one warns you about is that the sunbeds and umbrellas of the equipped beach are already finished,(it was enough that the owners of the shops at the end of the asphalt were in contact with the beach managers)would have given the possibility to pigs like us to buy at least the umbrella. So, without an umbrella, we chose to leave the famous beach of Elafonisi and leave, we certainly could not stay under the sun or even under a plant and even less without drinking or eating for a day, because the nearest bar, is at the top of the dirt road .Okay, it's not a suitable place for everyone.... as we left, we encountered queues of motorists pouring in and many buses full of people. It is true that the beach is large, but we would not have beached like seals. I am now attaching a film and I kindly ask you to tell me , if you have visualised some pink sand as they say

reviews.title: Mixed
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach visually with crystal clear water but several negatives: access to the beach difficult on foot, low water temperature and lots of wind which makes swimming unpleasant, no pink sand as sold and deckchairs very difficult to get.Mixed experience.

reviews.title: Watch out for the first parking on the right
reviews.text: Wonderful, the first time we came as a couple 10 years ago, now with 7 year old. Strong wind but always beautiful. We noticed a lot more people.Attention there is the first parking lot on the right with a road sign closed at 100 meters. He is the only one who takes 5 euros a day, the others only 3 euros. It's not a clean job!!

reviews.title: Nothing special
reviews.text: Beach with huge people, very windy and sea with cold water. It doesn't pay for the trip. There are other beaches in Crete less famous and more pleasant.

reviews.title: A spectacle of nature
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach I've ever seen .. the water is transparent and always shallow, and in some stretches the sand is pink (there is a prohibition to collect it!)... and although after 10.00 there may be a risk of being very crowded, the space in the sea is so much, that this is absolutely no problem ... There are paid parking lots, at 5 and 3 euros, and then on foot you walk for about ten minutes an unpaved path. It is worth it, because then you have the opportunity to admire a simply wonderful landscape, a true spectacle of nature...

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Incredible air as always throughout the island! Difficult access, full of tourists from all over the place. The photos do not correspond to reality

reviews.title: the beach where nothing is pink ..
reviews.text: What to say about this so-called pink beach .. well it is not pink ... except a few pink reflections in places the photos on the net are faked ... filters added to deceive the tourist. just like what happens on arrival .. they force your hand to park on the farthest and most expensive parking under the pretext of a closed road .. which is not ... below the parking is 3 euros .. once the way to the beach is a huge disappointment. the turquoise blue of the sea and lagoon fades in front of the crowded beach ... one on top of the other and if you find a free deckchair you will have the feet of the neighbor on your head and you can participate in the conversation of the neighbor. even read his magazine ...only positive point the translucent water ... In summary flee ....

reviews.title: Beautiful beach!
reviews.text: To start with the fact that you park in the parking lot very far from the beach and walk in the capsule at least 15 minutes until you arrive.We arrived at 9 in the morning and it was all very beautiful!But even there because even at that time we didn't find a sun lounge...We had an umbrella but with the incredible air there was NO umbrella standing so you either burn or leave.After 12 I don't talk about it.Concluding...very beautiful place where you don't go to take a bath is very shallow but to see all this beauty ONLY early in the morning!

reviews.title: Superb
reviews.text: Despite a high number of visitors, a beautiful beach!We arrived in the middle of the afternoon in the tourist season, the beach was overloaded. However, if you cross the ford across the island (the water reaches at most the height of a small adult, but beware of the current if you are passing with a child), the attendance is much more correct.The water is crystal clear, the slope very gentle (don’t think about swimming unless you’re going very far)Parking: we followed the advice of the reviews on the site.  A shoe agent tries to point you to a parking lot from the beginning of the access, with a sign “road cut”.Do not believe it and continue (he will try the argument of authority but ignore), a parking is much closer and huge.

reviews.title: Tourist magnet
reviews.text: Great beach..but would not consider it to be the most beautiful in the world in 2025, as it has been said to be.We arrived early departed we thought, but when we were there a little before 11 there was stack full of everything. No free sunbeds and some maurtue. Little pink sand again, but it popped up here and there. Fresh and clear water. Possible for surfing etc. large parts are very longground, so lovely for children.Clearly the place has become a tourist machine, and one must have expectations thereafter. But okay to have been there. The road to Ellafonisi from Chania is OK. New road here and there and some turns down the last part, but drive with reason, then it goes fine.

reviews.title: Elafonissi Beach in August
reviews.text: It is beautiful there is no doubt about it. But it is way too crowded. We got there at 9.30 and not a single sunbed free and all the sand spots were quickly getting filled up with people. The water is stunning. Crystal blue and yes some of the sand is pink. We stayed for 3 hours and left. Too many people so not relaxing. But glad we went and got to see it. My advice is: get there for 8.30am, stay for a few hours then make your way to somewhere else for a more peaceful afternoon. Bring some water and a few snacks of your own. Oh and  a sturdy umbrella as it is windy! 1euro to use toilet.

reviews.title: Lost ring at elafonisi beach
reviews.text: I lost my ring at elafonisi beach last Wednesday . It is a sliver ring with a blue center stone and two white stones on the side. It was my godmothers gift for my graduation and has a lot of sentimental value as she passed way last may. I really hope if anyone finds it they can contact me or send it to me I’ll pay them!! Thank you for your help 🙏🏻😭

reviews.title: Nice attention to the first parking lots
reviews.text: Ideal for children, clean and very crowded, preferable in the afternoon, avoid the first car parks present more expensive and far away, you can go further, pay attention to the directions of valets who mislead

reviews.title: By all means don't go!
reviews.text: It could really be a little less rosy. Yes, the water is crystal clear *just like so many places on Crete), but the pink sand you really have to look for with the number of people brought in by busloads. It's even worse than Scheveningen and Lloret de Mar combined on a sunny day. If you don’t go organized, the people who offer parking places extort you, by pretending that the road ahead is broken...tip...just drive on. Then the people who rent out the beds and umbrellas (+/- 150 ) are king in the land of One Eye, where all tourists (+/- 2000) are the blind. If all the parasols are taken and you still want a bed without a parasol, only to share shade (what you need there, you don't want to catch skin cancer), you'll just be reprimanded for not paying for a parasol. It's just outrageous.I would say, especially DO NOT go!

reviews.title: A fun excursion with crystal clear water
reviews.text: The beach is very shallow so it's perfect for kids in that regard. The water is crystal clear.There are some sunbeds and umbrellas to rent, but they are rented out really fast so be there early or prepare to bring your own umbrella. A word of causion, it is windy there so quite a few struggled to keep their umbrellas up.

reviews.title: Avoid! there are better, less crowded beaches elsewhere
reviews.text: Having read all the guidebooks and looked at tours that said this is the best beach on Crete, we drove from Chania to find the most crowded beach we've ever seen on the island. People trying to get you into car parks, the 10-15 min walk to the beach, not a square inch to sit anywhere let alone finding a sunbed to rent.  So we crowded under a tree for five minutes of shade before returning to the car.  Didn't even put our toes in the water!  People were still streaming in as we left, with coaches still arriving to join the rows of other parked coaches. I don't know when all the beautiful photos of the beach were taken without the people, but they don't look like the ones we took!

reviews.title: UNACCEPTABLE PARKING
reviews.text: The beach is wonderful, but not in the summer months! We visited it in August and we did not sit for an hour because there was too much people and you couldn't take a bath! The three stars are pure only for nature! Attention the first parking place you will encounter stops and tells you that it does not go further down with the result that you park there and pay 5€ go further down there is parking closer with 3€.. you are unacceptable!!!

reviews.title: Tourist beach
reviews.text: Long to round the road. You must be on the beach before 08:30 to get a sunbath. The first bus stop from Chania arrives at 0845. Get full soon after that. Incredibly many people out over the day. Difficult to find sleeping on the beach with cloth. Every square meter on small islands is busy with people with cloth and toys. Violent tourist pressure

reviews.title: Very nice beach, but come early!
reviews.text: This beach is beautiful! The waters are crystal clear and there is a strip of pink sand on the edge. After seeing all the beaches of Crete, except Balos, she is clearly in the top!Come before 10am to avoid the large crowds and plan to walk one end in the water to access the other side, with less people! Watch the wind for umbrellas too!

reviews.title: We shouldn't have gone!
reviews.text: From Xania 1h30 of winding road. Arrivals in Efalonisi agents "force" you to park your vehicle in the first car park at 5€ (scandalous).  Other car parks closer to the beach are accessible at 3€.  From the parking lot to the beach take good shoes, the path is scabrous for 10-15min. Arriving at the beach, we did not find pink sand (what a scam).  Reentered in the water, impossible to swim, there are only rocks and very little water.  There is only one small place where the beach is suitable (fine sand and water without rocks).   Don't go!

reviews.title: Great site on arrival early
reviews.text: We arrived around 9:30 and we had room to find a place on this sublime beach. The first car park is 3€ on arrival and the second 5€ (closer to the beach)The descent is quiet without anything complicated. This beach is sublime with heavenly lagoons. Do not hesitate to go behind the island where there are fewer people and the pink beaches are just as beautiful. The place is at the end of the world but it would be a shame to miss this exceptional site

reviews.title: A little disappointed
reviews.text: Beach quite far from parking lots. Also favor the nearest car parks because they are cheaper even if agents will invite you to go to the first car parks.

reviews.title: A THOUSAND TIMES LATE IN THE AFTERNOON - IT WOULD BE GOOD IF THE CITY BANNED KITE SURF IN THE WORLD
reviews.text: Looking for advice on visiting the beach, we found that most recommend either a very early morning visit (9am) or late in the afternoon (17:00) to avoid the crowd. Because we started from the old house that is just over 1 hour away, we decided not to be bothered by waking up too early in the morning with the fear that we might not find a sun lounge again. We arrived at the beach at 17.45. We were fully justified!  We found comfortable parking (not to mention that unlike what we read, the first parking costs 3€ and the last "mega parking" located 20 meters below 5€), no heat at the 15-minute descent. Also, most people were leaving at that time, we obviously didn’t need sun loungers (not even sunscreen), fantastic colors in the sky and on the beach (threatening photos ..), comfortable sailing in the lagoon and comfortable bathing in all places, we enjoy the sunset and went up to the parking lot at 20.30 with coolness. For us (a family with 3 children - the youngest 3 years old) it would have made no sense to be there early in the heat. We suggest you do if you want a first bath on your nearby beach and enjoy the redness as later as possible. The sun goes down across and the beach has light until very late. Only negative of the beach: two idiots with kite surf who considered their right to cross the passes in the lagoon with speed among the boys who wept, apparently considering that they are so "experts" that they would avoid the accident. The extra positive is that we found a comfortable table to eat in the village on the return, since most had already finished their dinner when we arrived.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Great beach fair trip to get to but worth it, fairly idiotic and restful. Loungers available for rent and facilities on site

reviews.title: Fast stop
reviews.text: It is definitely a beauty of nature, one of those to see .. But then you realize that it is a lagoon where you can not swim because it is low, crowded beach with people stopped to take selfies or to "steal" the sand as if it were a souvenir. No refreshment points on the beach, a few sectors equipped with sun loungers attached to each other. Given the rough and long road, you should arrive early, enjoy a couple of hours of natural beauty and then go away to other equally beautiful destinations

reviews.title: Nice place to see.
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, very nice to put down your towel or rent an umbrella and a sun lounger.Pink sand is present; the color is due to micro shell fragments of the same color. The water is transparent and swimming can be done in peace especially with young children because of the shallow depth of the water.A tip: go there at the end of the day to avoid the flood of tourists arriving by coach.

reviews.title: Pink sand beaches
reviews.text: Access by curvy car and once parked there are several places to eat and buy drinks. We previously booked. The descent to the beach is about 10 minutes approx. Beaches with crystal clear and warm waters, nice, fine sand. A great experience.

reviews.title: Cretan adventures
reviews.text: The beach and sea are very nice. The scenery is stunning. We got there at 8.30 and had we wanted to we could have got sun beds and an umbrella for 20euros. By 9.30 these had all gone. The crowds of people can be a pain but the area is great.

reviews.title: Avoid high season
reviews.text: Overrated,  overcrowded, windy and very little beach facilities.If you are lucky you can rent a sunbed and an umbrella.

reviews.title: HORRIBLE
reviews.text: Front We should not recommend looking for pink sand but not found before going to tale that it was seen a penne,The only thing I liked was the water

reviews.title: A dream
reviews.text: Wonderful, magnificent, there are no words to describe it. The photos do not make the beauty of this beach. I recommend going before 10.00 to find umbrella and 2 deck chairs cost 20,00 €. In addition there are 2 kiosks to eat , toilets at 1.00€ , showers free and changing rooms to change. Parking from 3 to 5,00€. Route to get to the beach quiet, 5/6 min walk.

reviews.title: Only a little pink
reviews.text: The beach is very nice indeed.  But get there very early (by 9:00) to be sure to get a parasol beach lounger spot. The water is clear and clean and there are beach side cafes. It gets very busy, and the famous pink sand is really quite restricted to the area where the waves break on the shore. The road to the beach from Chania is quite hairy, with some very narrow places and a single lane tunnel. Take it slowly and it will be fine. Worth the trip, but the pictures of bright pink beaches are exaggerated.

reviews.title: Superb pink beach with clear water that looks like a pool
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach I have seen, really beautiful , protected area where you can walk from one island to another without sinking, downside is that it is quite crowded

reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text: Perfect water for kids, but she wants you to have an umbrella. Because the tourists from 9 have closed them. A little cold sea

reviews.title: Elafonissi with Klados Travels
reviews.text: We traveled with Klados Travel from Rethymnon to Elafonissi Beach. We were four adults. The bus came precisely. The driver drove safely and the guide provided useful information. On your way to the beach you will see a lot of nature on Crete. The beach is fantastic! The water is clear and clean. There were a lot of people there, but it's a big place, so there was no problem. The water is colder than in Rethymnon. It takes some time to walk from the bus and down to the beach and further to the island, especially when it is very hot. If you are all out on the island you need about 20 minutes back to the bus, partly in the upper hill in the sun. The information says you get five hours on the beach. But we got four and a half. I asked the guide why we had less time than the information. She said that she did not know what it said in the brochure, and that this was the normal departure time for the bus. Klados should either change the time of the return, or change the information. The bus was back in Rethymnon half an hour early.

reviews.title: A little disappointed
reviews.text: Don't stop at the first car park because they try to block you when there are parking lots closer to the beach and cheaper 15 minutes walk quite strenuous Sunbeds and umbrellas at 20 euros at availability Absence of catering with a few bars with prepackaged sandwiches Crowd always present with thousands of people always on the move They were waiting for us far from sin

reviews.title: Big disappointment
reviews.text: A complete waste of a day trip. We drove there, a man stood in the middle of the road in a high vis waving us into a car park. Walking closer to the beach, there are other car parks for €3. It's a complete tourist trap, even if you need the loo there's a charge, €2 to spend a penny!!! Once you eventually get to the beach, it's just people everywhere. Every inch of sand covered with people. All sun beds were full, you can buy an umbrella for €1 but ours flipped inside out and broke pretty much instantly. We didn't see any pink sand. Yes the sea is clear, but so many other beaches in Crete are just as beautiful.  I spoke to our hotel receptionist who said Elafanisi is best if you get there before 10 and only some small parts of the beach has the pink sand. Don't bother with this one.

reviews.title: Parking disaster and money making beach beautiful
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful but at the very beginning the road is closed by a parking guide to direct you to the parking lot which costs 5 euros although further down and closer to the beach parking is cheaper This is real money-making and a real pity just drive past those and use the cheaper parking

reviews.title: DO NOT STOP AT THE 1ST PARKING LOT
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful but don’t stop at the first parking lot people in the parking lot will make you believe in yellow vest that the road is blocked, so yes it is blocked but 600m away there is a parking further away at the same price. They are simply trying to force you to pay theirs further (already the beach is already far away)

reviews.title: More than a beautiful beach...🤩
reviews.text: Beautiful site because it is much more than a beach. Water colours and paradisiacal surroundings, friendly and accessible restaurants ...

reviews.title: Where to park
reviews.text: Watch out for parking! I recommend you not to stop at the first parking lot where there will be a person in the middle of the road who will make you understand that the road is closed and that you are obliged to turn right.... actually he is letting you enter his parking lot at a cost of 5 € and 20 minutes walk to get to the beach, when immediately after there will be more parking lots at a cost of 3 € which are also closer to the sea. The beach is beautiful and worth visiting

reviews.title: One of the most beautiful beaches in the world
reviews.text: Fantastic beach. A must on you go to Crete. Come early before the afternoon wind sets in. First avoid the parking lot and ignore the parking attendants who try to force you into expensive parking. Drive on closer to the beach and take cheaper parking. Bring food and plenty of water because in July it is 32-37 degrees Celsius. Don’t forget sunscreen as the wind doesn’t make it feel so warm and sunny.

reviews.title: Attention to parking
reviews.text: WARNING: As soon as you arrive, employees in vest are thrown out of the parking lot in the middle of the road and make sense to get into the parking lot. Do not do it has lower parking with less money and closer to the beach. Long distance from the parking lot. About 15 minutes on foot and quite tiring the journey in the heat. The day I went there was plenty of air and there was no umbrella. Nevertheless, the beach was nice, shallow and clear waters.

reviews.title: The sea is very clear, wonderful and clean, but you must be careful and not swim in the depths.
reviews.text: The sea is very clear, wonderful and clean, but you must be careful and not swim in the depths.😍🥰🥰😍😍😍😍😘😘😘🌹🌹🌹🌹

reviews.title: Beautiful beach even though it is not so pink anymore.
reviews.text: Beautiful nature area. Beautiful shallow beach. Come before 9:00, then the sunbeds are available. 20 euros for two beds and an umbrella. Otherwise there is plenty of room for blankets and a small cafe on the beach. Is not so pink anymore, but it can be seen. It is still a very beautiful beach and definitely worth a visit. Family with 2 children aged 11 and 15.

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, ruined due to the excessive number of tourists; in areas where the water is shallow it becomes cloudy and loses its transparency. Entries should be restricted to safeguard nature and beauty.

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: It's a beautiful beach, on which we agree. Everything else is wrong. I had been there 8 years ago in broad daylight and unfortunately the quiet, peaceful, a little wild side is no longer present at all.A lot of people (outdated 9h vs will all be like sardines ), not enough deckchairs so forced to buy an umbrella with an infant of course! (the information was given late otherwise we would have organized upstream) difficulty finding a place to bask so much we were all on top of each other. Luckily my son was happy to see the fish and pink sand...  Caution because at the moment we reach 40 degrees: caps/hat and sunscreen galore on an island where there is no corner of shade!Anyway, I certainly wouldn't go back. Everything has changed and it's a shame...

reviews.title: That's not what it used to be...
reviews.text: I was first on this beach 8 years ago it was sublime wild calm. Today if you are not at 9:00 this beach has no interest. It has become a seaside resort with more than 5,000 people per day with only 180 umbrellas. Not a corner of shade. If you have children at a young age it is absolutely necessary to protect them from the sun. Of course you will have shops to buy umbrellas and a supermaket filled like never before. It’s a beach to see but it has lost all its charm... What a pity.

First and foremost the water is beautiful clear and that lovely turquoise that makes you just want to stay in the waters for ever....now for the rest of the experience.  Tourists everywhere...packed from inch to inch so if you want a peaceful getaway and dont like the sardine experience maybe give it a miss in the peak season.  As for parking...a word of warning if you plan to drive there.  As you cannot park near the actual beach and need to treck down to the water be mindful of the pseudo parking attendants in high viz vests that wave you into the first parking.  Its the furthest away and they charge you 5 euro for the parking.  As you walk further down there is parking for 3 euro and even further down you can park for free if you purchase something from a local establishment. A little bit cheeky to be waived into a parking spot thinking that its the only option only to find there are others.

reviews.title: too overcrowded to enjoy
reviews.text: i don't recommend. it's already so extremely overcrowded at 10 am & too windy for the sun umbrella. the beach is not pink at all.the beach is beautiful still, but we simply didn't enjoy our stay due to the factors mentioned previously. if you go by car, be careful: don't be fooled by the man standing telling you the road ahead is closed and leading you to a parking lot! it's a scam. just drive straight ahead to "megapark", it's 5€ per day.

reviews.title: Waste
reviews.text: If you are looking for crowds, scams,no shade,high prices and bad restaurants, congrads you found it..  also the road in is one way and narrow and in bad shape.. any beach in Crete is better then this one.. its a waste of a day..

reviews.title: Tourist trap
reviews.text: Tourist trap. Yes - the beach is nice, but with several thousand (dry I claim) tourists and locals you can see nothing but umbrellas that stand out from the beach. Parking guards fight and discuss. We came by bicycle, which made it easier to find parking than those struggling with cars. The water was clear and nice to the left of the beach too, although you did not get the idyllic beach there.

reviews.title: Wonderful.
reviews.text: Unforgettable day. Beautiful beach. Clean sea. If you arrive early enough you can also rent sunbeds and umbrella. Two sunbeds 10€ . Also the cost of parking is not excessive. 5€/day, 3€/day for motorcycles. The road to reach it is quite winding, but when you arrive the spectacle of nature that appears to you is worth the trip!

reviews.title: Arrive early if you want an umbrella! Very nice as a beach. Top amenities!
reviews.text: I arrived by bus from Chania (departure at 9 am and arrival at 10.40 am. Cost of 22€ return) There is a nice 15-minute walk to do on foot. I recommend arriving early to be sure to find an umbrella!Arrived in the beach the first section of umbrellas was already all occupied, going to the right you will find two other parts with umbrellas.Even the second was full, continuing to walk you will find (the third the outermost) where there were still umbrellas but in zero two ended. I paid 20€ last row with two deckchairs.The bathroom has a cost of 1€ (you can also pay with the ATM) but they are really very clean. Instead the shower is free. Bar with honest prices. 1€ water, beer 3/4€, gin and tonic 6€ and magnum 4€.

reviews.title: Absolutely did not live up to the recommendations. My advice, steer away.
reviews.text: The first thing that meets us is a parking guard who stands in the middle of the road and guides us into the first parking lot. He's giving a signal that we can't move on. We park the car and walk out of the parking lot just to discover three parking spaces below which were more affordable than the first one. Then we get to a supermarket where dozens of buses empty out tourists to then go in line 1 km to the beach. The beach itself was beautiful with many fine colors in the water, large lagoon with a beach that surrounded it and high mountains in the background. But with several hundred bathing guests, there were just too many people and it became more a visit to a recommended tourist spot to be crossed off. Very sharp stones on the right side seemed surely better on the beach that separates the lagoon from the sea. There was also a national park there, but it did not come up. Should you go here and have a nice experience go outside the high season or maybe very early or very late in the day. Crete has much more to offer on this which was very commercial for our taste.

reviews.title: Wonderful Elafonissi
reviews.text: Definitely the beach and the most beautiful sea of Crete . Don't stop in the bay but cross it and go to the beach that is beyond the bay (the real beach)

reviews.title: Over-touristic and expensive beach. Travel another place
reviews.text: Overcrowded beach, expensive parking and curved narrow road down to the beach, calculate about 15 min walk in queue. Expensive sunbeds and very much wind blowing sand in the face, access road beach is poorly organized so that tourists have begun to create their own shortcuts that struggle down nature and the surrounding area. About 1.5 hour drive from Chania each way. Drive away

reviews.title: Beautiful beach, we had a lovely time here.
reviews.text: Visited with my 2 children, age 15 and 7 year old and we had a lovely time. This beach is absolutely beautiful and we really enjoyed relaxing in the water and looking for fish and sea life around the rocks.Things that may be helpful - there are toilets just before the entrance to the beach and these were 1 euro to use. There isn’t much shade so take a sun umbrella or beach tent, but be careful as it can get quite windy and I actually witnessed a sun umbrella flying across the beach and hitting several people in its path whilst I was there! There is a cafe and shop located near the car park where you can buy hot/cold food and drinks. The little shop also sells beach items, including umbrellas so don’t worry if you forget something. The shop also sell sun creams, towels, and many other items. I purchased a bottle of sprite, a cappuccino and a Cornetto and it cost me around £8 euro which I didn’t think was bad. I didn’t use the cafe as it was too expensive. There are also several little huts scattered around the main beach area for getting changed, I also saw a larger disabled hut near the entrance. Another important thing to mention is the path that leads from the car park down to the beach. This is a gravel bath and a slight hill so going down isn’t bad, but coming back up in the mid day sun was quite challenging as there isn’t much shade. It takes about 5-10 mins to get down to the beach and anyone with mobility issues would more than likely struggle, so please keep this in mind when planning your trip here. All in all I would definitely recommend visiting if you’re in Crete and I do hope to come back with my family in the future. Thanks for reading and enjoy if you do visit this wonderful place. 😊

reviews.title: Wow
reviews.text: Fantastic beach, the sea a pool.... shame the wind very annoying!One of the most beautiful beaches on the island, easily accessible from the many on-site parking lots (don’t stop at the first one but continue to the next, in addition to being closer they are also cheaper!)

reviews.title: WHAT A DISAPPOINTMENT
reviews.text: Long trip to visit this beach, arrived it seemed to be in Rimini😱😱. Nothing to say at a glance, quite the contrary. Maybe going there in other months is the solution. As soon as you arrive a valet literally throws himself under your car to let you into his parking lot. Don't stop, go further. Leaving the car it seems to be a Dante group.😱😱😱. Hordes of people with umbrellas, chairs etc. etc. walking to the beach and returning from the beach which will be at least 800 meters from the parking lot. All under a terrible sun. Once you arrive you will find many people in the water. The beach was pink but only for the large number of people. In summary; it is not worth going there waiting for who knows. In other seasons it is definitely a spectacle.

reviews.title: Unique, less beautiful than Balos, but still crazy.
reviews.text: It's very good if you can go in the evening and early morning.Otherwise forget, too many people.Moving to the island in front, this is where you will see the pink sand with the sunset.I liked it less than Balos Bay. But still, it's a unique, privileged place.

reviews.title: Nice beach with crystal clear water
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with crystal clear water, although the pinkish tone has faded slightly over time. The atmosphere is calm and inviting, perfect for a relaxed day. In the small café on the beach you can buy snacks and drinks.

Avoid Getting Scammed!Do not park at the first car park you see. The staff there often make it seem like the road ahead is closed – it’s not! That car park is the most expensive and also the farthest from the beach.As for the beach itself, it’s absolutely stunning, but more scenic than practical. It can get quite windy, and there’s very little shade. If you plan to spend the day there, try to arrive before 9 AM to grab a spot with a sun umbrella.

reviews.title: Elafonisi beach
reviews.text: Was there today. The truth is I was quite disappointed. There is a long walk to the beach (at least 15 minutes). It is quite challenging in the heat. For some reason the parking place is far from the beach. In addition-it was very very crowded. I guess I should have arrived earlier, cause I couldn't find a sunbed. I think it's better to arrive at 9 am. Oh and the pink sand exists only in certain areas, you have to look for it. To sum up-I guess it's a must, it's true that the beach is  impressive with all the lagunas but it's crowded now in July, it takes a walk in the sun  to get there and the pink sand is relatively minimal.

reviews.title: Paradise on Earth
reviews.text: Beautiful beach crystal clear water unforgettable pink sand, if you are in those parts is a must, if you do not go to see it you can not understand its beauty

reviews.title: Lovely beach
reviews.text: To get to the beach we had to make a 2.5 hour drive, but it was worth it! Beautiful pristine beach, beautiful and crystal clear sea, worth the trip! Some tips: bring umbrella and high protection sunscreen. Being in the water often risks getting sunburned. There are some umbrellas for a fee, but they sell out immediately in the morning; do not stop at the first parking lot, but get to the last before the walk that takes us to the sea, with 5 € you can leave the car all day.  You will not be disappointed!

reviews.title: Beautiful but very early arrival a must
reviews.text: If you want to experience the beauty of this spot, go very early. We were there before 9am, got a sun bed first row in the small middle area , beautiful view and quieter. We got two hours to experience the beauty, walk to the small beach behind the little island and snorkel before it got very very busy from 11am onwards. Stayed another few hours people watching and were happy we went.

reviews.title: Heavenly!
reviews.text: Elafonissi beach is a real paradise. There is always room because it is vast. So no problem if you arrive late. Parking lots are different with lots of space. Just pay attention to the first parking lot you will find on the street. They get smart and they stop you and make you think everything's busy afterwards. The cost of the ticket is 5 euros all day. There are further ahead, closer to the beach other parking always at 5 euros or even 3 euros. When we went we realized they were free. So, go to Elafonissi because it's a dream, no problem of any kind. Only attention the first valet. Don't stop at once intimidated by the fact that they point you to stop. Go on ahead. You will find other car parks closer or at the usual price or even less.

reviews.title: A paradise on earth
reviews.text: The beach of Elafonissi is a real wonder. It is easy to access and very spacious. Despite the people, by the hundreds, the beach is really huge and you do not suffer the crowd effect, this at least in July. There are various kiosks on the beach where you can buy drinks or food and go to the bathroom. The water is a wonder like all of Crete, but the very conformation of the beach is the specialty that makes it unique.

reviews.title: Caribbean beach
reviews.text: The glance is spectacular, the colors are breathtaking. Clean and transparent water. Too bad the beach is dirty, full of garbage and cigarette butts. Unfortunately, people are often uncivilized. And the lifeguards don't give a damn the beach is full of tourists, all the time. That's too bad.

reviews.title: Among the most beautiful in the world
reviews.text: One of the most beautiful beaches ever seen in my life.It is a mixture of a lagoon, sandy sea and coves with rocks.I recommend you go either in the morning by 10 or in the early afternoon when several already leave.The beach is great and there is room for everyone, do a few meters and you will find yourself practically alone.Free showers and affordable bars.Parking at 3 euros.

reviews.title: Beautiful! But, avoid the first parking lot you see :)
reviews.text: Very beautiful beach! Worth checking out, even with how touristy it is. Just get there early! A quick side note: AVOID the first parking lot that you see. It is slightly more expensive than the closer lots, and the way they operate is pretty shady. They wave you in with a bright vest, making it look like it’s the only way you can go. This is wrong! The next lots always have space, are cheaper, and are much closer.

reviews.title: Scam parking Elafonissi beach
reviews.text: Beautiful beach! But don’t stop at the first parking lot – they lie about the road being closed! Keep driving, there are cheaper and closer options ahead. They are scammers.

reviews.title: amazing beach!
reviews.text: The beach spectacular and one of the best in the world. It’s definitely the best one we found in Greece. The sand is soft and not pebbles like many beaches in Greece. The water was warm and so clear. The sand is slightly pink rich was pretty. It’s very busy in the summer so be ready for the crowds. There is a canteen on the beach with food and drinks. There is also a market at the top of the hill to buy drinks, ice cream and sandwiches.

reviews.title: Mooi
reviews.text: A beautiful beach but extremely busy. You have to look for the pink sand because there is minimal. You walk / scramble for 10 to 15 minutes on the paths and stones so it is not accessible to everyone. Definitely worth a visit but wouldn't stay there too long.

reviews.title: The place to go
reviews.text: Elafonissi is the beach not to be missed. The road to get there is narrow and winding, but absolutely practicable. There are 3 car parks, do not stop at the first one you meet, for the same price (€5) you can leave the car closest to the beach. I also recommend bringing umbrella, backpack (preferably waterproof) skip the baths and bathers who stop in the most "touristy", take a walk and cross the lagoon to find the Earthly Paradise. You won't regret it.

reviews.title: Elafonisi Beach
reviews.text: Very nice beach. Until there though. A lot of walking in the heat from the parking spaces to the beach. Forecast for disabled people in terms of access??? A municipal car that according to the driver does not concern all disabled people but only those with motor problems. That's how he's fucked. Those who do not have a motor problem and have 80% disability certified by KEPA I am sorry but you painted it. Good luck to you. To remove from the car of the Municipality the symbol of the disabled and put something else better. Whatever you think. Let's not be fooled at all. It’s a shame because some of us blacken the true image of the hospitality and heartfelt Cretan that we have known to this day.  To exploit the tourist I don't say. To charge him to park, to charge him to sit in an umbrella, to charge him to go to the wc (1€). But don't forget the human factor. So that he won't forget about us sometime... And whoever understood understood.

reviews.title: The Caribbean Sea
reviews.text: Caribbean beach worthwhile, easy to reach , parking present. 10 minute walk downhill but worth it. Beaches equipped with sunbeds and umbrellas, bars

reviews.title: Watch out for the sunbed guy
reviews.text: The beach is really nice but the sunbed guy is a scammer. He asked for 30 euros for 2 sunbeds and said he will be back with the receipt, but he never did. Later we saw that the price for 2 sunbeds is 20 euros.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Very suggestive and particular beach, shallow and clear sea, beautiful landscape and you can glimpse a little pink sand. You park your car and make a very simple route of about 10 minutes walk. In the parking area there is a large supermarket. On the beach there is a kiosk with very honest prices. Unfortunately, we had a bit of a windy day (I don’t know if this is always the case) so it was a bit difficult to keep the umbrella open. Around 11am, in June, the beach started to get a bit crowded but still livable.

reviews.title: Elafonisi Beach
reviews.text: Beautiful and rustic beach, different from many in Europe, as it is sandy. Sea water looks like a swimming pool, very clear and calm. And with lots of fish (p who likes snorkeling). We only saw 2 points that rent loungers and tents (20 euros 1 tent and 2 loungers). There is no food/drink to sell on the beach, only on the way. Beach well full, if it is c children go early or late in the afternoon, because there are no shadows / trees and take tb something to eat and drink. We stopped at the first parking lot (5 euros per day), but after we walked we saw that the others were 3 (NO PARKING IN THE FIRST PARKING). It is worth seeing this paradisiacal beach.

reviews.title: Lovely beach go in the afternoon
reviews.text: Lovely beach we went about 2.30 so was not as busy but no sunbeds! We sat on the sand and was fine.The sea is shallow would recommend beach shoes as rocky getting into the sea but it clear and beautiful so can see where your treading.On arrival ignore the first car park for 5 euros keep going there are A few for 3 euros and closer ! There is a supermarket so grab drinks ice cream etc before going to the beach and there is only a small beach bar on the beach. We didn’t see any pink sand maybe wrong time of the day however was a lovely beach the drive to it was along some scary mountain roads so be warned if driving x

reviews.title: Yep do it
reviews.text: It’s an experience alright and swimming around this islet is a dream.   Snorkelling was fun too if not quite as good as on the south coast.   The only quibble is the sheer number of people who descend on this spot,  So pick a quiet time.  Oh and the drive is heaps of fun if you enjoy driving!

reviews.title: Elafonissi Beach is absolutely stunning!
reviews.text: Elafonissi Beach is absolutely stunning! The sand has a beautiful pink tint that makes the whole area feel unique and magical. The water is crystal clear, and the beach was very clean and well-maintained during my visit. It’s a perfect spot for relaxing, swimming, and enjoying nature. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Be aware of scammers operating at Elafonissi
reviews.text: Be aware there are scammers operating at Elafonisi - visited 8th July 2025, as you drive in there is a sign saying road closure 100m ahead with people standing by the sign frantically telling drivers to turn right into there car park pointing at the sign - this is a scam which will cost you almost double to park vs the next more legit parked further down the road - when I tried to take a photo the parking assitants threatend to smash my phone absolute scum bags.

reviews.title: Pink all the way
reviews.text: A very beautiful and pleasant beach. Be prepared for a bit of a walk to reach the best spots to relax. It can get quite crowded, so the best time to arrive is early in the day. The parking area at the end is the most convenient option and costs just 5 euros for the whole day.

reviews.title: Beautiful but what a struggle...
reviews.text: The sea really beautiful, it is an immense swimming pool maximum 1 meters high where you can swim. In some places it is very low and is so hot that it looks like a spa.To park do not stop at the first car park even if you are told to go there, further on there are many that cost even less.To eat you will have two sandwich kiosks with honest prices.The flaws are:Lack of showers on the beachUmbrellas impossible to find given the immensity of people presentTo get there you have to do an hour of curves, climbs and descents by carTo eat there are only sandwichesThere is a walk under the sun downhill on arrival and uphill on return... but if you have a spirit of adventure, you have no problem staying on the free beach a little 'clumped and have no problem spending a day with so much salt on you, it will be a beautiful experience in a fantastic and unique place. Think of it as a tiring but very rewarding hike

reviews.title: Attention, do not go to the 1st parking lot.
reviews.text: Wonderful beach, sea,and landscape definitely unique. But our experience was bad city we stopped at the 1st parking lot saying that we were not allowed to go below the 5€ charge while there were at least 4 other parking lots for 3€.Attention!!!!

reviews.title: Horrific, absolutely avoid
reviews.text: Unfortunately, Elafonissi is still touted everywhere - most beautiful beach in Europe, etc. That was perhaps 25 years ago when there were no buses going there, but we were looking for the way there with the rental car over a long gravel road. We were almost alone in the natural paradise.Now there are around 5000 people a day, worse than beaches in Thailand! Umbrella to umbrella, in front of people you can hardly see the landscape anymore!You will be greeted by Grand Parking signs! If the Cretan government does not limit access soon, there will soon be nothing left of the beauty of the lagoon, just garbage...Why not book online and limit? Why not use entrance fees and money to protect nature? Then people could still enjoy the once so idyllic place in the future!

reviews.title: I don't think it's worth it.
reviews.text: Very far from the reality of the product they promote. Crowded, with a shortage of sun loungers and little space to sit and sunbathe. Such a trip from Chania (1.40 minutes) in my humble opinion, does not justify it.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Paradise on Earth .. I come from Sardinia and I am used to the beautiful sea but I must say that this beach left me speechless .. also because it is really big. It is definitely worth a visit bearing in mind that you need to come very early if you want to find a place in the establishment.
