reviews.title: Turquoise waters
reviews.text: Extremely beautiful. Can get very hot and crowded in high season. You will need all essentials. There is a beach bar and parts are organised. But the best of this area is found away from the organised beach. Though lagoon over toward the sea. There are several different stretches of beach.

reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.text: 2nd visit, after 2021, and it's still the wouaouh effect! well, ... early in the morning around 0900 from the small headland overlooking the beach,. the place is beautiful also because of its isolation with a preserved landscape.If not, and although the number of deckchairs has been reduced, from 10:30 a.m. until about 1600, there are people, because the entire buses disembark their passengers.  It's the tripadvisor effect and its drawbacks.

reviews.title: Stay Home
reviews.text: Don’t go!!Save the beauty for the rest of us :)The waters here are crystal clear and calm. We didn’t really see much of the pink sand (because apparently idiots take it as souvenirs). Our visit was during low season so there were less than 20 people. We were told though that there are days with up to 5k people during summer.

reviews.title: Beach
reviews.text: Very cool water in October for swimming. The water is beautiful. Some traces of pink on the sand but do not expect a pink candy beach. A lot of people. Long way to get there. Compulsory parking at 5€ whether you stay 5 minutes or the day

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: A true paradise beach, it feels like the Caribbean. Small swim in October, a little fresh but it was a real treat!!! We stepped away from the finish and felt like we were alone. On top

reviews.title: Family visit
reviews.text: Beautiful clean beach, we went in October so it wasn’t overcrowded.  Nice shallow water for children and nice deep water for swimming.

reviews.title: Fun Times at Elafonissi Beach.
reviews.text: We were in Chania for a couple of days and were excited to drive over to Elafonissi Beach. We were there mid October and the beach had enough people for people watching but was not over crowded.  People were coming and going all day.  We arrived late morning and some people were already leaving. Our only regret is we didn't get up at the crack of dawn in order to have more time while there.  Would have loved to have a couple more hours.  I can't imagine what it's like during peak season though.The water is very shallow and clear which made it great for my cautious sister.  This is the perfect beach for families with little ones.  Would definitely tell people to visit if they are anywhere in the area.Even the fun/challenging drive through the mountains would not deter me from returning.  My sister on the other hand, might not.  She was scared by the drop off/cliffs and when the road goes down to one lane.BE WARE of the men going out in the road to direct you to the first parking lot.  There's more parking lots closer to the beach path.  Some of the lots were cheaper too.

reviews.title: Fantastic beach
reviews.text: Fantastic beach with spectacular sea. Rent umbrella and two sunbeds at 20 euros per day. Ample paid parking 5 euros per day. There are toilets at 1 euro. Highly recommended

reviews.title: Perfect lagoon -highlight of our trip
reviews.text: Incredible lagoon to visit-like the Caribbean. Saw the pink sand and I don’t care that it wasn’t as vivid as the photos online. Went on tour from Chania on last day and gutted I didn’t go sooner. Not many people there even at midday and it’s quite amusing to read ‘too many tourists’ comments written by tourists!! It was the highlight of our trip

reviews.title: Gorgeous Elaphonix
reviews.text: Beautiful beach suitable for both families and young boys. For those who want umbrella and sunbed you have to arrive early by 9.15 otherwise you will not find anything , alternatively you can bring umbrella etc because there is so much free beach. There are two small bars offering drinks, sandwiches and pizzas.

reviews.title: Unless partying, give this a miss
reviews.text: Too much tourism for us, far to busy and commercialised, no where sensible to park. Possibly a good experience if you are young and want a full day at the beach.

reviews.title: Worth visiting
reviews.text: We made sure to arrive before 11 and the buses, and had no problem getting loungers.  It definitely got crowded, but we had a few hours in the morning to wander around to the different areas when it was more quiet.  The sand is the tiniest bit pink, but it's still a gorgeous beach.  And the walk back to the car is nice and short!

reviews.title: Bof
reviews.text: We were there in windy weather so not great, then it's crowded, a beautiful beach but as there are plenty of crests, it's not worth it to pile up in high season for me

reviews.title: The beach with pink sand! The pleasure of the eyes
reviews.text: This is a beautiful beach! But very very very frequented (even in the middle of October) that makes lose a little of its charm at the beach but that does not prevent to have a good time. One of the most beautiful beaches if not the most beautiful in Crete! And the pink reflections of the sand are just beautiful. By necessarily visible all at once when we arrive once in the water we see them

reviews.title: Unfortunately turned into a tourist trap
reviews.text: Thousands of tourists - large crowded pitchesThe pink sand - was beautiful, but there was not much and difficult to spot.

reviews.title: Red beach and turquoise sea
reviews.text: Easy access .one of the most beautiful ridge beaches. Ideal for snorkling. Do not hesitate to cross the lagoon and get away from conventional beaches. Beauty is pure

reviews.title: Never again!
reviews.text: Tourinepp! The beach is completely crowded even at the end of the low season. What used to be pink is now black from the legacies , like sunscreen, oil, pippi... of tourists. Then the parking lot mafia wants another €5. We were just excited! If this is a TopTen attraction in Crete, this island has nothing to offer.

reviews.title: In the postseason 😉
reviews.text: In the low season, in October little crowded by tourists. The pink beach can also be seen well in some places. Clear water, very nice surroundings. A trip there is worthwhile. Tip: Arrive in the late afternoon and enjoy the sunset. Most leave the beach earlier.

reviews.title: Sketchy drive- narrow roads, cliffs
reviews.text: We had a rental car and drove here Oct 14, very pretty beach. Pink sand is visible but definitely not like the google pictures. I was unable to capture it on camera.There are plenty of restaurants and cafes on your way in but you will also find food on the beach, bathrooms for a small fee (1 euro) changing huts, umbrellas and chairs (20 euros for 2 chairs). Parking is between 3-5 euros depending on what lot you get into. It takes about 10-15 min to walk to the beach from the parking lot.The drive is a bit sketchy narrow and sharp turns the closer you get to the villages but the town is beautiful. If you’re driving on your own, smaller cars have an easier time driving through. The water is nice, specially to cool down from the heat. The Water is a tap cold but you can adjust to the temperature quickly.The water is warmer than the US but colder than the Caribbean.

reviews.title: Caribbean beach
reviews.text: Beautiful sandy beach, the small waves wash up the pink color, which you then perceive as a strip on the shore. Areas are recommended to arrive early and preferably stay in the suburbs before the crowds of tourists invade with the buses or rental cars like the grasshoppers. There are suburban supermarkets, restaurants, canteen (food stalls). Shower and toilet are also available. The water is crystal clear, sunbeds can be rented (2024 for € 20). Parking is available for a fee and the path to the beach leads downhill for about 10 minutes.

reviews.title: Pink disappointment
reviews.text: Elafonisi is really one of those places that sound like a fairy tale, but in reality can be a disappointment. Pink sand sounds great, but the massive influx of tourists and commerce can quickly make the magic fade. A waste of time!! A waste of money. I wouldn't spend any time on it. The local beaches are so much better.

reviews.title: Site became overused .
reviews.text: Even in October, this site has lost its charm because of its overcrowding and the business it generates.people who scream and who are there because you have to be there.The surroundings are horrible and charmless, The lagoon and the beach without interest with everyone.Farther afield, on the side of krios and palaiochora , you will find beautiful, super wild places of incredible beauty.The choice is not in dispute.This is the authentic ridge away from this horror.

reviews.title: BEAUTIFUL BEACH
reviews.text: SUCH a beautiful beach.  Something for everyone.  There are quiet corners on Elafonisi island...and nice snorkeling too ... as well as shallow warm waters on the main beach.  We loved it!

reviews.title: Beautiful lagoon!
reviews.text: It is true that the road has been long! 2h car like us, which are between Chania and Heraklion. In autumn several parking rates but generally 5 €. I advise you to go arriving rather the better 😁 in front, crossing the lagoon, you will have less people and the beach continues thereafter on your right. Very nice place and we do not regret the few hours drive.

reviews.title: Not crowded if you arrive early.
reviews.text: I arrived early and it was fabulous! I got to the beach on a Wednesday at 9 am and it was largely empty. It stayed fairly empty until about 10:30.  It was early October and the water was still warm.

reviews.title: Paradise before 12:00... it's beautiful! Then it's pointless... hell!
reviews.text: Fabulous but only in the morning! Between 9 am and 12 pm the beach and the lagoon are extraordinary ❗...We enjoy the transparent water, the fish, the pink sand... the small islands... the place is magical! After 12 noon hundreds and hundreds of tourists arrive...and it becomes hell!...No more charm, run away! It screams, and everything's invaded... plus an M2 available. We're going from Heaven to Hell!

reviews.title: Why the negative reviews?
reviews.text: Nearly didn't come here after reading the negative views. Dangerous roads, mafia running the parking, dirty, overcrowded, and worst of all, no pink sand having being stolen by the tourists. I'm not sure if I'm in the right place, but our experience seems a little different. The roads are beautiful with gorgeous scenery and plenty of stops. There are various parking options, all with a short walk of the beach ranging from 3 - 5 euro. They appear well run and keeping traffic out of the park. There are plenty of beach chairs, with 2 loungers and a parasol 20 euro ( just checked account and cost just under £17. Two pints and perhaps a packet of crisps in manchester). Best of all, I'm sitting here, and it's beautiful. The scenery is stunning, and the sea is crystal clear. Pink sand is washing up with the waves and just realising why this is one of the top places to visit in Crete. Happy travels.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: What should I add to the review title? Wonderful place that leaves you breathless, crystal clear water... really one of the best beaches seen in the world

reviews.title: Stupenda!
reviews.text: It absolutely deserves to be visited, with the pink beach and crystal clear water! beautiful panorama .. the only Recommendation is to be careful of illegal valets! they get in the middle of the road to stop you and let you in to park by them, but it costs much more and they make you park away!

reviews.title: Got sucked in by the guy that runs the last parking place before the gravel road that takes you close to the beach
reviews.text: This is quite a large pretty beach with little lagoons and tight poolsEven though I read a review that said to ignore the guys trying to get you to park when the paved road ends, the parking lot attendant directed us into his lot and charged five euros. After waling about 15 minutes to the beach down the gravel path we realized we could have driven almost all the way down The parking lot at sea level had only two cars in it on October 7 at 11 AM when we visited.  And it’s FREE.  The beach wasn’t overly crowded when we arrived, but within a half hour, several tour buses arrived and most of the lounges and Palapas were in use.

reviews.title: Fat experience.
reviews.text: Lovely beach area, enjoy being there with the wife, fat experience that must be tried at least once in life. We'd like to come back sometime.

reviews.title: Tourist trap like no tomorrow. Not worth it.
reviews.text: Save your time and money and visit other beaches more worthwhile. The promotional pictures depicting this beach are highly photoshopped or enhanced by AI. The pink sand is scares, only few small  patches here and there. The “enhanced” pictures attract thousands of people daily, making you feel like a sardine in its box.

reviews.title: Beautiful, but not delightful.
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful, especially at sunset. But going there on purpose, in my opinion, is definitely not worth it.The water is pure. Developed infrastructure near the beach itself. But you have to be prepared for the fact that from the parking lot all the way to the beach, you have to walk 15 minutes on a dusty road. We were lucky, in early October and afternoon the weather was not hot, but in the heat the pleasure is doubtful.

reviews.title: Beautiful place ruined.
reviews.text: A beautiful place just ruined by the daily procession from miles around by the mass of tourists. People everywhere, in every direction, we left after ten minutes. I'd far sooner be at the rocky beach ten minutes up the road, no one there at all, no need to pay for parking, no need for a 15 minute walk, no pink inflatables and no people. If the throb of tourism somewhere beautiful doesn't bother you, this place is for you. If, like us, you hate it, steer well clear. I mean, who's the imbecile who decided to carve smiley faces into the cactus???

reviews.title: Only for an Insta photo you don't necessarily have to go, as the beach is only slightly pink. But for bathing it was great.
reviews.text: We were there to see the pink beach as the teenagers were informed about it on Insta.The approach from Chania almost 1.5h. The ride was a bit like Mario Cart, quite winding.Once there we did not let the park attendants guide us at the beginning, but drove through to the end. 5 Euro per day / payment on exit.There's also a toilet right there. ( 1 Euro)You can then reach the beach in 10 minutes. There you can rent sunbeds with umbrellas ( 20 euros per double bed)We decided on the sand and a towel. It's really crowded. I can't imagine what it must be like in midsummer.We really just wanted to stay for 2 hours.But it was really Caribbean paradic. Flat water, perfect for small children. Also great for snorkeling. Crystal clear water. We have seen a moraine, a sea needle, a giant sea urchin and many other fish.In the end we were there for 6h. It has toilets, shower and a snack bar.

reviews.title: Horrible.
reviews.text: The beach was not visible because of the busload of tourists, went down to the water but you barely arrived. Did not see if the beach was pink or if the water was nice because of all the people. Went home again

reviews.title: One and Done - pink beach
reviews.text: I came here to see the “pink beach” so many people talk about…I was heavily disappointed. There’s barely any pink sand and the little patches of pink that is here really isn’t worth the 3+ hour drive that we made. I will say that the beach itself is pretty and mostly shallow and the water wasn’t too cold. However, it is EXTREMELY CROWDED and it’s hard to find a spot. This is definitely more of a one and done type of thing.Side note:I saw online that there’s a nudist area here if you’re into that. Supposedly it’s across the water (which is shallow enough to walk through) to a stand alone small island. We couldn’t find it.

reviews.title: Nice beach
reviews.text: We visited with a tour operator , arriving at 11am. The beach was super busy already . There were no sunbed/parasols left . We found a space near the surfing school to set up .  The waters were still and crystal clear , the pink sand is not that visible but it’s there . It’s not like the Google pictures , I understand it’s dependant on weather the night before . Amenities are good and I was surprised the food shack had reasonable prices . The shop is very well equipped which things needed for a beach trip.Toilets are €1 .There are shacks to change but limited . I just went in a corner and changed . Not a great deal of shade . Going in the water certainly helps

reviews.title: Fin strand
reviews.text: Traveled there by rental car. Very twisted roads, they recommend with height fear to close their eyes on the trip there.Clean and nice beach, but not as pink as in the pictures.Was very windy when we were there, but still nice to swim. Absolutely a nice day trip

reviews.title: Deception
reviews.text: Surfing. Nothing sensational except a small lagoon if you can say so. A lot of people. The preveli beach is much more beautiful

reviews.title: Beautifully overclaimed
reviews.text: Very beautiful, but very overrated. Lots of people. Missing shade at the diners. Far to make from parking down to the beach.

reviews.title: superb
reviews.text: actually do not get fooled with the first parking follow your way , then yes there are people , but there is nothing we can do about it , meanwhile this beach is superb with pink sand by the water , surprising and to do anyway;

reviews.title: Disappointment
reviews.text: Do not let you have the Check-out on the first parking lots , we easily think that the guys regulate while they push to park in their parking lot at 5 euros! While others are 3€Then, apart from the beauty of the water, there is a quiet corner and the .... It's not easy! A fairly touristic and very dense population spoils a lot the magic of the place. Maybe you have to go out of season or very early in the morning to appreciate the beauty of this sandy beach and turquoise water.And watch out for the wind which can become quite annoying because the fine sand will spoil your tranquility

reviews.title: Nice experience
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with pink sand beautiful colors We went in September and it was quite crowded The beaches are equipped with sun loungers and umbrellas but are also free There are refreshment points We ate in a restaurant at the panorama tavern from which you can see all the view Great food and affordable prices

reviews.title: Is Worth Feeling Like In The Caribbean
reviews.text: Beautifully, however, it was already quite crowded in the low season, in the summer it will probably be breaking full from noon. The way there is not without a coach

reviews.title: Beautiful beach with pink sand
reviews.text: Beautiful beach with crystal clear water and pink sand. The route to get there by car from the north is a bit winding, and the area fills up easily. But beauty is worth the effort.

reviews.title: Busy, a long way from parking, not enough loungers to rent
reviews.text: Went with two small children aged 3 and 1. We were herded into the highest car park 0.8 miles from the start of the walk to the beach but then there seemed to be lots more closer, walk to beach then snakes round a longer road, very busy despite late September midweek, toilets are all paid (bit of a pain with a 3 year old) and parasol / sun loungers all full / seemingly not enough for numbers of visitors. Husband set of back to buy a parasol and we attempted to shelter by an olive tree but all shade has been cordoned off and we were told we couldn’t stand under it?!? All in all a pretty beach but has been massively over sold and now feels very touristy and a bit of a money making racket, wouldn’t recommend with small children

reviews.title: Thunderstorm with natural beauty
reviews.text: The beach itself is beautiful, the pink sand is only on the shore but this does not make you lose beauty. It is true that there are too many people.. but the beach is totally beautiful and to walk or spend the day this great, it is a Top visit. When we went we got caught in a thunderstorm and we couldn't enjoy it but on a sunny day it has to be a 10.

reviews.title: Elafonisi parking overcharge
reviews.text: Yesterday we were in  Elafonisi and I hade bad experience with parking.. It was  5 euro  Isnd used visa machine and I didn't check my account at the moment .. After 1 hour then I checked my account they charged  twice... so we Paid 10 euro for carparking... Just wanted to let you know guys if you use visa machine just  check your account straight away..

reviews.title: Too touristy, not worth it
reviews.text: Beautiful beach probably if you can see it between all the hordes of tourists. We hoped it would be less busy at the end of September, unfortunately not. Quickly reversed to beach further down. Please note, when entering village you are immediately ushered into a parking lot but there are many more with enough space further on, saves a lot of walking

reviews.title: Nice surprise.
reviews.text: The beach is paradise, the road is accessible. Parking 5 euros a day. Cabin to change, toilet at 1€, deckchair 20€. We have been on the peninsula the sand is pink, it is quieter. I had a memorable afternoon.

reviews.title: Mass tourism
reviews.text: We drove by car about 70 minutes to the beach and arrived around 11am. You have to park upstairs according to the instructions of a park usher and then you walk down to the beach for about 15 minutes. You could already see the crowds from above. On the beach you have to laboriously clear a path through towels to get to a somewhat freer area. The water and the beach are really great, but due to the crowds it is not very pleasant to lie there. We didn't stay long. There was no free space left in the parking lot and about 30 tourist buses were waiting for the tourists there.Conclusion : a beautiful beach in Crete , but a long drive is not worth it.

reviews.title: A postcard landscape
reviews.text: We spent the afternoon on Sunday, September 22, on this beautiful sandy beach with translucent waters. It is an unmissable excursion if you want to discover the Crete in the best it has to offer. If the road to get there is in fact quite difficult on some sections , it allows you to travel through mountainous terrain and incidentally to understand the life of the small villages crossed. We don’t regret that it took us long to reach this protected and still very busy site in mid-September. The landscape is beautiful and the waters crystal clear. A postcard landscape. We recommend crossing the lagoon on foot to escape the overcrowding of the place. The water is shallow. We then reach a beach located behind the much quieter dune. Unfortunately, the wind picked up and we had to shorten the experience. Avoid taking the seaside route on your way back to Platinos . This road is very winding and dangerous because it is neither stabilized nor secure.

reviews.title: The supposed pink sand is hard to find, if anything ...
reviews.text: 5€ Parking fees at the beginning of the place, we were stopped by the parking staff, could have continued in truth, there were very many parking spaces further down free, sometimes only 3€/day. We took coffee in the cafe above the beach, with a poor service and did not taste good.The beach was totally crowded, we were looking for a quiet corner on the edge. Very nice water, but the supposed pink sand was extremely rare to find in mixture of normal sand. The transition to the island by the water, at most at Po level, was fun. The island is very beautiful, with nature conservation for dunes and sand lilies. Lying here is even nicer than in the bay.An interesting experience, but as I heard from other visitors, once seen is enough. The journey takes a long time.

reviews.title: Exhausting, a bit disappointed
reviews.text: So when you first get to ellafonissi, you are flagged down by parking attendants. We assumed that we couldn’t go any further. That wasn’t true, there were nearer car parks. It’s 5€ for the whole day, or the one after is 3€. I walk with a walking stick due to problems with my legs. There was no one there to ask about whether disabled people can get down to the beach another way. I suffered walking on uneven and stone paths for half an hour. Then seeing that some cars do go down there. When I eventually got there, was guided to the disabled sun chair area. Was charged 30€ for the privilege. Everywhere else was 20€ for 2 beds and an umbrella. Felt cheated and battered. 😫

reviews.title: Not pink but WOW
reviews.text: 4/5 rated because it advertises with a pink beach, which is not always or not guaranteed pink. For example, it rained the day before - maybe it was because you only saw a slight pink tinge in some places. (!!) Basically, however, "wow" —> finest sandy beach and crystal clear sea. In addition, it is possible to stand & walk in the water forever. We were only there at half past 11/11 - parking was no problem. We parked at the last parking lot. So on arrival the last on departure the first parking lot. 5€ for the whole day, totally OK.There are sunbeds and umbrellas on the beach. Was written for € 25 ,-. By the time we got there, everyone was already occupied. So if you want to have a shaded spot guaranteed, you should definitely bring your own umbrella. Showers and toilets available. Toilet € 1,- ... Super clean! You like to leave a euro for that. Catering facilities available. Rather fast food, was fine. The coffee was really good.Further up by the parking lots would be another restaurant.  On the whole, a trip definitely pays off, even if the beach might not be pink.

reviews.title: Refreshing, beautiful
reviews.text: The tour was really good. The bus driver and guide were very knowledgeable about the region. The drive is beautiful and very curvy. The walk to the beach is about 15 minutes but when you get there ….WOW. Crystal clear water and very refreshing.

reviews.title: Site oversold, very disappointed
reviews.text: Quite disappointed to see this site so crowded...it is probably pretty but out of season and in my opinion, even out of season, this beach is not as beautiful as what is touted on tourist guides. Balos is definitely much more beautiful...There's almost no room to put his towel down. The little beach is occupied by paid sunbathing and umbrellas, which are on top of each other...no privacy and frankly no interest!

reviews.title: Poorly managed parking lots
reviews.text: As we came down the road to the beach area the parking lot attendants at the first lot stepped out into the street forcing the line of cars into their lot. We didn’t think we had a choice. As walked down to the beach we passed the second lot which was completely empty. The obese man sitting in his chair was too lazy to wave cars down to his lot. Finally we passed a third almost empty lot much closer the beach. All of the lots are managed by Mega. I’m in my 70’s with a bad knee and had to walk much farther than necessary because of the jerks in the first lot. You can bypass the first lot and go down to the first. Another small lot charges two euros less but it will probably be full.

reviews.title: Slightly overrated
reviews.text: It was far to walk down to the beach from the parking lot and sure it was long and big but overclaimed I thought and it was very shallow you have to walk a long way out to be able to dip. The restaurant there was closed too early I think in the season despite a lot of people. And some pink beach well I didn't see that.

reviews.title: Overcrowded
reviews.text: Too many people. We considered a lot but this was outrages. Every squaremeter of shadow, every sun bed was used. Even outside of the main travel time the pure mass of people was too much for the region. Parked at mega parking - nearest and good place but huuuge. The place is overwhelmed by its own celebrity. Consider to be there very early or take another beach. Arrived at 11, left at 12:30 and still the line of people arriving was endless

reviews.title: Not recommended
reviews.text: The beach is much too crowded, much of the pink sand is not visible and it stinks. Were 5min there and left again.

reviews.title: Better to go in the less frequented months but unforgettable!
reviews.text: We immediately crossed into beautiful water to go to the islet unique landscape.  Placed in a protected area and we hope it will remain

reviews.title: Beach victim of its success. About tourism.
reviews.text: Not seen a beach with pink sand, I saw an overcrowded beach where most people walk around phone in hand looking for pink sand to post on Instagram I guess. I don’t like much but everyone likes what they want.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: We were so excited to go to this beach after reading the many wonderful reviews. Sadly, it was a huge disappointment. First the parking sucks, a lot! A guy stepped out into the street and herded us in saying this was the only available parking. It was not! We paid 5 euros to park in the last lot when there was parking much closer for 3 euros.The walk to the beach was long. About a mile. When we finally got to the beach it was overly crowded and it’s September. Couldn’t imagine it in the height of summer. There was no pink sand to be found. Something we were excitedly were looking forward to. The water was clear and beautiful. We never got it. After seeing the many people and realizing the water closet was 1 euro, we thought it best not to. The best part of this excursion was the ride from Chania to Elafonisi Beach. The view from the top of the hill to the beach was also pretty spectacular. Many more other beautiful beaches here in Crete worth the time.

reviews.title: Everyone at the supermarket
reviews.text: An open-air supermarket!! if you love shopping centers, Italian beaches model one on top of the other this is the place for you!! if you love and respect the sea, beaches, privacy and enjoy your well-deserved vacation go elsewhere!!! other thing selfie tourists are very accepted in this place!!! I forgot sunbeds at 30 euros.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach in Crete
reviews.text: We were staying in Chania for 8 nights and wanted to break up our trip so booked to stay here overnight . We took the ktel bus . Booked online from uk 10 euros each per person . We got the bus that leaves 9am arriving at 11 direct . Bus full . You get ticket number but sit anywhere . Journey is scary through single tracks small villages and scary mountain roads ! Drivers are goodArrived at 11 and it was busy . We stayed at Elafonisi village hotel which was excellent.  We saw the beach quiet when crowds left and got up for sunrise and walked all around the beach . Beautiful.  Coach leaves 4pm and goes back the same scary way ! Pleased to have visited but wouldn't do it again purely on the white knuckle coach ride

reviews.title: Very disappointed!
reviews.text: Very disappointed! Overcrowded beach, we must look for grains of pink sand. The place was probably idyllic a few years ago but it is nothing extraordinary. In Crete it is possible to find beaches and sites much more pleasant.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: Probably one of the most beautiful beaches.Sea transparent, clean, blue.There is plenty of space for the free beach, there are also umbrellas and sun loungers at 20€ I think I read. As soon as you arrive, after an easy walk of about 10min from the car park (for a fee, the first 3€, the nearest 5€)There is the first part of the wide and wide beach, instead crossing the water (max water at the waist) you can get to the other islet in front and stop there too.Walking instead behind the islet you find yourself on the back as well as wilder than elafonissi.I loved it for its colors, the shallow water for walking, beautiful.The pink sand is there but I thought more honestly, I found one much further north, very small, with much more pink sand! Anyway go there

reviews.title: PARADISE on Earth.
reviews.text: PARADISE EXISTS!I don't add anything else... the words fail to express the beauty of the place. Although crowded there is space x all.Really incomprehensible reviews with only 3 stars.For me it is the TOP!!!

reviews.title: Caribbean beach
reviews.text: We had 120km from our place, which meant 2.5 hours drive. From the parking lot it was about 300 meters to go. It was already quite busy, we switched to the island through the shallow spot. There a small natural shade sought and off into the water. One side was very shallow for a long time, the other side slowly but steadily deepened. Even if there was a lot going on, in the water we had a lot of space to ourselves. It was really with the most beautiful beach where we have ever been. Caribbean is the best place. We would take the long drive for it again at any time.

reviews.title: Not worth it!
reviews.text: It's just mass tourism, and the beach isn't really pink either... ..with a lot of imagination and a close look...

reviews.title: Like a paradise!
reviews.text: I love this place, a must see.Be there early around 8 in the morning, after some hours it will get crowded.The water is clear. Its like a paradise before the people arrive.When you visit Elafonissi I also recommend you to stay at Taverna Stomio, its close by.Its a lovely restaurant with animals around. We had chickens next to our table.

reviews.title: Spectacular beach and a must visit!
reviews.text: What an incredible place! We stayed overnight at the Elafonissi resort by Kalomirakis near the entrance to the beach so were able to see the beach at sunset and early morning.The water is beautifully clear, the pink grains of sand dance around at the waters edge and the water is shallow enough for far enough to walk around in the water.Yes, it's quite a long, winding drive down to the beach especially if you are staying around the Heraklion area but if you're only visiting the island once and plan on seeing other parts of the world before you come back, you MUST get down to Elafonissi. Easily in the top 3 beaches I've ever been to!Naturally you'll have to pay for a sunbed if you want to be there for the day but do it. Just do it. You won't regret being there!

reviews.title: Too touristy
reviews.text: A nice beach, water is super clean, but that is everywhere in Crete. Too touristy and therefore of course too busy. We had to drive two hours for it and that is not worth it, but fortunately we did it for a reason because a few kilometers away is the beach “Kedrodasos”, it is worth much more and fortunately we went there to look, otherwise two hours drive would have been for nothing.

reviews.title: Too many people too bad
reviews.text: Frankly disappointed, it's black people it's like Auchan at Christmas time, what a shame!Of course it is to be seen , the lagoon is beautiful but overcrowded!I do not advise with young child and stroller, you have to walk on steep path in full peak of the sun..The first car park we sign you that there is no car park on the beach , but there is one more ready anyway! Of course we got screwed...The Parking Award is €5 with no imposed time. Pink sand has to look for it, there are very few.

reviews.title: SHAMEFUL
reviews.text: There's no pink sand, too many people They couldn't keep and protect this place It's shameful, because it's profitable, you have to pay for parking, the beach is not maintained, in short a shame.

reviews.title: Burning disappointment
reviews.text: We deliberately added two nights in the Elafonissi area during our holiday in Crete, since on paper it was the most unmissable beach of all: what a disappointment!Clearly a lot depends on the wind, but I traveled a lot and honestly this was one of the least beautiful beaches seen in many years: murky water, zero pink sand, umbrellas massed and expensive compared to the Greek average (but this was known), obviously all Italian because probably the magical narrative about Elafonissi is only there for us... fortunately we stay 5 min away, otherwise it would have been a joke.In short, with all the isolated, inexpensive, beautiful and well-served beaches of Crete, this really is not up to scratch! If you have more than 15/20 min of travel to reach it, it is not really worth it.

reviews.title: Nice beach, good for families
reviews.text: The beach is beautiful. The water is very shallow. There are toilets, showers and ways to get something to drink or eat. However, it is very crowded there and the path from the parking lot to the beach is rather uneven and long.

reviews.title: Day at the Beach
reviews.text: Went here with family. The beach is lovely. The sea is really clear and couldn’t resist going for a swim. The views of the mountains and the sea is magnificent would go again

reviews.title: Go early-super crowded
reviews.text: We drove from Chania. 1 1/2 hour drive. About half is difficult through small villages and mountainous roads. We drove to the last parking lot-closest to the path to the beach. 5 euro to park. It’s a little bit of a walk to actually get to the beach.Rented chairs and umbrella-luckily, they run out when crowded. There’s snack stands with a variety of drinks and snacks. You can see some pink sand and it’s beautiful but there’s so many other spectacular beaches in Crete I’m not sure if it’s worth the effort and battling crowds to go.

reviews.title: Clear shallow water, but that's it :)
reviews.text: Don't trust the media and expect to see a beautiful beach with pink sand. There is hardly pink sand anymore, so in this sense this beach is not different to any other. What you will see is clear shallow water, where only small kids can swim and tons of "Instagram models" trying to make a perfect picture. The Beach is overcrowded and the food here is overpriced and low quality (that was the "dryest" pizza in my life) .The sand is nice though and in contrast to other greek beaches it's comfortable to walk on (no big hot stones or slimy seaweed) A pair of sunbeds cost 20 Euros but make sure to come for them as early as possible, after 12pm the beach is swarming with people. If you drive here by car you might enjoy some nice mountain ride on your way here, parking is affordable (5 euros for the whole day) and the way to the beach is quite easy and quick. The beach is also wheelchair accessible.This place is a nice alternative incase you got "lucky' with stormy weather during your vacation, since the waves here won't get too high and dangerous and according to personnel it never rains here for too long.

reviews.title: Paradise on Earth ❤️
reviews.text: Whatever I write is limiting and will never explain well the beauty of this place. Beach and sea of kille colors. Seen in August, with the chaos typical of the period, it is wonderful. I want to come back in June because, in my opinion, it will be even more beautiful. You can't even compare it to the beaches of the Caribbean, which remain beautiful, but will never come to such a wonder.

reviews.title: Beautiful and a little pink sand
reviews.text: Very nice place, warm water and turquoise because shallow over a great distance Very good for young child because no wave (a large pool 30cm / 50cm deep)People but frankly the space is large so it’s okay!5min walkSeveral paid car parksAnd the most expensive back parking costs 5€...but it's worth getting closer Little mini-market next door!

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach
reviews.text: Beautiful, go early because at 11 the umbrellas were already all taken. The first parking is the cheapest and is not far from the beach

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: We were really looking forward to visiting here as one of the best places to visit in Crete. But unfortunately we were disappointed. The place was packed, which meant it lost some of it's beauty. Very limited on the "pink" sand too, which was disappointing. Google images have a lot to answer for!!

reviews.title: Great day at the beach
reviews.text: The beach is magnificent but be prepared for lots of other visitors and a long walk down from the carparks.Make sure you don’t stop at the first carpark as there are lots of carparks much closer to the beach entrance. Sun beds are expensive but necessary unless you have your own sun umbrella with you. If you are travelling through the mountains be sure to stop at the small vendors along the way selling lots of natural Cretan products including honey balm which is amazing. Also take the coast road home it is a magnificent drive but not for the faint hearted! Enjoy the sunset too

reviews.title: Beautiful but overpopulated
reviews.text: Very nice beach. Unfortunately being one of the most famous is really too flat people especially in the afternoon. Recommendation to arrive very early to enjoy the landscape and not to stop at umbrellas but to continue and go to the island in front and enjoy the true nature.

reviews.title: Mixed
reviews.text: Beautiful beach to see, but there is very little pink sand left, a very small line at the edge in some places. The number of tourists is a bit confusing, it looks like on the French Riviera in the middle of July-August. And even if we cross the other side, with water sometimes above the knees, there are still a lot of people... You really still have to walk to find a quieter place. However, it remains magnificent. Water not super hot, but refreshed considering the outside temperature and pleasant wind. Consider eating and drinking if you plan not to stay on the main beach.

reviews.title: Fantastic.
reviews.text: Fantastic excursion!Super Guide which was helpful and nice. When we booked our hotel did not come up as a pickup location so we had to go from another hotel, on our way home we talked to the guide and bus driver who dropped us off at our hotel, which we were very grateful for! Super nice beach, tip: do not buy an umbrella it blows off anyway at the beach 😂.

reviews.title: A wasted day !
reviews.text: A wasted day, there is nothing spectacular, go to Balos! There is no pink sand, the water deepens after approx. 90 m from the shore, too crowded for my taste. If you're still curious, come after 5 p.m. Nice holidays !

reviews.title: Spectacular
reviews.text: The beach of Elafonissi is very beautiful but there are must limit to the equipped part because the beauty is just to explore the entire reserve and get to the top of the church. The walk is feasible and you do not notice the fatigue because the walk is dotted with rocks, bays and coves that tempt you to enter the water at every step. Sand and white dunes, clear and transparent water. The beauty is finding a space all to yourself. The view from the top of the church is beautiful. Recommendation, if you want to choose the equipped beach, to stay on the right side where the water is shallower because, at least it is clear; where the water is higher it is cloudier.

reviews.title: Nice place to be!
reviews.text: We went on early September to Elafonisi Beach.We took  the public transport bus and all went ok. Not so crowded as previous reviews. There is plenty of space for everybody.There are few area with "pink sand" -actually rest of some shells, but it worth it .If you want to stay prety close to "pink sand" maybe could be crowded,  but there is also a wild part of the beach with specific Mediterranean vegetation-trees where you can find a shade. The blue lagoon is very nice, clear water, wild vegetation , kite-surfing, a nature masterpiece. The way to Elafonisi is also quite impressive,  there are some areas where you are surrounded by mountains, you will pass through small and nice Greek villages.If you pass by Crete you must visit Elafonisi Beach!

reviews.title: THE REAL PARADISE!!!
reviews.text: It was amazing..exotic..a unique experience...a natural lake....and, at the time so romantic...the best beach all over the world!!!!

reviews.title: It's not lost!
reviews.text: Not lost!!! Excellent beach, mirror the sea with white sand. The truth is that there are too many people but they suffer because of the vast area. Parking you will find nearby and walking access easy. There is a canteen-bar and sunbeds but for the many-many breakfasts. Cleaning everywhere!

reviews.title: Like a swimming pool!
reviews.text: To get to this wonderful lagoon from Agia Marina, we faced a challenging journey: more than an hour and a half of "mountain road" between hairpin bends, cliffs, narrow streets and narrow tunnels dug into the rock. The route, not exactly relaxing, is made a little more pleasant by the view: you cross characteristic villages surrounded by olive groves and you will be breathless observing the bottom of the barren and rocky valley from above. Once at your destination you have several parking possibilities. Recommendation not to park immediately (5 euros for the whole day) but to proceed to the area where several mini markets are concentrated; here the cost is lower (3 euros), there are toilets and you are closer to the beginning of the pedestrian path that leads to the different coves of the lagoon. This is where an important question needs to be asked: whether or not to buy an umbrella? In fact, along the entire beach of elafonissi there are several "bathhouses" with small bars and the possibility of booking umbrellas and sunbeds but they are often not available because they are crowded early in the morning. After an easy walk of about 5 minutes, (nothing comparable to the endless, challenging and dusty path that leads to the lagoon of Balos!!!), you get to the different beaches of Elafonissi.  Even if the visitors are many, you do not have the feeling of crowding. I recommend not to stop immediately but to proceed all the way. Here the beach is more spacious and it is not a problem to plant the purchased umbrella (prices are modest) and lay the beach towels and, above all... you are in the open sea.The spectacle that opens to the eyes is heavenly! It looks like a Maldives beach! Clean, crystal clear water with all shades, from blue to light blue. The bottom of fine sand is very shallow for several meters and allows children to have fun in the water without anxiety. The small bars allow you to buy drinks and simple snacks so that you can safely have lunch on the beach without worries. Highly Recommendation to visit this beach, in my opinion, much more beautiful from a naturalistic point of view, than the lagoon of Balos (presence of tar July rocks!!!)However, I remain of the opinion that the beach of Falassarna is the most complete: free parking very large, clean beach of fine sand that, for this reason, is not annoying, sea that contemplates all shades of blue, impeccable beach services thanks to Dimitri and his collaborators can also guarantee restaurant service on the beach (at no additional cost) at reasonable prices.Happy holidays everyone!

reviews.title: A very nice beach!
reviews.text: A great day! As far as pink sand is concerned, there’s not much of a small line at the beginning of the sea but that’s it. In any case, the water is incredibly TRANSPARENT and AT VERY GOOD TEMPERATURE 😻!!

reviews.title: Beautiful but busy
reviews.text: Thanks to Tripadvisor, I was forewarned that a) there wouldn’t be much pink sand, b) it would be rammed with people, and c) there is a horrible walk back up to the car park.Having set my expectations quite low, it turned out to be a very nice day, because it really is beautiful. We waded over to the island which has much more space, just be warned that you will be wading to hip-height so have everything securely packed away. Don’t drop your whole towel in the water like I did!Unfortunately we were on a coach day trip, and while the drive both ways (from Chania) was worth paying for in itself, I  would rather have done the walk back to the coach when it was cooler (not 3.30pm). Do allow yourself loads of time, it is a killer. Also you do need to bring or buy a beach umbrella (one between 2 people), as sun beds and umbrellas get snapped up early.

reviews.title: Trying to believe!
reviews.text: It might put off the crowds and buses walking to the beach BUT just walk a little more (to the right) to discover a wild side and find an exclusive spot! Recommended x snorkeling and to take time to relax.

reviews.title: Beautiful beach in the lagoon
reviews.text: Very nice beach with umbrella and deckchair ( 20 € both deckchair with umbrella and 5 € extra deckchair. Parking between 3 and 5 €. Snaking possible on site but a little expensive!

reviews.title: A crowded paradise
reviews.text: Elafonissi beach in Crete is truly enchanting, with crystal clear waters and unique pink sand. However, in August it is very crowded. It is advisable to arrive early to secure an umbrella, especially on the right, and prepare to defend your space. The bath is magnificent and the strip of sand leading to the island offers a fascinating hike. The view of the pink beaches and the scent of lilies in August make the experience unforgettable.

reviews.title: A beach to discover absolutely 👍
reviews.text: A beautiful beach of fine pink sand , we swim with small fish and small shrimp ... we will have to walk away and cross to the other side for a real discovery of the beach ... we preferred to wander and get away from the crowd that was at the first beach ... Put on your cream and go discover this almost island 😀😀... One thing you are not told is that it is windy! Lots of wind but protect your skin anyway because it is sunny...

reviews.title: Not to be missed during your stay Cretan
reviews.text: Beautiful place with translucent waters. Plan to go early so you can fully enjoy the scenery before tourists arrive. Sunbeds and umbrellas are storming the main beaches. Trip Tip: feel free to walk along the beach to the right to be away. You will find many coves where you will feel like you are alone in the world in the water.

reviews.title: Partially disappointed
reviews.text: We reached the beach of Elafonissi with a speedboat excursion leaving Paleochora at 16. After two stops, and as many dives in the enchanting beaches of Viena (clear water with green colors) and Kedrodasos, semi-desert with wonderful crystal clear blue waters.  Arrived in Elafonissi at about 17, given the hour, we thought we would find a beach with fewer people, but this was not the case, overflowing and with rather murky waters in the lagoon, a little better towards the open sea, little pink sand on the shore, a real disappointment! Fortunately on the way back, we met four dolphins that delighted us with some vaults in the blue waters of the Libyan Sea.

reviews.title: Wow!!! PERFECT COMBO
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, lovely. There are parking spaces for 5 and 3 euros. If you go to the bottom you will find the parking at 3 euros, do not stop at the first parking. There are beaches and of course free beach. The lagoon is wonderful, it is blue and on the other side of the islet it turns turquoise green, then if you go even deeper you will find fewer people and more privacy and the sea all your own. You will have to walk about 10/15 Min from the parking lot. I recommend it, for now it is the most beautiful beach I have ever seen until now. It is a perfect combo between turquoise blue/green sea, the mountains behind, the lagoon, the white beach with contrasting rocks and of course the pink sand. Beautiful, GO THERE. EVEN SEVERAL TIMES. Ah, then Recommendation a nice dry bag where you put things inside and always move around and explore the whole beach.

reviews.title: Wonderful.
reviews.text: A true paradise.I start with explaining some things I have read in other reviews. If you have been to Sardinia, in Stintino for example, you know that the most beautiful beaches are very crowded everywhere in the world. Now, compared to Stintino, this beach was a deserted island. So many people, yes, but absolutely it was possible to find your own space to place an umbrella and be comfortable. Nothing unlivable. At least as far as my experience of a Tuesday in August is concerned. Maybe the weekend gets fuller?? I don't know.Now let's talk about the beauty of this beach. I state that I am Sardinian and I came to Crete because often this and other beaches are compared to ours, expectations were high as well as the fear of disappointment. And instead I must admit that it is perhaps one of the most beautiful beaches I have seen in my life (and I have also been to the Caribbean and the Indian Ocean, in addition to my Sardinia).No photo you see online can capture the beauty of this beach in my opinion, with its intertwining sand tongues joined by lagoons from the sea of a blinding blue in which you can walk with the crystal clear water that comes to life.Let's talk about Pink for a moment. Exactly as for our Budelli.... Pink is there, but they are shades due to corals, in some places more evident, in others less so. Forget the photoshopped photos. However, what makes it special is not pink but its shape that almost resembles a beach in the Bahamas. Finally to have an umbrella in the establishment you have to arrive very early. So, either find a way to stay in the nearby b&b or hotels or you will have to wake up very early because it is 1 hour and 30 from Chania.We had two umbrellas loaned from the chania hotel and we managed without much difficulty. Our neighbors were at least 10 feet away and we were like hell.

reviews.title: A must visit!!
reviews.text: Simply a must visit if you are staying to a hotel nearby Chania. The road it’s pretty rough, but the view is very beautiful. Absolutely stunning view. Me and my friend went there by bus through an agency. I would say the road from parking to the beach is pretty accessible. It took us between 15-20 minutes. It’s true that the beach was very crowded, but it was worth it. The beach is very large, so that everyone can enjoy it. I understand that there are some people who dislike crowds. But I would say it’s normal, because Elafonissi it’s in top five beaches in the Greece. So what do you expect? Especially in mid season. The view on the beach was fantastic, with the mountains surrounding the beach. Also the water was crystal clear. There are some places on the beach where the water isn’t that great, so choose carefully your spot. I recommend not to pay for sunbeds (very limited), but instead just bring your own umbrella. As I said, the beach is very large and it’s enough space for everybody. Since I am visiting Greece, I think this one is on the second place, after Balos.

reviews.title: Idyllic beach
reviews.text: Very nice idyllic beach, like on postcards. Watch out for sunburn, no gray areas. The sunbeds and umbrellas were stormed. It is not possible to plant his on the page because too much wind. Very nice experience, to do!

reviews.title: Excellent decision to visit this beautiful beach for the sunset without the crowds. You will not regret it.
reviews.text: We decided to visit for the sunset and arrived at 6pm as people were leaving, so after parking up at the final car park before the beach (€5 for the day) we strolled down and it wasn’t too busy at all.We waded through the lagoon on the left and after a quick dip we then walked to the right on the path that takes you to a much quieter part of the beach and is best for seeing the sunset.The pink sand on this side was outstanding all the way along, the water was super clear. We finished our evening there feeling very happy and as we were walking back, we captured further pictures of a magnificent sunset.We are all happy that we chose to go for the evening rather than the full day and would recommend this option if you don’t want crowds. There is a toilet for €1, options for buying food and drinks and also a changing cubicle which was very helpful.All in all it was a 5 star experience.

reviews.title: Good, but busy
reviews.text: A victim of it's own success, beautiful beach but too crowded.  If arriving by car drive straight to the end to park and ignore all the previous car parking attendants waving you down as you'll have to walk far.

reviews.title: Like the illuminated swimming pool. Divine!
reviews.text: Caribbean you can smoke in the pipe. One of the most beautiful beaches I have ever visited. Highly recommended. Disadvantage: Crowds and the beach bar reminds beach canteens as they are known in Italy. Tasteless. They could come up with a little more, like in the rest of Greece. Otherwise, everything well organized. The walk from the parking lot to the beach is not very long.

reviews.title: Beauty that goes lost...
reviews.text: Unfortunately, we didn't look for it long before and we hit it.... In principle, don't get into the first parking lot, even though it's a 'master' who flies in the middle of the street and says the road is closed after. Lie. It is the most expensive parking and there are closest to the beach and cheaper a little further down. The bottle of water is 50 minutes more expensive the closer the store to the beach. Arriving at the beach, be prepared for the 'popular pilgrimage' that prevails! One on the other... At the point where there are sunbeds, it is half a meter from those around. 20€ for the two beds. As a natural landscape it is very beautiful but unfortunately they destroy it. I can tell you at least 10 beaches in Crete, better or equally good, with half the people and half the cost, less advertised simply (fortunately in the end!) I am sorry about this and I would suggest the Municipality, instead of renting sunbeds at selling prices, to take care of a little to check this situation instead of participating!

reviews.title: A beautiful experience and discomfort at the same time
reviews.text: It reminds of the pilgrimage, because of the crowd. You just go to experience an experience and suffering at the same time. It's a special place. A beautiful beach, but wants the preparation to go doches in the summer months, umbrella, sandy etc. It has a walk until you arrive. Very shallow water. You can't stay for a long time.The ground is rocky and it doesn't have much space, just put the towel, a little disappointing for me.For parking, don't park at the first(5€), it's below (3€).

reviews.title: Not as good as the hype.
reviews.text: The hype outweighs reality. Some parts of it are lovely of course, but it’s absolutely mobbed and largely not as good as beaches at Falassarna or even the lovely little beach at Paleochora. If you like shoulder to shoulder busy beaches then maybe it will suit you here. Wasn’t for us. Toilets are €1 if you need to go.

reviews.title: Very bad experience
reviews.text: Initially while there is enough parking space below (as it was earlier), now you are forced to park 900 meters ahead and walk up there to pay the 5 euros that the parking has. Very shallow sea and the people overnumbered for this particular beach, one on the other. I ⁇ 't go back. Nice landscape but the discomfort is great.

reviews.title: beautiful sea place
reviews.text: definitely it is a must of clay and in fact it pays the very high number of tourists. Recommendation to cross the basin and go beyond the islet. it is open sea, there are fewer people and certainly calmer. beautiful and clear water. many speak of the most beautiful sea of clay. I do not know.in Apulia there are many similar beaches.you make an uncomfortable walk and definitely not equipped for strollers and / or wheelchairs. there are lidos and bars as always more than decent prices.If you are on clay, you have to come. reviews.title: Beautiful but uncomfortable
reviews.text: Nice but disappointing. Beach with quite crowded and quite frequented. Hence becoming uncomfortable and being almost impossible to enjoy such beauty. It is a pity that this heritage of nature will deteriorate, derived from the massive presence of tourism. It should have limited space, and even be paid, in order to preserve this heritage.

reviews.title: The exaggeration in a mediocrity
reviews.text: Blue-green waters and there stops the playfulness of the beach. Very shallow sea (no matter how far you go, you can soak your hips, at most!). I believe that if it was not much advertised by the media, it would be another beach in many of Greece.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in Crete
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, pink for real, lagoon, crystal clear, shallow water. An open-air swimming pool. Compared to Balos is accessed after a walking path with little slope and therefore pleasant and feasible (about 10 minutes). We returned from Chania a second time as beautiful as it is, of course the car route is challenging because it takes about 1.30h in the mountains but it is absolutely worth going and... returning.

reviews.title: The most beautiful beach in Crete
reviews.text: ... and one of the most beautiful I have ever visited.Crystal clear sea, white sand (in some places it is really pink), good amenities. The only sin is the many people, not always polite, who meet in August.There are also (few) umbrellas and sunbeds available at prices that, in Italy, we dream of.

reviews.title: One of the best beaches in the world.
reviews.text: This beach is really unmissable if you travel to Crete. It has well earned its location among the best beaches in the world. Its crystal clear waters, pink sand and breadth make it worth the trip on a path full of curves. I have been to the Caribbean several times, but this beach seems a thousand times better for its absolute absence of waves. One can go deep inside just by walking. There are agencies that offer tours to Elafonisi, but I think it is much better to rent a car and go freelance. There is ample parking nearby, only 5 euros per day.

reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text: Together with the cedar forest the best beach! It is exotic with clear waters and vast sand! You can also walk from one shore to the other and be in the sea as the waters are shallow! One of the best experiences and one of the most beautiful beaches in Crete!

reviews.title: PARADISE 🏝️
reviews.text: A paradise .. clear sea with beautiful colors. It feels like being in a huge pool. The most beautiful sea in Crete .The route to get there is very feasible and on the beach there are umbrellas and services.

reviews.title: A sea of a thousand shades...
reviews.text: Definitely the most beautiful beach I have seen in Crete. I was there twice just as much as I liked although I had to make a journey of about 1 h and a half. Convenient parking and a short walk to the sea. The beach is equipped with various points with umbrellas and sunbeds and the cost for the set (umbrella + 2 sunbeds) is 20€. My husband and I chose the right side where there are 2 small points with a few umbrellas close to 2 lagoons... in our opinion theBest point. We had the pleasure of meeting a beach attendant who in our opinion is a lovely person. Tourists are provided with detailed information on the beach and its surroundings. He shows attention to the cleanliness of the beach by picking up here and there what is left by the patrons through neglect or distraction. His kindness shines through in every little attention he places on customer service. His name is Ioannis. There were such people around who demonstrate love and respect for the environment around us. An example to follow. Discounted tip: you have to arrive early to find free umbrellas otherwise be equipped on your own to guarantee a little shade.

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: Unquestionably the most beautiful place in Chania district.Crystal clear sea, white sabbath, shallow waters, mountains frame all this.It’s August, of course a myriad of people arrive and the show loses some of its shine but the game is worth the candle.You can take an umbrella with two sunbeds for 20 euros but you must arrive no later than 10 am, otherwise bring an umbrella and arm yourself with patience because you will have to find a place and it will not be easy.Parking 3 or 5 euros depending on which you choose.Worth a social mention Johannis, beautiful boy who takes care of his lido, entering the beach you have to go to the right of the small beach bar.Very kind, from advice, explanations, cleans everywhere, practically a cicero and plastic detector.Also thanks to him Elafonissi was my favorite place.I highly recommend dedicating a day to this place.

reviews.title: Elafonisi
reviews.text: A beautiful beach with fantastic waters. They have closed access for people to the beach and have done very well to protect the environment. You leave the car at the parking lot for 5 euros and walk 10 minutes on a good road without any problems (I was with the slippers). We went there at 8:00 and ⁇  a beautiful landscape. The only negative is the crowd . Since 10:30 a.m. there is a lot of people gathering that spoil the beauty of the landscape. And one tip: it blows very often. Plastic cheap umbrellas do not do for this place. Either you have a good umbrella or you go too early to catch beds.

reviews.title: To see but...
reviews.text: Beautiful place, the colors are superb, the water is translucent, the turquoise of the sea puts you in a postcard. But... to flee in summer! Tourist place to the highest point with full coaches tours, finally with the world it breaks all the charm. Or do it sooner or later in the evening. Provide paid parking

reviews.title: Overestimated...
reviews.text: Let me share the experience so that one knows what awaits him in August. From Chania is almost 2 hours drive. BOAK and then not even a rural network, but villages streets (beautiful villages!) Very careful and low speeds because the risks are many. On my trial route I was respected by the locals (their favourite) and I was disappointed by the foreigners who with the nuts they rent have seen Juha Kandotten in the asphalt rally of Crete... Go to the last parking lot! What says MEGA Parking and you will pay €5 (good as here-we got...!) Then starts the descent to the beach at least 15 minutes walk on rough paths. Very careful if you have children to have them by hand. You won't find sunbeds unless you go to 8:00! Yours are hard to carry (I did). When there's air, there's air! And finally you won't swim, because it's 30 points of water...In conclusion, the advertising has caught! Or it used to be worth it and not now. 4 hours from Chania! Wasted time! In my opinion the most overrated place. It really has much better places in Chania than Elafonisi. Of course, age also plays a role. If you're a group of students, you have kids, and I'm with you! If you're a family member, let my friend go!

reviews.title: Do not go in August
reviews.text: Absolute tourist trap. What felt like millions of people arriving by buses and cars. The parking lots are a 20 min walk from the beach, could probably be less but you will be walking with thousands of people, just as if you are about to enter a stadium for a football game or a pop star concert. Once we arrived at the beach, we literally couldn’t walk without stepping on someone’s feet. There were no available sun beds, and even if we had our own umbrella, there was no space to place it. Although we drove all the way from Chania, we left after only 5 min and we are definitely not coming back, at least not in August.

reviews.title: Beautiful but overcrowded
reviews.text: To enjoy the beach we left at dawn and arrived in Elafinissi at 8:15. We did not stop at the first umbrellas but we took the little road on the right and arrived at some very nice straw umbrellas, we took possession of them and after about an hour the guy came for payment. We immediately went to the islet that is worth visiting. It is full of small coves, if you go with your own umbrella I highly Recommendation to go there. There are also structures handcrafted from beach logs that can be used for shelter if you find them still available. The real problem is that the river of people coming never stops. At 15 we left also because in the afternoon there is a lot of windFor those coming from Chania, you should consider at least 1 hour and 20 minutes. The last kilometers before arriving at the beach are in the middle of the mountains, without guard rails. Very cautious

reviews.title: To flee in August
reviews.text: What a disappointment, we ended up on a crowded beach. There are so many people that you do not see pink sand, only a few grains, nothing spectacular. This type of beach should be protected in order to conserve a gem. Overtourism is becoming a real problem.Note the war between parking lots! We were beckoned to enter the 1st parking lot when there was room below!

reviews.title: Avoid in high season
reviews.text: Very nice place spoiled by the crowd, there are places just as beautiful and also wild little frequented aroundDo not hesitate to walk on the left along the coastA little more complicated to get into the water but at least you will be quiet under the pines

reviews.title: Touristic trap, people on top of one another
reviews.text: If you have never seen beaches in your life, this place is for you. Absolutely crowded, everyone sitting on top of one another. Not enough seats and umbrellas, even if you bring your own, there is hardly any place for it. Barely 3 small cabins to change which are super old and the doors are with broken locks. Was are not free, its 1euro per entrance, there were 3 of them in the vicinity. Everything is absolutely super touristic, reminded me of those stables with cattles, when you are dropped by bus at 11 and collected at 4pm (the bus going from Chania is operated by Ktel, another bad experience, absolutely zero customer service). The worst beach experience

reviews.title: How to Destroy a Paradise
reviews.text: Arrived at 9:15 (after a 1.30’ drive) the MegaParking car park was at 20% capacity but umbrellas almost all taken. Sea still livable with some beautiful areas There are 2 locations to rent umbrellas as soon as you enter and on the right more hidden. Absurd the amount of people who arrive and keep arriving until 2 pm. Few facilities , poorly managed , old umbrellas and sunbeds .In the water you cannot stay with people who are there. At the beach you can not walk. But how badly you got.. DIAL CLOSED , increase prices and provide adequate services .I'll never come back

reviews.title: overrated beach
reviews.text: we arrived in a week-end in august, by car. there are 3 parkings- first one cheaper than the others two. but also you could park further whith no charge. we have park in the biggest parking, the closer to the beach, near the store. the region was very windy. it's a short and easy walk to the beach arriving there, since it was very hot, we have rent an umbrella and 2 deckchairs pt 20 euros/day- no cards accepted, only cash. the man in charge it was very rude. since it was very windy and hot, we have left at 12. obviously he didn't return half of the amount, even if by the time we picked up the sunbeds had already been rented to other tourists - obviously he still charged them also 20 eurosthe beach....it's not pink at all....absolutely no pink. we have been also to Balos beach- which is more "pink" than Elafonissi. the water is very clear, but it is not deep, it is ideal for very small children, but disturbingly small for adults - you can't really swim. also...the toilettes- no comments. so, after driving more than an hour to arrive here, the all experience just to put on a "to see list", but there are much more beautiful beaches in Crete, such as Balos

reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: The beach of Elafonisi is a true paradise.The water is so clean and crystal clear that it looks like a pool.The sand is pink. Crazy colors.

reviews.title: CROWD MADNESS
reviews.text: Gone yesterday and arrived at 8 and after a while the umbrellas were already all occupied. Then comes not so much but so many people who put themselves everywhere. Overcrowded would be saying little. It would be a nice beach, but you can't enjoy it. I strongly advise against this period. The Greeks should at least put a closed number on the buses....but God money is worth more than nature...

reviews.title: PARALIARA!!!
reviews.text: The most beautiful beach in Greece. We heard about difficult access etc. Nothing to do. 5 minutes walk and you're in heaven. It is so big that you will definitely find a nice place to sit.

reviews.title: Bofffff
reviews.text: To visit out of season...August = overcrowded.I think there are other places less crowded and much more surprising in Crete.

reviews.title: Crowded
reviews.text: It is very very crowded, it's só cowded that people camp on the rocks, haveing no choise.  There are no shades unless you rent an umbrela or You bring yourself one.

reviews.title: Much change in 3 years - disappointing
reviews.text: Our experience has been increasingly disappointing. Contrary to what we saw 3 years ago, there was almost no pink sand (perhaps a season ago?) Certainly Instagram was involved in the destruction of this splendid place!  We start by dropping 25€ for 2 deckchairs and 5€ for parking and no deckchair rental option for half a day is available. The beach was overcrowded from 9:30-10:00, without any respite, bus after bus, which made the experience tiring. The barrier to limit access is a good ecological idea (before we parked openly at the foot of the beach in the shrubs), but in practice it means you have to walk a lot, which is a real nightmare with a stroller and young children. (Only pregnant and disabled women can get off by car)For those who still wish to try the experience, I recommend taking a nearby accommodation and arriving very early in the morning to avoid the crowds.There are also some superb beaches not far away, without this human tide and without that feeling that the tourist is an inexhaustible cash cow.

reviews.title: Lagoon with grey/pink sand
reviews.text: Beautiful lagoon with clear waters and grey and pink sand. It is recommended to get there very early. We arrived at 9:30 at the beach and found no unoccupied umbrellas with sunbeds. By the way, they cost 20 Euros a pair with an umbrella and 5 Euro each extra sunbed.Overall, a fine trip, we walked 2 or 3 km on the shore and thru the water to see the island and then took a nice bath, but made and early escape, at around 12:30 as we had no umbrellas with sunbeds and the sun was hot. We had our own umbrellas but we could not plant them in the sand because of the wind and hard soil. There were places in the lagoon with thick and fine sand to put the umbrellas, but not near the areas with all the amenities (toilletes and sunbar).

reviews.title: EXTRA EXPOSITIVE
reviews.text: A BEACH THAT YOU MUST VISIT.UNBELIEVABLE WATERS AND UNBELIEVABLE LANDSCAPE.LITTLE CHILDREN LEAVE THEM AND PLUNGE WITHOUT FEAR OF DROWNING.SOME ADVICE: BE THERE UP TO 09.30 TO GET A GOOD POSITION BY CONNECTING THE SEA WITH WATER TO THE MIDDLE OF THE PROVISION.GET EVERYWHERE WITH YOUR UMBRELLA IN THE BROOKS IF YOU FIND, IT HAS A GOOD SHADD TO DON’T GO TO THE HORSE.NOT STAND IN THE LOCAL.PARTIQUETH NOW BODY BODY BODY BODY (PAKET 10).

reviews.title: Crete on the road 2024
reviews.text: Beautiful beach but absolutely to avoid in this period. Very crowded.Impossible to find a place in the shade and even less deck chairs and umbrella. Hordes of people

reviews.title: Very nice!!!
reviews.text: Very nice beach. You can get there easily by car. Parking is charged 5€, then there are about 15 min walk Recommendation put comfortable sneakers, rough terrain. It is necessary to arrive early in the morning between 8:00 and 9:00 then you will no longer find the parasol, essential. The cost is 20€ (umbrella + 2 sunbeds) if in the main beach everything is busy, immediately to the right there are 2 other equipped beaches. The umbrella brought from home unfortunately flies away easily, the area is very ventilated and under the sand, because of the stone slabs, it is difficult to pitch the umbrella, better a tent. The pink sand is visible but not much, you will have to move on foot to the islet in front where it is most visible. Unfortunately, the impact of man on the environment can also be seen here!! Shallow water almost everywhere, crystal clear (it looks like a swimming pool) unfortunately very cold so I RECOMMEND the shirts those special for water. A nice experience accessible even with children!!!

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: A beautiful beach, however, overrated, crowded, there is no way to book a sunbed and, despite arriving at 9 am, the umbrella can only be dreamed. A bad experience, just as with a woman who had to fill the role of lifeguard, dishonest, rude and too presumptuous for what her job should be (all this in the early morning, I dare not imagine after a day of work how she is). We ran away after 10 minutes.

reviews.title: Wordt beach ever!
reviews.text: Nice Beach BUT the  Business is more important then the tourist. Parking places would be directly at the beach but the business people making a barrier to come to the beach. Result is walking 15-20 min for nothing. It’s here really all about the money. To Long ways even if the beach is beautiful. And if you really want to go there take the last parking place, they stay already 500 meters before the last big parking place and say you have to park here. Also really aggressive!!!! I think you could spent your time and money better in your holidays !

reviews.title: One another another
reviews.text: What Lafonisi with Elafonissos is not the same muscaria. Look at the photo and see what it says.Booja.Good night

reviews.title: Beautiful beach... But too many people!!
reviews.text: Beautiful beach, it reminds me a lot of the hairy Stintino, unfortunately in August is not the best time to visit ..We arrived at 10, after twenty minutes of walking in the sun and there was no longer a cot available besides the flood of people who kept coming, at 11 after a swim we escaped!!So Recommendation for those who want to go there, to arrive early in the morning!!

reviews.title: Beautiful beach to see absolutely
reviews.text: The beach of Elafonissi is really beautiful and the water is so crystal clear that it looks like a natural pool.Few shaded areas and if strong wind blows put umbrellas is practically impossible.So Recommendation to arrive early or to take umbrella and deck chairs at a cost of 20 € or to occupy a shaded space.There are several parking lots .. the last one costs 5€ and is a few meters closer to the entrance to the beach. Walking path of about 500 meters feasible ..To see

reviews.title: Day in the Caribbean
reviews.text: Our day in Elafonissi is unforgettable, turquoise sea, translucent water, beautiful landscape. We took a bus Check-out from Rethymnon. There is something to eat on site.

reviews.title: Heaven
reviews.text: Amazing beach!!!All is beautiful blue day The sand is white K white!Ideal for families!!!K for couples

reviews.title: Ignore the negative reviews!
reviews.text: Yes the drive is not for the faint hearted, so if you're not confident, book an excursionDon't park at the first 2 car parks, ignore those at €3 and head to the last car park at €5 (it's closer to the beach)When walking to the beach, after the white mini market. Verge right, this is a gentle slope and not rockyIt's also not a long way down as others would suggest It is very busy, we arrived at 9.30am, you need to get there for 8/8.30am to get a sun loungerWe laid on the beach, swam in the crystal clear waters and enjoyed ourselves.If you don't like many people, don't go!
